She was loved by all and had an almost otherworldly ability to calm people and make them feel safe and at peace. However, after giving birth to Orsted, she was murdered by Hitogami when she used her body as a shield to protect her newborn son, who was the true target of the assassination. Her death was the catalyst that caused the Dragon God, out of sadness and rage, to destroy other worlds believing that the other gods or their servants were responsible for her murder.
- Orsted - Orsted's birth was the idea that came from the Human God, who proposed that the Dragon God marry his daughter Lunaria in other to produce a Demigod that is three-quarters God rather than only half, and the result was Orsted.]

entries.name: Seven Great Powers
Birthdays
entries.content: [Birthday celebrations: Birthday celebrations in this world take place every five years, i.e. at the age of 5, 10, 15, etc. Although it is rare, it is usually done in a rich and grand way, with significant gifts from parents, acquaintances and friends, sitting around the table with relatives and loved ones, drinking and celebrating. Such a tradition exists among the human race in this world, and perhaps among other races as well, although other races may have different views and rules about such traditions.]

entries.name: Adulthood
entries.content: [About adulthood: Among the human race, and possibly other races in this world, those who have reached the age of 15 are considered adults. But, as in the Middle Ages, the observance of this law varies, depending on the people themselves, the kingdom, the race, and so on.]

entries.name: Diseases
entries.content:
[About Diseases: Since the Human-Demon Wars, there are also several magic related diseases that are known to exist and in time the denizens of the Human World became immune to it or a way to treat them has been discovered. Such as:
1. Magic Stone Disease: Magic Stone Disease is an extremely rare magical virus that turns that kills its host by gradually turning it to a purple magic stone starting from their feet and eventual death upon reaching half of their body at the very least.
- Background: Magic Stone Disease is known to exist in the Human World since the Human-Demon Wars or earlier, when Kishirika Kishirisu was ruling as the Demon Empress. She has knowledge of this disease, that is also passed to those who are given her Identification Eyes in recent times.
- Cause: Rats are the main carriers of Magic Stone Disease because some of them have resistance to it, whereas the infected individuals can be identified easily by their teeth that turns into violet crystal. Humans or other animals could be infected by consuming food contaminated by infected rats.
- Infection: The pathogen of Magic Stone Disease is not airborne and infects orally, but it doesn't persist for very long and it disappears around a day, resulting in a very low infection rate. Moreover, it only infects pregnant women. When infected, the pathogen grows inside the fetus and proceeds to remold it into magic stone, which results in the death of the growing baby. At this point the mother also begins to exhibit symptoms of the disease, such as having fever and becoming bedridden. Finally, the body of the mother would start turning into magic stone (beginning from her feet), and she would also die in a few weeks if left untreated.
- Treatment: Magic Stone Disease is only curable by God Rank Detoxification Magic. The only book for the chant of God Rank Detoxification Magic belongs to the Milis Religion in Millishion, where they have exclusive rights to it and is only made available for archbishop rank or above. Transcribing the book takes time since it is as thick as a dictionary, whereas stealing it would result in the perpetrators being labelled as the worst criminals by the Milis Religion and hunted down for life by Millishion's Holy Knight Orders.
2. Drain Syndrome: Drain Syndrome is a magical illness first found in Humans from the early ages into the Laplace Wars that affects a child born with out any magic capacity who absorbs magic externally and after accumulating it for 10 years, they will fall ill and die.
- Background: Drain Syndrome had existed in the Human World ever since its early ages especially on children. Drain Syndrome was eventually eradicated around 7,000 years ago during the first Human-Demon Wars at the reign of Demon Empress Kishirika Kishirisu. The war caused all kinds of advancements for Humans such as increase in their mana capacity, which in turn made them immune to Drain Syndrome. As such, information and written records about the illness is very scarce during the present day, and some consider finding the disease's name to be a miracle in ancient libraries such as in Perugius Dola's Flying Fortress.
- Cause: Drain Syndrome is a disease that occurs when a human with little or no Mana capacity externally accumulates mana over time, until their body begins to react negatively to it. It usually takes around 10 years to happen for children. In other words, it's a disease that results from having mana within body that is incapable of holding mana. Despite the Humans that are born in the Human World are already immune to it for the past 7000 years, Drain Syndrome still affects those that have drifted to the Human World (like Nanahoshi).
When the patient's body is no longer able to handle the mana absorbed, they exhibit symptoms of frequent coughing that gets more severe over time, to the point of coughing blood, collapsing and losing consciousness. The affected patient would have a pale complexion and dark circles under their eyes while bedridden, and would eventually die unless treated.
- Treatment: Drain Syndrome has no permanent cure and it does not work even with the use of Healing Magic or Detoxification Magic. Otherwise, Drain Syndrome's sickness can temporarily be cured by drinking tea made from Sokasu Grass, which removes the Mana that accumulated in their body through their waste.
The unique power of Perugius' familiars can also be used as a temporary treatment such as Yuruzu of Atonement's power of transfer the health and vitality from one person to the patient. Sukeakoto of Time's power to stop time can also be used but because the patient's time is stopped no further research on the cure can be done and ultimately Sokasu Tea is the best treatment.]

entries.name: Laplace Factor
Miko's Blessing/Curse
World Map
entries.content:
[World Map: The Human World was originally an endless grassland, rolling hills covered in grass spreading endlessly. It is originally part of the Six World ruled by the Human God and is prominently known to be the most developed civilization among the worlds but their inhabitants, the Humans are the shortest-lived race and as such unique individuals and revolutionary ideas evolved more frequently for them.
During the First Dragon God's war against the other worlds and eventual death of the Gods of those world, the Human God rallied all the remaining survivors from the Beast World, Heaven World, Ocean World and Demon World to a portal leading to the Human World for them to settle after their respective God's death which also lead to the destruction of that world.

Central Continent: It's split into three parts by the Red Dragon Mountain Range. The poor and needy Northern areas with many wars, Asura Kingdom in the West one of the worlds most abundant and rich regions, a number of large countries are always struggling for power and rioting in the Southern area. Human race makes up the majority of the population.
Central Continent Place List: Asura Kingdom, Fittoa Region, Red Dragon's Lower Jaw, Upper Jaw, Dragon King Kingdom, West Port - East Port, Shirone Kingdom, Sanakia Kingdom, Kikka Kingdom, Strife Zone, Biheiril Kingdom.

Demon Continent: A poor place with strong monsters. There are Demon Lords ruling over various places. Demon(Magic) Race make up the largest portion of the population.
Demon Continent Place List: Town of Rikarisu, Town of Kurasuma, Wind Port - Saint Port.

Milis Continent: In the north there's the Great Forest, in the south there's the Holy Milis Kingdom. Splitting those two regions is the Blue Dragon Mountain Range, with the Holy Sword Highway going straight through them from top to bottom with not a single monster on the Highway. Population is roughly 50/50 of Human Race and Beast Race.
Milis Continent Place List: Great Forest, Holy Milis Kingdom.

Begaritto Continent: A large number of labyrinths, a place of many strange occurrences in terms of magical power. The strength of the monsters is equal to those of Demon Continent. A variety of races live here. The majority of them are Adventurers or ex-Adventurers.
Begaritto Continent Place List: Maze City of Rapan.

Heaven Continent: A level ground 3000 meters above sea level. The place where the Heavenly Race live.]

entries.name: Asura Kingdom
entries.content:
[Asura Kingdom: The country that holds the greatest national power in the world. It's abundant with natural resources, a land of fertility with no starvation. The soil hasn't become barren. The Asura Kingdom is a human kingdom holding the world's greatest national power located in the western area of the Central Continent and is one of the most abundant and richest regions in the world as such, becoming king of the Asura Kingdom is the same as becoming the richest person in the world. The bountiful resources found in this region and relatively very few monsters showing up makes the Asura Kingdom thrive with people. Asura, however, it is a hard place to make a living for adventurers; knights are dispatched regularly in order to exterminate monsters across towns and villages, hence very few extermination quests are put up. The capital Ars, named after a war hero of the human-race, is the largest city in the world.

The coat of arms: The emblem of the Asura Kingdom shows two unicorns at the edges, rearing up and looking at each other. Between them, in the center, is a sword, the blade looking down, capped with vines and grape leaves, alluding to the wines produced in the kingdom. Above the sword is a crown decorated with leaves on the sides. Beneath the sword are ears of wheat and a ribbon.

Territory: King's Region, Fittoa Region, Milbots Region, Donati Region, Wishiru Region.

Population: Asura Kingdom population is comprised mostly by Humans.

Royal Family: Asura Kingdom is ruled by an unnamed king and his heirs are scheming against each other on who will succeed him to the throne by gathering support from the kingdom's nobility. Currently the Boreas Family and Darius Silva Ganius supports Grabell's Faction while the Eurus and Zephirus Family supports Halfaus' faction and the Notos Family supports Ariel's faction.
Members of the royal family: Kaunis Freean Asura, Ariel Anemoi Asura, Grabell Zafin Asura, Halfaus Asura.

Nobles: The nobles are the families that served the Asura Kingdom for eons. Many of the prominent noble family names follow the color + animal etymology. For example: Greyrat, Redbat, Bluewolf, Purplehorse, Whitespider, Silvertoad, Yellowsnake.

Currency:
- Asura Gold Coin (100,000 yen = 1,000 USD);
- Asura Silver Coin (10,000 yen = 100 USD);
- Asura Large Copper Coin (1,000 yen = 10 USD);
- Asura Copper Coin = (100 yen = 1 USD).

Trivia: The surname of the royal family of Asura, Anemoi is based in the Greek: Ἄνεμοι, that means "Winds";
The surname of the four noble Greyrat house of Asura, Boreas, Notus, Eurus and Zephirus, is based in the four chief gods of the Anemoi.]

entries.name: Kings Region
entries.content:
[King's Region: The region that governs the kingdom. Population density is high and goods are gathered within the Asura Kingdom. In addition, glassware, etc. is sold for trade with the Begaritt Continent.

Ars: The Capital of the Asura Kingdom. Named after a hero who led his comrades in the First Great Human-Demon War to victory, it is also the largest city in the world. The headquarters of the Water God Sword Style is also located on Ars where knights undergo training.
High up on the top of a hill sits a majestic castle, the Silver Palace. Surrounding the palace are the huge mansions belonging to the higher nobles. Boulevards extend out of the surrounding city wall. Ars also has a huge coliseum, a gorgeous training ground for knights, beautiful temples for the Saint Milis religion, an aqueduct system that spread throughout the city and headquarters to the world's largest trading companies.]

entries.name: Fittoa Region
entries.content:
[Fittoa Region: It is known as the land of perfume, a fiefdom in the Asura Kingdom.

Region Lord: Under the crown of the Kingdom of Asura, the Fittoa Region is reigned by the Boreas Greyrat family. Sauros Boreas Greyrat is liege lord of the Region.

Landmarks: It is a vast agricultural area on the borders of the Kingdom. The lands in the Fittoan Region are largely rural with many forests.

Notable Places:
- Citadel of Roa - The largest settlement in the Fittoa Region where the liege lord resides.
- Buena Village - A peaceful hamlet.
- Wieden - A small town. It is two settlements away from Roa.]

entries.name: Citadel of Roa
entries.content:
[Citadel of Roa: The Citadel of Roa is a fortress city in the Fittoa Region of the Asura Kingdom lying on the Central Continent. Being the center of trade and commerce and the administrative headquarters of the Fittoa Region, Roa is the largest settlement in the Region.

History: Roa is an ancient city with noble history. Four hundred years ago, it stood as the last bastion of defense during the war against the Demon race. Owing to that, there stands a picturesque castle in the middle of the city.
Though, despite its mighty origin story, the nobles of the imperial capital currently saw Roa as nothing more than a crude backwater full of adventurers.

Description: Roa is a fortified city built inside walls. Sturdy ramparts, 7 to 8 meters in height are wrapped around the city. The walkways of the ramparts are roofed and along it, towers with conical spires are built with airy overviewing windows and balconies.
The city itself is not a perfect circle; it bent with the terrain making the dimensions hard to estimate. The city has a gigantic gate for the influx of merchants and townspeople. At the entrance one would be greeted with stables and inns and the waiting area for the stagecoaches. Along the main road, lines of merchant stalls are erected. Shops for different kind of customers are grouped by street junctions while residence buildings are situated in the alleyways much deeper into the city. The streets are paved and buildings are established in a grid structure with vendor shops lined tidily on the roadsides.
The city was built in such a way that the deeper you went into the city the bigger the houses became and the more luxurious the goods shops offered. The closer you lived to the center, the richer you were. All the shops near the noble district are elegant and peddled expensive wares. A castle is nestled right in the middle of the city which is used as the residence of the Region's lord.

Known Inhabitants: Sauros Boreas Greyrat, Philip Boreas Greyrat, Hilda Boreas Greyrat, Eris Boreas Greyrat, Ghislaine Dedoldia, Alphonse, Thomas, Edna.

Trivia: The city's mayor is Philip Boreas Greyrat.]

entries.name: Buena Village
entries.content:
[Buena Village: Buena Village is a small village sitting on the vast Fittoa Region plains of the Asura Kingdom. It is located in northern Fittoa closer to the east-west corridor of the Red Wyrm Mountains. Paul Greyrat is in charge of it as a knight.
Buena is a small hamlet surrounded by vast expanse of agricultural fields and prairies which comprised of approximately thirty households where most of the houses are built far apart from each other. Most of the villagers are engaged in the occupation of farming. The village's main produce is Asuran wheat that is used to make bread. Other than wheat, vegetables are also grown, and Vatirus flowers are cultivated which is a main component of making perfume and also edible.
At the edge of the village exists a forest where mana is concentrated and monsters occasionally appear. A watchtower is also built near the edge to keep a watch on monsters and other activities concerning the forest. Once every month, a group of young men, made up of knights, hunters, and the local militia, would head into the woods and exterminate monsters which have been accumulating its species.

Known Inhabitants: Paul Greyrat, Zenith Greyrat, Lilia Greyrat, Rudeus Greyrat, Sylphiette, Laws and Arna, Mr. and Mrs. Eto and their son Somar Eto.]

entries.name: Milbots Region
entries.content:
[Milbots Region: Famous as the land of alcohol and has a gigantic brewing site. Although beer is a regular commodity in the Asura Kingdom, most of the wine consumed in celebrations are produced in Milbots.
Region Lord: Notos Family.]

entries.name: Donati Region
entries.content:
[Donati Region: Famous for sugar and knitting wool. The export of arms for the northern adventurers and mercenaries is carried out as well.
Region Lord: Zephirus Family.]

entries.name: Wishiru Region
entries.content:
[Wishiru Region: Though there is no special mention of it's local specialty, the circulation of money or goods is prosperous because it is a doorway for the merchants that come from the south.
Region Lord: Eurus Family.]

entries.name: Red Dragon's Lower Jaw
entries.content: [Red Dragon's Lower Jaw, Upper Jaw: The only valleys of the Red Dragon Mountain Range that can be passed through.]
entries.comment: Red Dragon's Lower Jaw, Upper Jaw

entries.name: Dragon King's Kingdom
entries.content: [Dragon King Kingdom: The third ranked country in the world. It holds a wide territory in the southern area.]

entries.name: West Port
entries.content: [West Port - East Port: Port cities that connect Central Continent and Milis Continent.]

entries.name: Shirone Kingdom
entries.content:
[Shirone Kingdom: An ally of the Dragon King Kingdom. The border area of the strife zone. Shirone Kingdom is a small country, but it's an old country that has 200 years of history.

400 years ago, all human race countries except Asura Kingdom and the Holy Milis Kingdom were wiped out in the war. Until 300 years ago when Dragon King Kingdom took control of the southern-most tip, it was a region of intense strife. Even now, if you go north, the strife zone spreads out. The Shirone Kingdom is a country that is relatively close to that strife zone. Shirone Kingdom manage to last as a country for 200 years because they formed an alliance with the Dragon King Kingdom early on in their history. Even if you were to call it an alliance, the difference in power is clear. If you were to stop by the Shirone Kingdom on the way to the Dragon King Kingdom it's like the other two kingdoms, a vassal state.]

entries.name: Sanakia Kingdom
entries.content: [Sanakia Kingdom: A vassal nation of the Dragon King Kingdom. Local specialty is rice.]

entries.name: Kikka Kingdom
entries.content: [Kikka Kingdom: A vassal nation of the Dragon King Kingdom. Local specialty is oil (side dish).]

entries.name: Strife Zone
entries.content: [Strife Zone: A place where large countries just keep continuing with nothing but skirmishes.]

entries.name: Biheiril Kingdom
entries.content:
[Biheiril Kingdom: The Biheiril Kingdom is a Human/Orc kingdom located in the northenmost part of the Central Continent and besides Onigashima, the orcs' homeland. Orcs are highly respected by humans and vice-versa, this is because a party of human adventurers had saved the orcs from the ocean-race in the past, causing the two to become closer.

The Biheiril Kingdom is full of North Style swordsmen looking for strong people to fight with.

The Superd have taken residence in a forest inside the Biheiril Kingdom.

Territory:
- First City - The First City is the capital city of the Biheiril Kingdom.
- Second City - The Second City of the Biheiril Kingdom.
- Third City - The Third City is a port city that connects to Onigashima, the Orc Island.

Currency: Biheiril Gold Coin = 10,000 Yen ($100).]

entries.name: Demon Continent
entries.content:
[Demon Continent: The Demon Continent, lying to the east of the Ringus Sea, is the continent where the Demon Race live. There are no roads but a single path is present. It's a poor place with strong monsters, D-rank or above monsters roam around the continent and they have high adaptability to the techniques even if they see it only once. It is said that warriors go there to train but mostly never come back. It is an exceedingly harsh land over which is ruled by Demon Lords. The monsters are said to taste bad. Demon (Magic) Race make up the largest portion of the population.

Population: The Demon Race makes up the large majority of the population. The Human Race, Beast Race, and the Seafolk can be seen near port towns. Demon God Tongue is the language spoken.

Governance: There are about 30 demon lords and each one of them has their own territory. They're demon lords in name only though, who just act bossy. There are also demon lords who have a special unit, but actually, they’re just warriors with special powers and cool names. The Special Guard in the town of Rikaris is also one of them. The people in special units are actually pretty similar to adventurers. They exterminate monsters like them, they catch criminals in town, and they also guard the town they live in. If a demon lord is determined to start a war, they would become the demon lord’s army. Most of the magic continent is a lawless area that does not have a Demon Lord ruling over the territory.

Geography:
1. Biegoya Region - The region reigned over by the Demon King Badigadi. It includes:
- Rikarisu - The city of Rikarisu, also referred to as Old Kishirisu Castle, is one of the three largest settlements on the Demon Continent. It served as the home base for the forces of the Demon Empress Kishirika Kishirisu during the Great Human-Demon War. It sits in the middle of a gigantic crater.
- Petrified Forest - A forest a days journey away from Rikarisu. It was a place where bone-like trees with jagged branches grew in enormous numbers. Cutting through the forest offered a shortcut to reach another nearby city, but due to the presence of multiple rank B monsters such as the Almond Anaconda and the Executioner, this shortcut is only taken by merchants in a big hurry who hire multiple skilled bodyguards beforehand. The rank A Red-Hood Cobra can also rarely be present as well.
- Migurd Village - The Migurd Village is a small settlement where the Demon tribe of Migurd lives.
2. Gaslow Region - The region reigned over by the Demon King Atoferatofe Raibaku. Sokasu grass is also grown in this region in depths of caves where the sun never shines and its inhabitants have knowledge of its cultivating techniques. In addition to being used as tea due to its delicious taste by demons, Sokasu grass is also used for treatment in Drain Syndrome. It includes:
- Fort Necross - An impregnable fortress built by the immortal Demon King Necross Lacross. The place where Atoferatofe resides.
3. Babynos Region - Where the Superd tribe originally lived before driven out of their homes during the Laplace war.
4. Southern Region - Here lies Wind Port. The only port city in the Demon Continent and is the connecting travel hub via sea to and from Zanto Port, Millis Continent. It's a town with a lot of hills and slopes. You can see the entire city from the entrance.

Monsters: Due to the high mana density, the monsters occupying the Demon Continent are far greater in strength and numbers when compared to other continents. All monsters are ranked D and above, while also having high adaptability to the techniques even if they see it only once. Combined with the harsh terrain, the Demon Continent is widely regarded as the most dangerous continent in the world.

Currency:
- Green Ore Coins (1,000 yen = 10 USD);
- Iron Coin (100 Yen = 1 USD);
- Scrap Iron Coin (10 Yen = 10 cents);
- Stone Coin (1 Yen = 1 cent).]

entries.name: Rikarisu City
entries.content:
[Rikarisu City: The City of Rikarisu is one of the three largest settlements on the Demon Continent, located in the Biegoya Region. Rikarisu sits in the middle of an enormous crater, the rim of which forms a single continuous wall around the city currently serves to protect the city against marauding monsters. At the time of the Great Human-Demon War, it served as a home base for the forces of the Demon Empress Kishirika Kishirisu. Even now, it is sometimes referred to as Old Kishirisu Castle.

The current ruler is Demon Lord Badigadi.

Description:
There are only three entrances to the city, all of which are cracks in the rim of the crater. The walls of the crater are tall enough that one would not be able to make their way over them unless they could fly. Near the entrance to the town were the merchant related inns, related stables, and stores which are all connected.
The buildings are not as tall as the ones built in human settlements in the Central Continent but there are just as many of them. The buildings are not built with architectural taste but rather as passable facility for living in, as a result a majority of the houses look homespun and similar. Most of the facilities near the entrance were stables and inns that clearly catered to traveling merchants and adventurers similar to the Citadel of Roa.
At the very heart of the city stand the ruins of Castle Kishirisu, half-destroyed during the events of Laplace War. Imposingly thick outer walls surround the broken black-and-gold castle itself, a sight that offer visitors a constant reminder of the Empress's faded glory and demonkind's violent, painful past.

Known Inhabitants: Nokopara, Roman, Jalil, Vizquel.]

entries.name: Town of Kurasuma
entries.content: [Town of Kurasuma: The only town where Demon Continent and the Sea Race make exchanges. The current ruler is Demon Lord Bagurahagura.]

entries.name: Wind Port
entries.content: [Wind Port - Saint Port: The port cities that connect Milis Continent to Demon Continent.]

entries.name: Milis Continent
entries.content:
[Millis Continent: Millis Continent is the continent where the ratio of Human Race and Beast Race is 50:50, people living there follow Milis religion similar to Catholics, and have a church but there are peoples who do not follow. In terms of marriage, they strictly follow the policy of monogamy. It lies Southeast of the Ringus Sea.

Population: The population of Beast Race is almost the same as the Human Race. The Human settles in the West plains while the Beast Race is secluded in the eastern jungles. The main languages spoken are the Human Tongue and Beast-God Tongue.

Geography: In the north there's the Great Forest, in the south there's the Holy Milis Kingdom. Splitting those two regions is the Blue Dragon Mountain Range, with the Holy Sword Highway going straight through them from top to bottom with not a single monster on the Highway.
1. Holy Country of Millis (aka Holy Milis Kingdom) - The second oldest and most powerful kingdom after the Asura Kingdom. It is the Holy Land of the world's largest faith - the Milis Religion.
2. Millishion - The capital of the Holy Country of Millis. It is said to be the most beautiful city in the world.
3. Great Forest - A huge woodland that occupies the northeastern half of the Continent. It is home to various races - the Beast Race resides in the northern part of the forest, Hobbits in the northwest, the Dwarves in the southwest, and the Elves to the southeast. The forest has 3 months of torrential rain every year.
4. Dedoldia Village - The settlement where the Dedoldia Tribe lives.
5. Blue Dragon Mountain Range - The Blue Dragon Mountain Range is the border that separates the Great Forest and the Holy Country of Millis thus effectively separating the human and beast race territory. The Holy Sword Highway passes through by a gap in the mountain that is wide enough for 2 carriages to pass at the same time. Rock slides almost never happens here which is believed to be the divine power of Saint Millis and one of the reasons Millis is worshipped very well.
Despite the namesake, Blue Dragons are almost never seen here since they fly all around the world, but they always return to the Blue Dragon Mountain Range for nesting and raising children. At the southern most base of the Blue Dragon Mountain Range lies a Dwarf town that is famously known as a blacksmith town because of its high quality and cheap swords and armor.
6. Holy Sword Highway - A road constructed by the Holy Country of Millis that crosses the continent, from West Port to Millishion and from Millishion through the Great Forest to Zant Port. Due to the story that the creation of the highway was from a single swing of Saint Millis' sword that sliced straight through the Blue Dragon Mountain Range, the Great Forest, and even cut down a Demon Lord on the Demon Continent, the road is eventually named "Holy Sword Highway". Despite the doubts on the story, the road is still bursting with Mana from Saint Millis, so even if the surrounding area is flooded because the rainy season of the Great Forest, the road remains dry and further proof of that, there are absolutely no encounters with monsters even now.
7. Zant Port - A port located in the North of Millis Continent, where his ships travel to Wind port in the Demon Continent. Also known as Saint Port or Zanto Port. Before the start of the 3 months rainy season, the inns of Zant Port are usually booked in advance for a long period as travelling across the Great Forest is impossible because of floods.
8. West Port - A port located in the West of Millis Continent, where his ships travel to East port in the Central Continent.

Currency:
- Royal Notes (50,000 yen = 500 USD);
- General Notes (10,000 yen = 100 USD);
- Millis Gold Coins (5,000 yen = 50 USD);
- Millis Silver Coins (1,000 yen = 10 USD);
- Millis Large Copper Coins (100 yen = 1 USD);
- Millis Copper Coins (10 Yen = 10 cents).]

entries.name: Millishion
entries.content:
[Millishion: Millishion is a human city and capital of the Holy Country of Millis, Millis Continent which is said to be the most beautiful city in the world for its majesty and harmony.

Geography: Millishion is located in the of central region of Millis Continent and is bordered by the Blue Dragon Mountain Range from the north and beyond is the Great Forest while making possible to get a full view of the city just by looking at it from the Holy Sword Highway. The Nikolaus River flows from Blue Dragon Mountain Range to the city that is the main source of water for the sparkling blue Grand Lake at the center of the city. Flooding was a problem for the city in the past due to the 3 months of torrential rainy season until the creation of the Seven Magic Towers to perfectly control the water and projects a barrier around the city.

Background: On the final battle of the Laplace Wars, the final kingdom left behind in the human race is the Holy Country of Milis, who rallied its entire army to resist lead by the 7 heroes. But due to the beast races acting as a blockade in the Great Forest and ally of the demons, the 7 heroes convinced the beast race to ally with them instead by kidnapping their children and threaten them. After a short time, the 7 heroes led the Holy Knight Orders and the beast races to attack the Laplace army. After the fierce battle, 4 of the 7 heroes died, but the entire main Laplace army was completely routed, and successfully sealed the Demon-God Laplace. The only 3 survivors are, Dragon God Urupen, North God Kalman I, the Armored King Perugius Dola and are called the "The three heroes who vanquished the Demon God".
Laplace was defeated, but the human race was also exhausted and it was impossible to continue fighting therefore, a treaty was signed with the moderate faction's Demon King. The treaty removes the blockade from the Demon Continent thus allowing the demon races to travel freely to other continents and the discrimination towards the demon races are all banned. Despite the treaty, the discrimination towards the demon races is still as deep as before especially between the Milis Religion's Demon Race Acceptance and Demon Race Expulsion factions who are in a bitter power struggle in Millishion to this day.

Areas: Millishion has multiple entrance in its districts but with the exception of the Adventurers District, entering the other district will put Adventurers through a certain amount of questioning and it can take quite a bit of time.
1. Adventurers District - Located in the south, the Adventurers District is the place where the Adventurers gather where all sorts of shops and inns aimed towards Adventurers. There's also a slum area, gambling place and the slave market is in this district rather than the commerce district. Near the district's entrance to the city, there are inns and stables that provides a service to take luggage to the inn for adventurers that are not in other towns.
2. Holy District - Located in the west, there is the Holy District where a number of places for those related to the Milis Religion is located such as the enormous Great Church and the Knight Orders has their headquarters in this district.
3. Residential District - Located in the north, is the Residential District where the section of private houses and blocks also follows the harmony of blue and green seen through out Millishion. This is the place where the family of nobles, knights and average citizens live but fundamentally they are all private houses in the residential district.
4. Commercial District - Located in the east, the Commercial District is where all sorts of merchants gather which has a large number of shops, but the structures are small. It's a place where many companies meet and widen their trade contacts together seen in any business district and services like Blacksmiths and Auction houses are here as well. The 2 factions of the Milis Religion is also shown here by posting the emblems of the faction they are affiliated with below their sign post particularly the Demon Race Expulsion who refuses to sell their wares to demons or even throw them out of their shop.

Points of Interest:
1. White Palace - The White Palace is Holy Country of Millis' Seat of Power floating at the center of the Grand Lake and home of the Royal Family. The Seven Magic Towers encircling the White Palace protects it from floods and because of the barrier from the towers, no walls are needed. Unlike Asura Kingdom's Royal Family, The Milis Church holds most of the power so having an audience the Millishion's king is only for formality.
2. Adventure Guild Main Headquarters - The Adventure Guild Main Headquarters is a silver glowing two story building and is the largest building in the Adventurers District at the end of the main road. Being the main headquarters, it is also the largest Adventure Guild Headquarters in the world and the main lobby is larger than the banquet halls of the Citadel of Roa. Since there is no Adventure Guild Headquarters in the Great Forest, non-human adventurers like the elves, hobbit, dwarves and beast race uses either Millishion or Zanto Port as their base or take requests on either places and because of this, adventurers in Millishion regardless of race are treated without bias.
A permanent job request in Millishion is the Goblin-Subjgation Job that it is also stated on the request to not tear of the request on the board and simply bring the gathered goblin ears to the counter for 10 Milis copper a piece and it can be accepted by adventurers regardless of rank. Goblins are E-ranked magic beasts that are almost a rat-like existence in the Human World and only appears in the forests or plains. Although goblins are weak, if they are left unchecked, they would steadily increase in population and start to attack nearby villages.
3. Great Church - The Great Church is the Headquarters and the center of faith of the Milis Religion, the world's largest religious organization which is a 4 storey building with a golden onion-shaped dome at the top and has 4 courtyards matching the 4 seasons respectively.
4. Magic Towers - Millishion has 7 Magic Towers that are huge Magic Tools that encircles the city to control the water levels of the lake and prevent flooding in the city especially during the rainy season. The tower is so tall and massive that it takes several minutes to circle it and at close distance, the top of the tower cannot be seen. The Magic Tower houses the Magic Tool like a case and it is also by protected soldiers and a large scale barrier magic where faint symbols around the tower can be seen. Because of the tower being unique only to Millishion, it is also a famous tourist spot for the city's visitors.

Holy Knight Orders: Millishion's military has three knight orders and are said to be the second most powerful nation after Asura Kingdom. Under the leadership of the 7 heroes and the combined forces of the Holy Knights Orders and Beast Race, Millishion is the only human kingdom that survived the Laplace Wars. Assassinations of other knight order members are not unusual especially those opposing factions of the Milis Relgion.
1. Order of the Church: The Order of the Church is entrusted with matters of national defense like patrolling Millishion and arresting would be criminals. They wear white armor and are neutral on their stance in the expulsion or acceptance of the demon race.
Known members of Order of the Church:
- Belmondo Nash Venick - Belmondo is the son of Galgard and Lieutenant Commander of the Order of the Church's "Arrow Group". He is a one-eyed man with scars on his face and is around 40 years old.
- Reilbard - Reilbard is the Battalion Commander of the Order of the Church's "Arrow Group".
2. Order of Instruction: The Order of Instruction is a mercenary group who wears silver armor that sends young knights to areas of strife for combat experience, and at the same time is responsible for spreading the teachings of Milis to various places. Participating in one of the Order of Instruction's expeditions is a coming of age ceremony for all Holy Knights.
Known members of Order of Instruction:
- Galgard Nash Venick - the Grand Master of the Order of Instruction is an unrefined, taciturn man who rarely laughs. How Galgard became an acquaintance of Ruijerd Superdia is unknown but in the past he had returned as a survivor of the Demon Continent expedition, and over the past few decades he's been the driving force behind the Order of Instruction being successively known as the the strongest. Since the time Galgard had become Grand Master, the survival of the Order of Instruction rose past 90% and because of numerous people he had saved, all knights hold him in respect.
3. Order of the Temple: The Order of the Temple are the most feared of the 3 orders due to their infamous Inquisitors, tasked with stamping out heresy. They wear blue armor and are aligned with the Demon Race Expulsion Faction of the Milis Religion.
Known members of Order of the Temple:
- Miko of Memory - Leader of the Order of the Temple and candidate to be the next Pope.
- Leblanc McFarlane - Cardinal of the Milis Religion who manages of the Order of the Temple and assists the Pope like a prime minister to a king.
- Carlyte Latreia - Born Carlyte Granz is the Head of the Latreia House and Battalion Commander of the Order of the Temple's "Sword Group".
- Therese Latreia - Company Commander of the Order of the Temple's [Anastasia Keep], the protector of the Miko of Memory.
- Edgar Latreia - Eldest son of the Latreia House and Platoon Leader of the Order of the Temple who is stationed to a town west of Millishion.
- Ralkan Latreia - Prevous Head of the Latreia House and Claire's father who was a Company Commander of the Order of the Temple.

Magic: Millishion has one of the most advanced Barrier Magic and Healing Magic in the world.
1. Barrier Magic - The Barrier Magic generated by the 7 Magic Towers is one of the reasons why Millishion is the only human kingdom that survived the Laplace Wars. The office of the Pope is also protected by Barrier Magic classified to be at least Saint Rank for additional security.
2. Healing Magic - Despite the very advance healing magic provided by Millishion's schools, most people stop learning healing magic after attaining elementary rank. If one learns healing magic to the intermediate rank, that person can work in Milis's hospital, so it is heavily favored upon in school.
3. Detoxification Magic - Millishion houses the book for God Rank Detoxification Magic where at least an Archbishop rank of the Great Church can access.

Earldom: In addition to the royal family and the Milis Religion, Millishion is also influenced by the noble families of earls. From a young age they enter school to learn magic and/or sword techniques that would eventually lead to either taking over the head of their family, join the priesthood of the Great Church or enlist with the Holy Knight Orders.
Latreia House: A distinguished family among the earls that has deep ties with the Order of the Temple and part of the Demon Race Expulsion Faction. The head of the house is Count Carlyte Latreia married to Countess Claire Latreia.
Grimoire House: The most influential family of the Milis Religion and part of the Demon Race Acceptance Faction. The head of the house is Pope Harry Grimoire and the leader of the Milis Religion.

Trivia: Millishion having 7 Magic Towers follows the notion that 7 is a lucky number seen through out history. Such as the 7 Worlds, 7 heroes, Seven Great Powers and 7 ranks for Sword Styles and Magic.]

entries.name: Milis Religion
entries.content:
[Milis Religion: Milis Religion is the largest religious organization in the world founded by Saint Milis that is found almost through out the continents where humans live.

Headquarters: The Great Church is the main headquarters of the Milis Religion located in Millishion, Holy Kingdom of Milis, Millis Continent. The current leader is Pope Harry Grimoire, Cliff Grimoire's grandfather.

Factions: The Milis Religion followed the scripture saying that "all Demons should be destroyed" and rejected the Demon Race. But 300 years ago, a priest read its scripture that said: "All races are equal under Millis" and questions if the Demon Races are equal as well, which caused a division in the priests and causing the religion to split in 2 factions that are in a power struggle since then.
1. Demon Race Acceptance Faction - Also known as the Pope Faction lead by the current Pope Harry Grimoire is the larger faction that has the influence among the majority of the general populace and the Order of Instruction. 50 years ago, the Acceptance faction influence rose after they put an end to the escalating conflicts with the Beast Race and other denizens of the Great Forest, and for the next 30 years since then had complete control of the religion and Millishion's affairs. Despite being a religious organization, assassinations is still a method used by both factions especially towards the opposing faction's pope candidate.
2. Demon Race Expulsion Faction - Also known as the Cardinal Faction lead by Cardinal Leblanc McFarlane is the faction of the Milis Religion who zealously follows the old teachings of the Milis Church that the Demon Race should be completely expelled and has a close relationship with the Latreia House and the Order of the Temple and at the peak of their influence, non-human races were strongly oppressed in Millishion which resulted many quarrels with the inhabitants of the Great Forest. While currently losing influence among the 2 factions for the last 30 years, this has changed when the Miko of Memory was born and joins the Demon Race Expulsion Faction to become the candidate for the next pope. The influence of the Demon Race Expulsion rose to the point that even the Royal Family needs permission from the Cardinal to even use the powers of the Miko.

Legends:
1. Necklace of Milis - Before heading to certain death, Saint Millis gave an ornamental necklace to her most beloved who gave him a kiss on his forehead and wished for his return. When Saint Millis was in danger, her beloved one offered the necklace to God who was touched by the exquisite necklace and beloved's love and intervenes to save Saint Millis.
This become a part of the Milis Religion wedding ceremony where a replica of the Necklace of Milis is a requirement of every Milis Church. The priest hands over the necklace to the groom who puts it on her bride. Then the bride kisses the groom on his forehead, a kiss of oath similar to the legend.
2. Holy Sword Highway - During the war between humans and demons, Saint Milis plans to use his holy sword to defeat the demon army but this takes time to focus the attack. While Milis is preparing the attack, Peter Dolior the commander of the human army and Milis' closest friend fought to hold off the demon army and died in battle until Milis brings down his holy sword on the demon army. The power of the holy sword reached from Millishion, cuts a gap through the Blue Dragon Mountain Range, through the Great Forest, then across the ocean and struck the demon king that instantly kills him at the place now known as Wind Port.
The place where Milis launched the attack is now known as the Holy Sword Highway that is still bursting with Mana from Saint Millis, so even if the surrounding area is flooded because the rainy season of the Great Forest, the road remains dry and further proof of that, there are absolutely no encounters with monsters.

Trivia: Milis Religion shares similarity with the Catholic Church from the pope being its head to even its teachings.]

entries.name: Ringus Sea
entries.content:
[Ringus Sea: Ringus Sea is a sea surrounded by the five Continents. Central Continent to the west, Demon Continent to the east and northeast, the Divine Continent to the north, and the Millis Continent to the southeast.
This sea spawned when the former supercontinent was split into the Central and Demon Continent during the Second Great Human-Demon War.

Population: The sea is populated by the Seafolk. The language spoken is the Sea-God Tongue.

Notable Places: Devil's Cave - A labyrinth that sits in the middle of the Ringus Sea. It is brutally difficult to even reach this labyrinth and due to its location, it is impossible to resupply once arrived. Given its depth and the fact that slow-paced exploration is almost impossible, it has earned the reputation as one of the toughest tests an adventurer can face.

Trivia:
- There are many pirates who rule these waters between the continents.
- Perhaps this sea was the result of the God rank magic that Laplace used to match the strength of the Fighting God Armor.]

entries.name: Begaritt Continent
entries.content:
[Begaritt Continent: Begaritt Continent is a continent in the southwest that has a large number of labyrinths, there is high concentration of mana in this region. The strength of the monsters is equal to those of Demon Continent. Due to the harsh environment and the number of monsters that spawn the continent is said to be the second most dangerous in the world after the Demon Continent. There aren't any established countries in Begaritt, only towns or safe areas.

Population: A variety of races live here. The majority of them are Human Race Adventurers or ex-Adventurers. The language spoken is the Fighting God Tongue.

Localization:
1. Maze City of Rapan - The most prominent city of Bergaritt Continent that was built inside of an enormous rib cage of a Behemoth monster, which could easily contain an average-sized city, the buildings are mostly made of earth and monster materials.
2. Teleport Labyrinth - An S-rank labyrinth located in a cave of a cliff near the city of Rapan.
3. Ports - The Continent has two ports, one that connects with the West Side of the Central Continent in the Asura Kingdom, and the other that connect with the South Side of the Central Continent in Dragon King Realm.

Monsters: Due to the high mana density, the population and strength of the monsters appearing on the continent are close to the level of the Demon Continent. Combined with the harsh desert environment, Begaritt is regarded as the second most dangerous continent.

Currency: The currency is the Shinsa, but bartering products with monster material or food is more common. For 3 shinsa you can buy a meal.

Trivia:
- It is the only continent disconnected from the Ringus Sea.
- The stories said that Kalman II defeated a Great Behemoth where the Maze City of Rapan was built.
- The glass is an outstanding product of this region, better than in Asura.
- The succubus was a monster that originally was found only in the Demon Continent until Laplace mass produced them to destroy the warriors of the Begaritt Continent.]

entries.name: Teleportation Labyrinth
entries.content:
[Teleportation Labyrinth: Teleportation Labyrinth is an S-ranked labyrinth located in the Begaritt Continent, in a cave of a cliff near the city of Rapan which takes app.

Book: To assist in the exploration of the Labyrinth, Rudeus borrowed a book from the Ranoa Magic Academy Library titled: «An Exploratory Account of the Teleportation Labyrinth» which records the previous attempts of adventurers on exploring the Labyrinth.

Overview: A seven floor labyrinth where each floor is connected by a teleportation magic circle. The labyrinth is full of teleportation traps. The architecture of the first three floors is similar to an ant nest, with curving tunnels, complicated passages and dead ends. Starting from the fourth floor, the architecture is similar to the ruins of the Dragon Tribe.
Floor 1 - The nest of the Tarantula Deathlord. The walls and ceiling have white threads stretched all around them.
Floor 2 - The place with a large quantity of Iron Crawler and Tarantula Deathlord.
Floor 3 - Mad Skulls can be found commanding groups of Iron Crawler and Tarantula Deathlord.
Floor 4 - Iron Crawler and Tarantula Deathlord disappear leaving only Mad Skulls and Armored Warriors.
Floor 5 - And then, after you get to the fifth floor the Mad Skulls disappear leaving only Armored Warriors and Devouring Devils.
Floor 6 - This floor is the nesting ground of Devouring Devils. The final room of the floor has 3 teleportation magic circles, these circles are traps, and the real magic circles that connects to the final floor can be found below a hidden stairs.
Floor 7 - The final room housed the Guardian of the Labyrinth, the Manatite Hydra. The room has a rectangular shape, similar to a giant temple hall, with thick pillars on the edge of the room as big as a baseball field.

Monsters: The labyrinth is filled with powerful and intelligent monsters. They are familiar with the labyrinth's layout, and are capable of setting up structured ambushes using the teleportation circles in the labyrinth.]

entries.name: Divine Continent
entries.content:
[Divine Continent (aka Heaven Continent) is a small continent located in the north connected to the Central Continent. It is where the Heaven Race lives. The continent sits on a 3000-meter cliff with no proper connecting roads. The Continent lies far north of the Ringus Sea.

Population: The Heaven Race is the only major race that is known to live on this continent. The language spoken is Sky God Tongue.

Localization:
1. Hell - One of the three greatest labyrinths in the world. This was where Nether King Vita stayed to avoid Laxus.
2. Artier - A town of the Heaven Race protected by a barrier. Perugius Dola has some ties with the citizens in the town, and they would guide the people who come for their child's baptism to the shrine.

Trivia: Even though is connected by a cliff with the Central Continent and Demon Continent, is considered a separate Continent because is really hard to climb.]

entries.name: Human-Demon Wars
entries.content:
[About Human-Demon Wars: The Human-Demon Wars were three wars fought between the Demon Race and the Human Race. The first two wars were waged by Great Demon Empress Kishirika Kishirisu, known as the Great Human-Demon War, to reign superiority over the Human Race. But the third war was waged by Demon God Laplace in his own name, referred to as the Laplace War, as an outcome of his hatred of the Human Race.

First Great Human-Demon War: The First Great Human-Demon War is the first great war between the Human Race and the Demon Race which was fought between 6000 - 7000 years prior to the main story. Kishirika Kishirisu, the Great Demon Empress, and the Five Great Demon Kings led the Demons against the Humans. This war was fought before the splitting of the Central Continent and the Demon Continent, when the Humans and the Demons still lived in one landmass known as the Great Continent. The war lasted for approximately a millennium, repeating constantly between a state of fierce battle and relaxation. Finally the hero of humanity Ars and his six comrades ended the long war following the defeat the Five Great Demon Kings and the Demon Empress Kishirika.

Second Great Human-Demon War: The Second Great Human-Demon War is the second great war between the Human Race and the Demon Race which was fought between 5000 - 4200 years prior to the main story. The Great Demon Empress Kishirika Kishirisu, seeking vengeance for a thousand-year old grudge, brought the Beast Race and Ocean Race to the Demon side and waged war for the second time against the Human Race. This time the Human Race was pushed back and cornered but the war still went on for several centuries without surrendering.
At the time of distress of the Humans, the Demon Dragon King Laplace joined the war to annihilate the Demon Army singlehandedly which allowed the Human Army to retake their frontlines. Laplace was eventually defeated by the Fighting God who was an Apostle of Hitogami. On the verge of death, Laplace performed the reincarnation Magic of the Dragon Race but the spell went out of control and the released force of Mana was so strong that it split the Great Continent into two - now known as the Central Continent and the Demon Continent - forming a new sea in the middle now referred to as the Ringus Sea. This event marked the end of the Second Great Human-Demon War which lasted for 800 years.

Laplace War: The Laplace War was a war that lasted between 500 - 400 years prior to the main story. Though it lasted much shorter than the previous wars, the humans were forced into a war far more brutal than any they had fought before. The one who united all the Demons of the Demon Continent and launched this assault against the Humans was the Demon God Laplace - a human-hating Demon who was split from the failed reincarnation attempt of Demon Dragon King Laplace in the previous war.
Demon God Laplace spawned approximately a thousand years ago. In a extremely short period of time, he rallied the Demons and conquered the Demon Continent. For many years he cultivated his empire, building his race to be tough and fierce. After long years, he pulled the Beast Race and the Ocean Race over to his side.
Laplace began his military campaign approximately 500 years ago. The invasion began from the south, drawing all the humans' military power there. Then he set his wyrms upon the land, making passage through the mountains impossible. After that he took the humans by storm, attacking with a separate unit from the north, scattering his enemies. In a short time, he had gained total control of the north and the south. Then from both directions, he pressed his assault on the western region.
Forced into a corner, the humans took their last gamble. The Seven Heroes convinced the Ocean Race to lift their blockade, then set out on the seas for the Millis Continent. Now allied with the demons, the Beast Race had taken control of the Holy City of Millis. So the Seven Heroes took the clan leaders' children hostage and threatened them into cooperation. The Seven Heroes, leading the Holy Knights of Millis and the Beast Race, launched a decisive battle and assaulted Laplace's main stronghold.
After a violent confrontation, four of the Seven Heroes were dead, but they successfully sealed Laplace away and destroyed his closest companions. Though Laplace was defeated, the humans were greatly exhausted from the long battle and couldn't keep up to fight anymore. Instead, they signed a treaty with one of the Demon Kings who wasn't allied with Laplace and the blockade on the Demon Continent was lifted. According to the terms of the treaty, racial discrimination was prohibited and demons could now freely travel to other continents.

Trivia:
- Demon Dragon King Laplace joined the human side of the Second Great Human-Demon War under the false name of Aldebaran who was nicknamed the Golden Knight.
- Demon Dragon King Laplace, who was a Demon-Dragon hybrid, split into two beings after his failed reincarnation attempt - Technique God and Demon God. Technique God retained his Dragon Race side and all his knowledge; Demon God retained his Demon Race side and his hatred for the Human God, eventually forgetting the "God" part his hatred mistakenly turned towards the Human Race itself.
- During the First Human-Demon War, the great elven swordsman Idaztleid fought and was killed by the great demon king Necross Lacross but almost no one today remembers this event.]

entries.name: Adventure Guild
entries.content:
[About Adventure Guild: One of the biggest organizations in the world. A place where men of great strength and valor gather. Adventure Guilds can be found in all major cities in the world. Adventurers can take missions up to one rank above or below their current rank. It's main headquarters is found in Millishion, Holy Kingdom of Milis in the Adventurer's District.

Receptionist: The Receptionist is the main contact of the Adventure Guild with its Adventurers and is usually seen at the reception counter.
Duties of the Receptionist:
1. Membership Services - Assist Adventurers in registering in the guild and informing them of the guild rules, regulations and other general guild information;
2. Adventurer Card Services - Process Adventurer Cards that includes updating party information and disbanding them;
3. Job Request Services - Provide information on a Job Request such as if its still available; Accept or Decline a job taken by an Adventurer like when someone was refused to solo an A-Rank Job of killing Luster Grizzlies or confirm a completed job and give out payment.

Code of Conduct:
1. Use of the Adventurer's Guild - If one registers with the Adventurer's Guild, they will receive services available to Adventurers.
2. Service Content - All Adventurer's Guilds throughout the world offer these services: job offerings, delivery of compensation and rewards, purchase of raw materials, and exchange of currency.
3. Registration Information - Adventurers receive a card with their own information under their control upon registering for the Adventurer's Guild. It is possible to re-issue it if lost, but rank will be reset to F. Also, each area has it's own fine for it.
4. Withdrawal from the Adventurer's Guild - If you request it, withdrawal from the guild is possible. Re-registration is possible, but rank will restart at F.
5. Prohibited Conduct - If prohibited actions are discovered, a fine will be applied and Adventurers guild qualifications will be revoked. The below actions are considered prohibited:
- Actions which go against a countries laws.
- Actions which disgrace and cause the reliability of the guild to fall.
- Actions which interfere or obstruct other Adventurers jobs.
- Buying, selling, and trading of jobs.
6. Breach of Contract Compensation - If you fail a job you have accepted you must pay compensation for the breach of contract, two times the amount of the job reward compensation. Repayment period is half a year. If compensation is not paid, Adventurers guild qualification will be revoked.
7. Rank - There are seven ranks from F to S based on Adventurers proven skills. As a general rule of thumb, you can only take jobs within one above or below your current rank.
8. Rank Promotions and Demotions - It is possible to raise your rank by succeeding a regulated number of jobs. However, if you feel that your ability isn't up to standard it is possible to remain at your current rank as well. Also, if you fail a certain number of jobs in succession, your rank will be demoted by one.
9. Obligation - In the case that a country is under attack by monsters and a request for assistance is made from the guild, you have an obligation to obey. Also, if an emergency situation arises, Adventurers have an obligation to obey the guild staff members.

Adventurer Card: Adventurer Cards are cards that shows someone as an official adventurer. It also contains Magic Power that can change the letterings of the card into different languages by pressing the center of the back of the card and saying the desired race's lettering you want to see but its costs Magic Power stored in a small magic crystal that normally lasts 1 year. The Magic Power in the card is automatically replenished on completing a job.
The letters of the card changes based on the race. There are cases where races are mixed, but generally blood is stronger on one side and those letters are shown on the card. If one goes too overboard with the card, the magic power in the card will disappear faster. In those cases, the guild will replenish the card if necessary.
There are seven sections present in one's adventurer card:
1. Name;
2. Gender;
3. Race;
4. Age;
5. Job;
6. Rank;
7. Party.

Party rules:
1. A party can have up to seven members.
2. Only members within 1 rank above or below of the party leader can join the party.
3. The party rank is decided by the accepted job.
4. The party is averaged based on all party members.
5. On completion of a job, all members of the party will receive equal status.
6. It is possible to take individual jobs while in a party.
7. The party leader and a guild staff member are required to join a party.
8. In order to withdraw only the guild staff member is required.
9. The party leader has authority to forcefully withdraw members.
10. In the event of the death of the leader, the party will automatically be dissolved.
11. It is possible to create a clan with more than two parties.
12. Clans in good standing with the guild will receive a number of privileges.

Known Parties: Counter Arrow, Fangs of the Black Wolf (Disbanded), P Hunter, Rikarisu Gang (Disbanded), 
Stepped Leader, and others.

Jobs: The jobs are done through request cards which varies per continent like for the Demon Continent uses wooden cards while in most Human Adventurer guild like in Millishion the request cards are paper. If the client puts a finger onto it and says a word of "Completed", the request's status will change to "Completed". showing this to the guild, adventurers can exchange it for money. The rewards from F rank jobs are roughly 5 stone coins. E rank jobs are all roughly 1 scrap iron coin. F and E rank jobs are fundamentally all jobs around the town, however, in D rank and above, the number of harvesting jobs increases.
Job Form:
1. The rank of the job;
2. The job;
3. Reward;
4. Job Details;
5. Place;
6. Period;
7. Deadline;
8. Job Owner Name;
9. Notes about the job.

Promotion and Demotion:
1. F > E:
- Clear 10 F rank jobs.
- Clear 5 consecutive E rank jobs.
2. E > D:
- Clear 50 F rank jobs.
- Clear 25 E rank jobs.
- Clear 10 consecutive D rank jobs.
3. D > C:
- Clear 100 E rank jobs.
- Clear 40 D rank jobs.
- Clear 10 C rank jobs.
4. C > B:
- Clear 100 D rank jobs.
- Clear 50 C rank jobs.
- Clear 20 consecutive B rank jobs.
5. B > A:
- Clear 300 C rank jobs.
- Clear 100 B rank jobs.
- Clear 20 A rank jobs.
6. A > S:
- Clear 100 A rank jobs.
- Clear 20 S rank jobs.

Demotion: There is also a rank demotion if one repeatedly fails to clear the jobs. Example:
- Failing 5 consecutive jobs of a lower rank will result in a demotion.
- Failing 10 consecutive jobs of the rank will result in a demotion.
- Failing 5 consecutive jobs of a higher rank will not result in a demotion, but you will not be able to receive higher rank jobs anymore.

Trivia: Delivery quests can be accepted regardless of rank because of the urgency but it's still commonly considered as an E rank request.]

entries.name: Mana
entries.content:
[About Mana: A form of energy that exists in Mushoku Tensei. It is the source of all magic and is comparable to energy. All living beings (human and non-human, including monsters and plants) have mana within their bodies. Mana exists in almost every aspect of the Six-Faced World. Souls normally dissipate into mana after death and can get reincorporated into the environment. The only known exception to this is people from outside the Six-Faced World that have been summoned. Summoned people are incapable of holding mana inside their body, thus incapable of using magic.

Flow: Like blood, Mana circulates throughout the body of every living being. Because of the internal constant Mana flow (which, like Disturb Magic, disrupts the formation of other flows), it is impossible to materialize magic inside the body. Every living being in the Six-Faced World has a similar protection.

Magic: Magic is the manipulation of mana. It can be classified into the following: Attack magic (basic elements), Healing magic (buff/debuff), Summoning. Furthermore, unorthodox magic that is difficult to classify under the three main categories are referred to as unique magic (or original magic in cases of innovation, such as Electric). It should be noted that while magic does seem to follow the law of conservation of energy, it demonstrably doesn't.

Mana Capacity: Mana Capacity refers to the total amount of mana a person can store and utilize for Magic Spells and Battle Aura. It's analogous to the concept of a reservoir holding water, where the larger the reservoir, the more water it can hold and the longer it can sustain the flow. A person with a larger mana capacity can cast more powerful spells or a greater number of weaker spells before exhausting their reserves. This can be a significant advantage in combat situations, allowing one to sustain their attacks or unleash devastating blows.

Mana capacity is not the only factor that determines the effectiveness of a mage. Other aspects like talent, skill, and knowledge can also play a significant role.

Mana or magical power reserve of a person is generally believed to be inherited and the amount one has is determined at birth. Due to the existence of individuals with the Laplace Factor having enormous amounts of aggregate mana that increased since their birth, they were considered to be the only exception. However, it is possible that this is incorrect and has nothing to do with the Laplace factor, and that all people are capable of increasing their total amount of mana by stimulating it from an early age. The ability to learn silent spell-casting is also linked to practicing the skill at a young age, only the best and talented mages possess this skill perfectly, and the rest/majority do not bother and use the usual way - incantations and magic circles.]

entries.name: Magic
entries.content:
[Magic: Magic refers to the manipulation of mana stored in the body to generate supernatural effects known as Magic Spells.

History: Long before the Great Human-Demon War, the world was engulfed in an unceasing spiral of battle and chaos. During that time, in order to fight their enemies the High Elves race entreated with the spirits of the forests to control natural inorganic elements like the wind and the earth. In this manner, the first magic spells were born. Modern form of magic took its form from humans imitating the spells used by the High Elves in battle and reworking them to convenience. Magic was mostly used only in battle and fending off obstacles. As a result, a large portion of the spells that came to exist are combat spells.

Mechanisms of magic:
1. Conventional Spell-casting:
- Incantations - In this method, one recites a set of words to cast a spell. Incantation acts as an activation trigger for spells, where uttering the words would create the effect without having to focus on the Mana coursing through one's body. As such, incantations are much less flexible than silent spell-casting due to a restricted amount of control one has while tuning the magic.
Incantations are the common method for casting spells as it is relatively easy to use. A magician typically uses incantations from when they were a beginner all the way to when they became a master.
Some examples of Incantations:
Healing - "Divine power is rich and nourishing. It offers the strength to rise again to those who have lost their strength. Healing.";
Fireball - "Let the great protection of fire be on the place thou seekest. I call the bold heat of a torch here and now. Fireball!".
- Magic Circles - Invented by Demon Empress Kirisis Calisis, this method involves one inscribing patterns using a specialized ink or carved patterns to cast a spell. Magic circles cast the inscribed spell at a predetermined power whenever mana is poured into it. Because of this, magic circles have the least flexibility of all spell-casting methods, albeit being the easiest and fastest to use.
Depending on the kind of Magic and rank, a Magic Circle's can be larger but its work around is to create multiple layers of Magic Circles on a single plane to achieve a single spell.
Earlier, magic circles were widely used until one magician succeeded at greatly shortening incantations. But for the more complex rituals involved in Summoning magic, where greater efficiency wasn't attainable, magic circles remained the primary means.
- Mixed Magic (aka Combined Magic) - Is magic where the caster uses consecutive spells to alter or enhance the effects of a single spell. Spells such as Dry Steaming (Wind and Fire) and Frost Nova (Wind and Water/Ice) are examples of melded magic. Melded magic is exclusive to attack magic; these are familiar and easy to piece together with basic knowledge of science.
2. Truncated Spell-casting: Truncated or shortened incantations are very similar to conventional spell-casting; the caster recites a predetermined set of words corresponding the magic they are using. With shortened incantations cast times and flexibility are drastically improved over conventional casting. The casting of melded magic also becomes much easier due to the reduced downtime between incantations.
3. Silent Spell-casting: Silent spell-casting or Incantation-less spell-casting involves the caster manipulating mana itself in order to produce the desired effect. This method, unlike incantation and magic circles, does not require preparation for invocation as the caster only needs strong imaginative power to mold mana to their will.
It follows a process the caster calculates in their mind: First, the caster calls forth the shape of the spell they wish to use. Next, there is a window of time where they can add additional magical power to impact its size. Third, the velocity of the spell with which it will travel is adjusted. Finally, the caster releases the finished spell from their hand.
Silent spell-casting is a particularly unorthodox method of performing magic for almost no mages are able to completely skip the incantation. Since the process is convoluted and relies heavily on the caster's understanding of the spell, this method of spell-casting is not formally taught anywhere. Though even the most accomplished mages are not capable of this feat, it has been conjectured that this method can be taught during childhood as young minds are more flexible to pre-determined concepts of magic.

Types of Magic (Main and Special):
Main Category:
1. Attacking Magic - Is comprised of spells that manipulate mana into tangible elements. The power, speed, effective range, and area of these spells are dependent on the amount of mana poured into them.
It is divided into four schools:
- Fire: Generate fire/heat.
- Water: Generates water and in extension, ice and steam (melded with fire magic).
- Wind: Manipulates gases.
- Earth: Generates earth, Manipulates earth and minerals.
2. Healing Magic - Mainly comprises of spells used for healing injuries and removing toxins.
It is further divided into four schools:
- Healing: Magic for healing injuries.
- Detoxification: Magic for purging poisons and disease.
- Divine Strike: Magic used against incorporeal monsters and demons.
- Protection: Magic for increasing one's defenses and create barriers (distorts mana in a finite space. Effects include nullifying magic activation and altering magic regeneration rate).
3. Summoning Magic - Is used to call forth powerful beings to carry out the summoners's bidding.
It has two types of summons:
- Fiends: A class of beast that have intellect.
- Spirits: An intelligent being called forth to reside in an artificial body, has been stated by Rudeus to be much akin to Mana Programming.

Special Category:
1. Inherent Magic - Is a magic of race secret with a special activation method. Examples:
- Howling or "voice magic";
- Teleport;
- Gravity Manipulation;
- Time Travel;
- Hypnosis;
- Magic Disruption (Ran Ma);
- Reincarnation;
- Divination;
- Temporary Soul Summoning (Used only by Hitogami).

Trivia: The number of mages able to use shortened or silent spell-casting is very few, as this method is currently unknown.]

entries.name: Battle Aura
entries.content:
[About Battle Aura, aka "Fighting Spirit": A technique used to amplify physical capabilities of the individual to the extreme.
Battle Aura, in essence, is a form of Mana manipulation, but different from the flashy effects of Magic invocation as it is invisible to the naked eye. It is specifically used as a technique to explosively boost physical power and physical defense. It involves coating the whole body or a specific body part in Mana and forming a mantle of dense energy.
It does not have a specific training regime, an individual will naturally come to understand how to wear "Fighting Spirit" the more they train their body.
All swordsmen and fighters at or above Saint-class are able to wear Battle Aura. Some use it subconsciously as to why they cannot explain their impermanent outbursts of strength during battle.
Demon God Laplace was one who was unable to wear Battle Aura.
Most of those born with the Laplace Factor are inherently unable to wear Battle Aura, and it tends to be weak even for those who can, but there are very rare exceptions.

Employment:
1. Offense: Battle Aura is typically used by all swordsmen. Wearing Battle Aura is woven into the art of swordsmanship, it worked to improve one's physical prowess and strengthening the blade of the sword itself. Swordsmen whose Battle Aura has been fully developed are able to cleave boulders in a single stroke, or unleash a flash of the blade to strike a distant foe.
Other than swordsmen, Warriors, Knights, and martial arts practitioners also wear Battle Aura to enhance their weapons' durability and physical attack.
2. Defense: Instinctively, swordsmen and fighters sheathe themselves in a protective veil of Battle Aura around the user's body or a specific body part. When mastered, the veil of Battle Aura can become impenetrable to most physical attacks.
It also greatly elevates one's sense of the battlefield.

Special Type:
1. Dragon Battle Aura: Dragon Battle Aura, aka "Dragon Fighting Spirit" - is taught by the First Dragon God during the time when the Dragon Tribe were struggling in the Dragon World against the larger dragon predators which allows its user to multiply their physical abilities many-folds and harden their skin, that is strong enough to pierce the toughest dragon's hide in 1 blow. Although the power itself is possessed by other races, the Dragon Battle Aura is far superior to the others which allows the Dragon Tribe to be the most powerful in the Dragon World.
2. Saint Dragon Battle Aura: Saint Dragon Battle Aura, aka "Dragon Saint Fighting Spirit" - is the greatest combat technique of the Dragon Tribe created by the Dragon God Urupen.
It is a style that uses relatively less Mana, and boasts an overwhelming defensive power that only attacks of very high caliber are able to leave an effect on the user.]

entries.name: Magic Tools
entries.content:
[Magic Tools: Magic Tools are specially crafted equipment that feature a carved magic circle. When a user channels their mana through the tool and recites an incantation, the magic circle activates, unleashing the desired magical effect. As long as the user has remaining Mana, the magic tool can be used repeatedly. Magic Items, on the other hand, are objects infused with mana that possess unique and specific abilities. By performing a specific action or trigger, the user can activate the item's magical effect. Magic Items have a limited number of uses per day, but their mana reserves naturally replenish over time.

Aside from the direct use of Magic, Magic Tools and Magic Items are developed and manufactured by the Magician Guild in Sharia to aid people in adventures or even their everyday life.

List of Magic Tools:
- Devil Spear - A Trident weapon made by Laplace as a gift for the Superd race, have a high resemblance with the Superd spear excluding his jet black color, this magic tool amplified their bearers’ physical capabilities several times over, nullified the effects of the humans’ magic, and heightened the Superds’ already sharp senses even further, but slowly erodes the mind of his user. (Owner: Superd Tribe, Ruijerd in the past).
- Lithograph Stone - Based off of the seven powers stone created by Technique God, Orsted created a stone that would allow long range communication through writing on the Large Stone. Anything written on the main stone will appear on the sub-stones. Having a main and a sub-stone for the other person's main stone, will allow for long range communication. (Owners: Orsted).
- Enchanted Shoes - Shoes that allow the user to run at twice its normal speed. (Owners: Luke Notos Greyrat).
- Flame Trapping Cloak - A cloak that helps the user maintain a constant body temperature. (Owners: Luke Notos Greyrat).
- Gloves of Overpowering - Gloves that reduce any impact to the palm of the wearer's hand by half. (Owners: Luke Notos Greyrat).
- Magical Sunglasses - A pair of sunglasses that aids in the detection of enemies.
- Steel-Cutting Sword - A sword that can easily tear straight through steel. (Owners: Luke Notos Greyrat, Paul Greyrat).
- Snow Melting Furnace - Snow Melting Furnaces are seen at the cities of the Magic Triumvirate in the Northern Central Continent and are used during the winter. During snowy days, the citizen's daily activities are at a halt so the city posts a job request open to all citizens or Adventurers regardless of rank to gather snow around the city and bring them to the entrance of a park sized plaza where the furnace is located. The snow is then piled up to form a huge donut shape hill surrounding the furnace where a magician pours Mana to the furnace which activates the Magic Circle around the furnace that heats then melts the snow gathered. The more mana is poured to the device, the more snow it melts. (Owners: Magic Triumvirate).
- Magic Wand - The wands are use to channel magic more easy, increasing the efficiency of the magic casted, his rank is determined by the wood and the Magic rock.
- Magic Tower - Millishion has erected 7 Magic Towers that forms a circle around the city which prevent floods from occurring by keeping the water of the lake at a fixed level which was a problem in the city until the towers were built especially during the rainy season.
