[Luke Notos Greyrat: Luke Notos Greyrat is Rudeus' cousin and the personal knight to princess Ariel Anemoi Asura. Despite being connected to such major characters, he himself only has a minor supporting role; a womanizer and mediocre knight.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K404.
Relatives: Pilemon Notos Greyrat (Father), Paul Greyrat (Uncle), Zenith Greyrat (Aunt), Rudeus Greyrat (Cousin), Eris Greyrat (Cousin), Ariel Anemoi Asura (Princess, may become an unofficial lover in the future).
Affiliation: Asura Kingdom, Ranoa Magic Academy, Princess Ariel Faction.
Occupation: Guardian Knight, Student, Asura Kingdom Knight.

Appearance: Luke is tall, well-built and extremely good looking. He has brown hair and wears it in a combed back style. A standard Ikemen, or cool handsome guy.

Personality: Luke is a playboy and, like the rest of the Notos Greyrat family, has a fetish for large boobs. Although he plays around with most girls, he treats his liege, Ariel Anemoi Asura with utmost reverence, with her safety and well-being as his top priority.

Background: Luke was born into the Notos Greyrat family as an Asura Kingdom high noble. He was tasked at a very young age into the appointment of being the Guardian Knight of second princess Ariel Anemoi Asura alongside Derrick Redbat.

Power and Abilities: Despite being Princess Ariel's guard, Luke's skills are stated to be mediocre. However, he makes up for it with sheer loyalty, not hesitating to sacrifice his own life for his liege.
Sword Techniques:
- Intermediate-ranked Sword-God Style;
- Elementary-ranked Water-God Style.

Equipment:
- Steel-Cutting Sword - A sword that can easily tear straight through steel.
- Enchanted Shoes - Shoes that allow the user to run at twice its normal speed.
- Flame Trapping Cloak - A cloak that helps the user maintain a constant body temperature.
- Gloves of Overpowering - Gloves that reduce any impact to the palm of the wearer's hand by half.
- Reinforced Undertunic - Made of material that is resistant to blades.

Trivia:
- In the future, when Luke meets Eris for the first time at Eris's 10th anniversary ball, he falls in love, though it's unlikely to be mutual.
- In the future, around the age of 15, will enter Ranoa Magic Academy along with Princess Ariel Anemoi Asura.]

entries.name: Ariel Anemoi Asura
entries.content:
[Ariel Anemoi Asura: Ariel is the second princess of the Asura Kingdom.

Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K405.
Relatives: Grabell Zafin Asura (Older Half-brother), Luke Notos Greyrat (Bodyguard, may become an unofficial lover in the future).
Affiliation: Ranoa Magic Academy, Asura Kingdom, Second Princess Faction.
Occupation: Student, Student Council President.

Appearance: Ariel has long blonde hair with blue eyes and a very attractive face. She is of average height, has a pale complexion and moderate-sized bust. She is regarded as the most beautiful princess ever lived.

Personality: Ariel is manipulative, sadistic/masochistic and a charismatic person who tries her best to create an image of a leader in order to obtain the throne.
In front of nobles and the connections that she needed to ascend the throne, she seldom says selfish things and always knows how to be politically correct, even when she was young.
She is a pervert, as most of Asura's nobles.

Background: As 2nd princess and 3rd in line for the throne, Ariel's childhood was flooded with assassination attempts, and at one point Lilia managed to save her from one of those assassination attempts, Ariel started to become sadistic and tends to release those sadistic urges by beating and or torturing her subordinate. Ariel would spend her time on the "White Lily Garden" and talk about their conquest and other indulgences with Luke while Derrick Redbat would lecture her about kingship and persistently urge her to become queen of Asura, much to her annoyance.

Power and Abilities: In the future, when she enters the academy, she will be fascinated with melding magic. In Ranoa, this subject was considered difficult. For the sake of her charisma, she will maintain good grades.

Equipment:
- Illusionary Ring - A magic tool that allows the user to take the shape of another, This magic tool took the form of two rings: a green ring, and a red ring. The person wearing the green ring would become identical in facial features and hair color to the person wearing the red ring, this magic tool don't change, height, build, voice, and the eyes colors. This magical tool was meant to be worn by a body double of the kingdom of Asura, but usually Ariel used it to take the form of someone else to freely walk around Asura or Sharia. This magic tool was a secret treasure passed down in the Asura Kingdom family from generation to generation.

Trivia:
- Her middle name, Anemoi, is the name of a group of Greek wind deities, each of whom were named after a direction. Furthermore, the 4 main families of Asura (Boreas, Notus, Zephyrus and Eurus) all have names derived from members of the Anemoi.
- Has a masochistic side.
- Can become aroused by unexpected public embarrassment.
- At about age 15, he will enter Ranoa Academy.]

entries.name: Kaunis Freean Asura
entries.content:
[Kaunis Freean Asura: Kaunis Freean Asura is a king of Asura Kingdom after the Laplace Campaign.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: 20-40 years before K0.
Status: Deceased.
Affiliation: Asura Kingdom.

Personality: Perugius describe him as a not-great man, a coward, who hated fighting, and was always on the run. He was bad at studying, had not an ounce of martial talent, and was always sneaking out to the city to get drunk and ogle bar wretches. However, Perugius respected him because even though he didn't have the ambition to become king, he had the most important factor to become one.

Background: He was the third prince of Asura, after the death of his family during the Laplace War, he became the heir to the Asuran throne and later became the king after the wars end. He was a great king and gave direction to the war-torn kingdom of Asura, allowing it to become the sole kingdom to rule the western half of the Central Continent. He was the reason why Asura was spared internal turmoil postwar.

Trivia:
- He is one of the four friends that Perugius Dola had during the Laplace Campaign.
- He is the only Asuran King to receive Perugius's backing for now.]

entries.name: Grabell Zafin Asura
entries.content:
[Grabell Zafin Asura: Grabell Zafin Asura is the First Prince of Asura Kingdom and half-brother of Ariel Anemoi Asura.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K38X.
Relatives: Ariel Anemoi Asura (Younger Half-Sister).
Affiliation: First Prince Faction.
Occupation: First Prince of Asura.

Appearance: Blond with blue eyes, stern look, short neat hairstyle with slicked back hair.

Personality: Grabell comes off as being very snobbish. He desires the throne and is not above assassination to get it. He has shown himself to be talented in politics and exercising his authority, being able to see through others' schemes and exploit weaknesses. However, because of his meticulous nature, he is deeply concerned about unknown variables.]

entries.name: Darius Silva Ganius
entries.content:
[Darius Silva Ganius: Darius Silva Ganius is the Prime Minister of the Asura Kingdom.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K36X.
Affiliation: First Prince Faction.
Occupation: Prime Minister of Asura.

Appearance: Darius is a fat and bald old man that wears wealthy clothes.

Personality: A vile man who does whatever he can to gain power and satisfy his desires. He regularly kidnaps young noble women and used them as his sex slaves and toys, selling them as soon as he was done with them. He also had no problem ordering people to kill others if he thought it was beneficial to himself.

Background: He was a big supporter of the first prince of the Asura Kingdom, Grabel Zafin Asura, and would do everything in his power to coerce others to his side to give Grabel the best chances of becoming King, even if he did not deserve the throne.

Power and Abilities: He can use fire magic, including the fire spell fireball.]

entries.name: Therese Latreia
entries.content:
[Therese Latreia: Therese Latreia is the sister of Zenith Greyrat and the aunt of Rudeus Greyrat. She is the fourth daughter of Claire Latreia and Carlyte Latreia.

Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K39X.
Relatives: Carlyte Latreia (Father), Claire Latreia (Mother), Ralkan Latreia (Grandfather), Edgar Latreia (Eldest Brother), Anise Latrea (Eldest Sister), Zenith Greyrat (Second Elder Sister), Paul Greyrat (Brother-In-Law), Rudeus Greyrat (Nephew).
Affiliation: Millishion, Milis Religion.
Occupation: Knight.

Appearance: Therese bears a striking resemblance to her sister Zenith, so much so that it's possible to confuse them upon first meeting, but Teresa's hair and the location of her mole are different from Zenith's.

Personality: She is a devout believer of the Milis Religion and is a knight of the Order of the Temple. Although she is part of the Cardinal Faction, she does not hate the Demon Race and is relatively tolerant to them. She is relatively easygoing and cheerful, often playing the role of a doting aunt towards Rudeus. She had unwavering loyalty towards Milis, not even hesitating to strike against her own family as long as the order was given. She is strong willed and holds her own beliefs, not afraid to speak up or take a stand against those that say otherwise.

Background: She was raised under the strict upbringing by Claire Latreia who was very disappointed that Zenith ran away, often expected to excel at various places. To meet her mother's expectation towards her, she had excelled in both academics and etiquette. Despite her mother's strong opposition, she went on to being a Temple Knight although her mother thought women were unfit for such roles.

Equipment:
- Order of the Temple Armor - When on duty as an Order of the Temple Knight, Therese wears a blue plate armor and helm, with a white cape and uses a double edge sword.
- Horse - The Order of the Temple also provides a horse covered by a blue caparison that has their emblem engraved on it. The horse is also trained to immediately go to Therese when she whistles.
- Therese can use magic.

Trivia:
- She is not married and is very sensitive about it.]

entries.name: Claire Latreia
entries.content:
[Claire Latreia: Claire Latreia is the mother of Zenith and Therese, as well as the grandmother of Rudeus.

Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K37X.
Relatives: Therese Latreia (Daughter), Rudeus Greyrat (Grandson), Zenith Greyrat (Daughter), Paul Greyrat (Son-in-law), Carlisle Latreia (Husband), Edgar Latreia (Son), Anise Latreia (Daughter), Ralkan Latreia (Father), Melody Latreia (Mother), Saula Latreia (Daughter).
Affiliation: Milis Kingdom, Milis Religion, Demon Race Expulsion Faction.
Occupation: Noble.

Appearance: Claire is an older woman with white hair in a bun and piercing eyes. She wears a purple dress with a darker purple cravat.

Personality: She's strict and hard headed. She was stubborn from the moment she was born, the house's education raised her to be a person strict with both herself and others; once she decides something, she will never yield and will keep the same opinion until the day she dies. However, when something happens which proves her wrong without a doubt she will revise her opinion, she will not admit to being wrong nor will she offer apologies, but she will at least not make the same mistakes in future.
She likes people that are fair and righteous and hates crimes. In conclusion, she's a genuinely good human being who is just too stubborn to hear out other people and faults frequently because of it.

Background: She was just a regular noblewoman you can find anywhere and has high expectations for her children as a result, she was delighted when her oldest son and daughter turned out to be a knight and a noble young lady who married into a good house. However, when her daughter Therese became a knight, she criticized that this was not a good job for a lady. When Zenith, her most promising child, became an adventurer she felt betrayed and scornful. In both cases, she was adamant her daughters would one day realize their mistakes and come home, but Therese became a high ranking knight and guard of the Miko herself, while Zenith became a successful adventurer and did not show any intent to return. She hates Paul Greyrat and most likely Rudeus because he will resemble Paul's appearance.]

entries.name: Edgar Latreia
entries.content:
[Edgar Latreia: Edgar Latreia is the eldest child of Claire Latreia, brother of Zenith and uncle of Rudeus. He is a Temple Knight.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K38X.
Relatives: Melody Latreia (Grandmother), Ralkan Latreia (Grandfather), Claire Latreia (Mother), Carlisle (Father), Anise Latrea (Sister), Zenith Greyrat (Sister), Therese Latreia (Sister), Saula Latreia (Sister), Paul Greyrat (Brother-in-Law), Rudeus Greyrat (Nephew).
Affiliation: Temple Knights.
Occupation: Temple Knight.]

entries.name: Tristina Purplehorse
entries.content:
[Tristina Purplehorse: Tristina Purplehorse is a daughter of the Purplehorse House, a noble family in the Asura Kingdom and was sold to Darius as a slave when she was a child. Eventually she was sold to the bandits and became the leader's mistress under the alias Tris.

Nickname: Tris.
Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K40X.
Relatives: Freitas Purplehorse (Father).
Affiliation: Purplehorse House.
Occupation: Sex Slave, Thief and smuggler (In the future, after the teleport incident).

Personality: Even though Tristina was born as a noble, she became aggressive and vulgar like her fellow bandits, while having an indifferent attitude towards the events that happened in her life. However, she didn't forget her relationship with Ariel and kneels down before her on their reunion. She was also capable of performing in refined noble etiquette when necessary.

Background: Tristina is the daughter of the Purplehorse house. She first met then Princess Ariel Anemoi Asura on her five year old birthday party. When she was 8 years old she was kidnapped by the Minister of Asura Darius and forced to become her sex slave.

In future: However, after Teleport Incident, Darius sold most of his slaves, including Tristina, who was sold to the thieves group. She later managed to obtain her freedom, but remained a thief known as Tina Tris.

Power and Abilities (in future):
- Thief - Tristina is trained as a thief during her time with the bandits group thus making it her business of knowing the names and appearance of dangerous people. During their journey to the Asura Kingdom's capital, Tristina also gathers information on the the location of Darius’s private army and movements of Auber Corvette at Ariel's request. The bandits group handles jobs that include information gathering, smuggling, search requests, slave trades and assassination requests. To make a job request with the thieves group, one must enter their territory in a forest in the border of the Asura Kingdom and communicate with passwords for the corresponding request otherwise they operate as highwaymen on those trespassing their territory.
- Smuggler - Tristina is also trained as a smuggler. As such, she has knowledge of uncharted roads throughout the Asura Kingdom without the need to pass checkpoints and has contacts with all the hideouts to house their goods being slaves or otherwise.

Equipment:
- Purplehorse Ring - A ring with a beautiful amethyst gem. On the amethyst, there is an engraved horse and is used for someone from the Purplehorse House to prove kinship.]

entries.name: Zanoba Shirone
entries.content:
[Zanoba Shirone: Zanoba Shirone is the former third prince and a blessed child of the Shirone Kingdom. Nurturing an abnormal passion for figurines and intrigued by crafting skills, will enroll in Ranoa Magic Academy in the future.

Nickname: Head Ripping Prince.
Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K397.
Relatives: Pax Shirone (Half-Younger Brother), Julius (Younger Brother, dead), Minerva (Mother), Zanoba's Wife (Wife, dead).

Affiliation: Shirone Kingdom, Ranoa Magic Academy (in future).
Occupation: Prince, Student (in future).

Appearance: He is a tall, thin, oval-faced man, with his cheekbones clearly visible. He wears round glasses. He also sports a bowl cut hairstyle.

Personality: Zanoba appeared as an impulsive and boisterous man-child who's deeply obsessed in dolls and figures, to the point that he has no qualms in killing people or trading his loyal subordinates for a figurine. Contrary to his comical appearance, he is highly intelligent and observant, but as his monstrous strength causes him to be alienated by others, he doesn't often have the chance to display these skills. Due to his intellectual level, he often conducts research and creates several inventions. He is also well versed in arts and crafts. Zanoba harbors a deep patriotism for his country and a fondness of warfare, but often tries to hide these traits from others. He is a highly proficient military commander, capable of rallying soldiers and planning effective tactics against tremendous odds.
Most likely, his patriotism, fascination with war, and love for his younger brother Pax are simple attempts to behave in a more human way. Even though he does not fully understand such emotions, he feels like they are the right ones to act on.

Background: Born as the Third Prince of Shirone. When he was three years old, he accidentally killed his brother Julius, the Fourth Prince. When he was 15 years old, he also killed his wife by accident.

Power and Abilities:
- Magic - Earth Magic, Intermediate.
- Miko Power - Even at a young age, Zanoba is abnormally strong, capable of standing off against a demon king as far as raw strength goes. Any hit from Zanoba is potentially fatal even with Battle Aura. This power does not include stamina, however, as Zanoba is described to be unfit for long travels. Because of this, his older brothers are afraid of him and sees him as a bomb that could go off anytime so they propose to exile him.]

entries.name: Pax Shirone
entries.content:
[Pax Shirone: Pax Shirone is Zanoba Shirone's younger brother and Roxy's student in future. The seventh prince of the kingdom of Shiron.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K402.
Relatives: Zanoba Shirone (Half-Brother).
Affiliation: Shirone Kingdom.
Occupation: Prince.

Appearance: Quite round, short, and with short limbs, you could say he looks like a hobbit and a dwarf put together.

Personality: He's a spoiled, rude and violent man. He could also be described as a sexual maniac, constantly forcing himself on the girls he has power over. A sadist for not considering human life, as he holds all the families of his servants hostage. In fact, his vile personality stems from a deep-seated inferiority complex that developed when he failed to earn Roxy's approval. Desperate to get Roxy's attention, he began committing increasingly serious pranks and crimes, which further alienated Roxy, forming a vicious cycle.

Background: Pax Shirone is the Seventh Prince of Shirone Kingdom. Due to his position, it is difficult for him to become king, so not many people pay attention to him. For this reason, he manipulates people who do not want to take his side with threats.

Power and Abilities: Intermediate Rank Water Magic (In the future, thanks to Roxy).]

entries.name: Sylphiette
entries.content:
[Sylphiette: Sylphiette is a girl who was born in the Buena village, Fittoa region, land of Asura Kingdom. She lives with her parents, mom Arna and dad Laws. Sylphy is of mixed race, she is an elf-human-beast hybrid. Children in the village often make fun of her because of the color of her hair.

Nickname: Sylphy.
Race: Elf/Human/Beast Hybrid.
Birth: K407.
Gender: Female.
Hair Color: Green.
Eye Color: Red.
Family (Live with them in village): Rudeus Greyrat (friend), Laws (Father), Arna (Mother).
Relatives: Elinalise Dragonroad (Grandmother).

Appearance: She had short green hair and elfish ears. Her tomboyish appearance at first might make you think she's a boy.

Personality: Due to constant bullying, Sylphiette is very shy and meek, and is also gentle and accommodating, but can be jealous. Sylphy can be very dependent on the person she falls in love with, but also willing to become strong and skillful to help her lover in any way she can. Sylphy is sensitive, empathetic and very kind to others.

Background: Sylphiette is the only child of Laws and Arna. Her father, Laws, is a half-blood elf who works as a hunter and also protects the village. Her mother, Arna, is the housekeeper. Sylphiette is constantly mocked for being a hybrid and having emerald green hair because it's the same as the Superd tribe, even though she's not from that tribe. It's just that most people in this world believe the stereotype that all Supers are evil, parents scare kids with stories about them, etc. Her parents try to protect her: her mother cut off her hair and made it short like a boy's, and she sewed her pants to make it easier for her to run away from the bullies, and her father asked the parents of the child bullies to stop bullying their daughter, but to no avail.

Trivia:
- May learn Voiceless Incantation in the future if someone helps her with it.
- Sylphiette's green hair is a result of her having the Laplace Factor in her, which grants her aptitude towards all forms of magic and a large amount of magic power.
- Sylphy ages slower than regular humans due to her 1/4 elven blood.
- Sylphy has very low tolerance in alcohol.
- Sylphy is submissive in bed, she accepts everything unconditionally, even if it is something very shameful, she will do it.]

entries.name: Laws
entries.content:
[Laws: Laws is a hunter from Buena Village. The village is located in the Fittoa region, lands of the Asura Kingdom. Laws is the father of Sylphiette and the son of Elinalise Dragonroad. He is not only a hunter, but also one of the village defenders and a good friend of Paul, the local knight. Laws loves his daughter, Sylphiette, and his wife, Arna. Laws is a half-blood elf, half-human, and half-elf.

Race: half-elf, half-human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K3XX.
Family (lives with them in the village): Sylphiette (Daughter), Arna (Wife).
Other relatives: Elinalise Dragonroad (Mother).
Affiliation: Buena Village.
Occupation: Hunter.

Appearance: As a half-elf, he has pointed elf ears, but they are shorter than his daughter's, Sylphy. Laws has short blond hair and red eyes. His face is quite attractive, but simple at the same time. He has no stubble or beard, which makes Laws look very young for his age, as if he were about 18 years old.

Personality: As a father, Laws was deeply concerned with his daughter that was constantly bullied. He is good-natured, calm and a good man who takes care of his family and friends. Laws is a good partner, together with his friend Paul and other defenders of the village, they sometimes have to clear the local forest, killing monsters.

Power and Abilities: Laws is an experienced hunter who often assists Paul Greyrat in exterminating monsters around the village.]

entries.name: Arna
entries.content:
[Arna: Arna is a girl of the Beastmen race. She was probably born in the Great Forest. She now lives in Buena Village, located in the Fittoa Region of the Asura Kingdom. Arna lives with her husband, Laws, and their daughter, Sylphy.

Race: Beast Race.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K38X.
Family (lives with them in the village): Sylphiette (Daughter), Laws (Husband).
Affiliation: Buena Village.

Appearance: Arna looks like a cute and ordinary girl with long brown hair. She has red eyes, a trait common to all members of the Beastmen race. Arna belongs to the wolf side of the beastmen race, Adoldia, so she has dog-like features on her ears and tail.

Personality: Arna is very much like a wolf; she is calm and cold-blooded, thinking through her actions. At the same time, Arna is very kind to her friends and family. She loves and cares for her husband, Laws, and her daughter, Sylphiette.

Trivia:
- Considering she's from the beast race, it's not easy for her husband, Laws, during her heat.]

entries.name: Elinalise Dragonroad
entries.content:
[Elinalise Dragonroad: Elinalise Dragonroadis a former member of Paul's party, cursed with an affliction that forces her to regularly have sexual intercourse.

Nickname: Lize.
Race: Elf.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K20X.
Height: 162cm.
Relatives: Laws (Son), Sylphiette Greyrat (Granddaughter).
Party: Fangs of the Black Wolf (Disbanded).
Acquaintances and friends: Zenith Greyrat, Paul Greyrat, Ghislaine Dedoldia, Talhand, Geese Nukadia.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: S «Adventure Guild».

Appearance: Like many of her race, Elinalise is shown to be a beautiful and youthful-looking elf of 200+ years. She often sports white-blonde hair in heavily defined ringlets. In body, she has a curvy figure with small breasts, wide hips and shapely legs. Her eyes are a light reddish-brown and she sported the signature pointy ears, customary of all elf kind. She sported black shorts and frilled stockings that ran up to the mid-thigh. In addition to this, she wore gold-colored bands around her forearms and her top was of a small red and white corset and is always seen in her battle attire with her Estoc and Buckler.

Personality: Elinalise is erotic, lustful, and carefree. She does however possess somewhat of a maiden's heart. Maybe deep down, she would be happy to be rid of the curse and love for real.

Background: She was found over 200 years ago in a Magic Crystal inside of a Labyrinth by Perugius. She had no memory of who she was. She was taken to a Elf town where she would eventually recover and get married. As a side effect of being in a Magic Crystal, she became cursed to need sex. The sperm of the men would fertilize the Magic Crystals inside of her. She would then give those crystals to her husband to sell. One day, while leaving the village to sell the crystals, he was robbed and killed. Five days later, she started attacking men who didn't mind having sex with her. After doing this a few times, the women of the village kicked her out. She worked as a prostitute for a while until then she became an adventurer.
She joined Paul's party Fangs of the Black Wolf as a warrior. Following the departure of Paul and Zenith from the party, the group was then disbanded.

Power and Abilities:
- An experienced adventurer. Though her strength can't be called high, only compared to people like Ghislaine or Zanoba, her strength is certainly in line with her S-class rank. She could "go solo" as an adventurer if she wanted to. She has good aggression and makes up for her lack of strength with magical items, such as the estoc, which releases vacuum blades, or the gladius she picked up in Lapan, which releases shockwaves. She is also very agile.
- Magic: Elinalise had to repeat her 3rd year because the Begaritt Labyrinth incident took her away for 6 months. She drops out after getting pregnant. Since the first two years of the Ranoa's curriculum teach elementary magic in the four types of offensive magic plus detoxification and healing, it can be presumed that she is able to do at least that.
- Curse of Promiscuity: Elinalise is afflicted by a curse that causes her to be highly sexually active to the point of being a dangerous sex beast and will cause death if not sexually sated. This uses sperm to transform naturally accumulating magic power in her body into a magic crystal.

Equipment:
1. Estoc - Elinalise wields a thorn-like Estoc, a silver double edge straight sword with a thin blade that she uses elegant techniques matching her extravagant appearance. An Estoc is not a weapon an adventurer normally carries since it is used in duels between nobles of the Asura Kingdom or used with armor in the sword city in the far north. But the Estoc that Elinalise uses is a Magic Item that was found deep within a maze which is far sturdier than normal swords and with a single swing, it can fire off a vacuum that can cut down a tree several meters ahead.
2. Buckler - Elinalise also uses a brown buckler with a silver cross which is also a magic item that holds the ability to soften the impact of blows it receives which makes Elinalise a formidable frontliner of her party to distract enemies.
3. Gladius - Because of her Estoc being inconvenient against armored monsters in the Teleportation Labyrinth, Elinalise purchased a one handed Gladius, another Magic Item that releases a Shock Wave when it pierces something. Although the damage is not high, it can be used in an instant to send an opponent flying backwards to make some distance. Because of the ability's practical use it has a high purchase price that Elinalise paid with several magic crystals.

Achievements: Attains Rank S Adventurer.

Trivia:
- It was previously observed that she carries a lot of magic crystals and by trading and selling them, she seems to never run into any financial problems. This is probably due to her curse by which she transforms sperm into magic crystals.
- She laments about her past as a prostitute and promiscuousness as she believes that this may affect the opinion of others about her descendants (Sylphy) and that's why she tries to hide any relationship with them.
- It is implied that her true identity might be Laplace's servant Rostelina, who was sealed in a magic crystal to condition her into a vessel that could resupply Orsted with mana.
- Currently single.]

entries.name: Geese Nukadia
entries.content:
[Geese Nukadia: Geese is an adventurer and was a member of Paul and Zenith Greyrat's former party. Geese is Hitogami's apostle, but that's a big secret. He has his own set of beliefs and are often called Jinx.

Race: Demon Race.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K3XX.
Age: Unknown.
Party: «Fangs of the Black Wolf» (Disbanded).
Acquaintances and friends: Zenith Greyrat, Paul Greyrat, Elinalise Dragonroad, Ghislaine Dedoldia, Talhand.
Occupation: Adventurer (Thief), Apostle of Hitogami (Secret).
Rank: S «Adventure Guild».

Appearance: Geese is a Demon Race with described to have monkey-like facial features. He is lean and somewhat muscular. Outwardly, he looks like a simple man, male, with monkey-like features of appearance, such as slightly large ears and a funny face.

Personality: A man of good-nature but is also manipulative, deceptive, easy going, and quite adaptive. Hard working and earnest to the point of placing himself in prison in order to take care of someone inside. Live his life following his rule of Jinx.

Background: Geese is the last survivor of the Demon Race Nuka Tribe, which was wiped out due to Hitogami's schemes. He is also a member of the party, Fangs of the Black Wolf, the same party that Paul, Zenith, Tallhand, Elinalise, and Ghislaine were all a part of. He served as the thief and jack of all trades in the party, avoiding traps in the dungeon and cooking are but some of his contributions to the party. He lives his life by his code which he calls Jinx as it was the reason how he survived so many dangerous situations since he was a child. After teaching Zenith how to cook, he swore to never teach anyone how to cook anymore since that was what eventually lead to the dissolution of their party.

Power and Abilities: As a thief, he can do mapping, establish the proper directions to advance in a dungeon, manage food supplies, and sort raw materials. He has the judgement necessary to decide whether to withdraw from a labyrinth as well. He has the ability to do numerous odd jobs in as a reader. He is able to make money by gambling, when in a pinch. He is also a great chef, but does not like to teach others how to cook due to his previous student Zenith marrying Paul soon after, causing the Party to disband.

Achievements: He reached S-Rank as an adventurer, an impressive feat considering that he has almost zero combat capabilities.]

entries.name: Talhand
entries.content:
[Talhand, aka Talhand The Clifftop: Talhand is a short rugged dwarf magician used to be in Paul Greyrat's party before Rudeus was born.

Race: Dwarf.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K36X.
Party: «Fang of the Black Wolf» (Disbanded).
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: S «Adventure Guild».

Appearance: Like all dwarfs, Talhand is short compared to other races. He also has a long orange beard that reaches below his waist that are split in two by dark bracers. He is always seen clad in dark armor, gauntlets and helmet with a white robe underneath his armor.

Personality: While Talhand shares similarity with all dwarves that likes rock and iron, alcohol and admiration for blacksmiths and builders, he is considered a maverick among dwarves due to his unconventional thinking and stubbornness. He learned water and wind magic that are frowned upon by dwarves, and refused to conform to the traditional dwarven mindset of blacksmithing and crafting but he is very devoted towards people he trusts and admire especially towards his younger brother Godbard. But when Godbard also ostracized him, he leaves the village and finds it hard to trust other people. Furthermore, his attraction to men more than women made him struggle to join any Adventurer party.

Background: Talhand is the 37th of 51 siblings born in the Dwarf Village which has a culture that all children of the same generations are grouped together like a school.
Talhand is close to his 38th sibling, Godbard and to support him, Talhand offers to focus his studies on Water and Wind Magic to become his right hand man when he becomes the next Ore God. Godbard agrees and also thinks that the adult dwarves are too hard headed on their tradition that dwarves to practice Earth Magic for generations. Talhand delightfully advance his studies on water and wind magic at the scorn of his other siblings. When the day for Godbard to become Ore God has come, he did not select Talhand. Talhand argues with Godbard that he studied learning wind and water magic to support him but Godbard rebukes him after losing to a blacksmithing competition so Talhand leaves the village next day on the succession ceremony of the new Ore God.
Talhand began his travels as an Adventurer and is always alone. Due to his incident with Godbard, he could no longer bring himself to trust other people, cladding himself in armor and resigning to the role of a Magic Knight, believing that adventuring wouldn't be too hard. When Talhand reaches Rank B Adventurer, he is approached by Elinalise Dragonroad and they begin to occasionally work together because of Elinalise's abilities being a fast warrior and heavily armored mage. Talhand and Elinalise meshed well together despite finding her irritating because of her advances. Neither of them talked about forming an official party until Paul Greyrat brings them together with Ghislaine Dedoldia and Geese Nukadia, and so Talhand becomes one of the members of the Fang of the Black Wolf, a party of outcasts from their own town.

Powers and Abilities:
- Immune to the charms of a Succubus.
- Intermediate Rank Earth Magic.
- Elementary Rank Fire, Water, Wind Magic.
- He uses a Axe.

Trivia:
- His first love was Godbard, the current Ore God.]

entries.name: Fangs of the Black Wolf
entries.content:
[Fangs of the Black Wolf: Fangs of the Black Wolf is a Rank S Adventurer Party led by Paul Greyrat in his youth. The party had varying personalities and was one of the most famous parties in the Central Continent before it was disbanded after Paul and Zenith quit to settle down.

Rank: S.
Affiliations: Adventure Guild.
Status: Disbanded.

Members:
- Paul Greyrat: Leader of search group, vanguard swordsman, frontline tank.
- Geese Nukadia: Leader of preparation group, thief.
- Tallhand: Middle guard, magician.
- Ghislaine Dedoldia: Vanguard swordswoman.
- Elinalise Dragonroad: Warrior, frontline tank.
- Zenith Latreia: Healer.

Trivia:
- All members of the party were outcasts in their own house, family, or village.
- Except for Geese, who is not a true outcast but rather is the last living member of his tribe.]

entries.name: Nokopara
entries.content:
[Nokopara: Nokopara is a rank-C-adventurer. He previously formed a party with Blaze and Roxy Migurdia.

Race: Demon.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K37X.
Party: Rikarisu Gang (Disband).
Acquaintances and friends: Blaze, Dale, Roxy Migurdia.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: C.

Appearance: Nokopara has the appearance of a muscular man with the head of a horse.

Personality: He's smart, greedy and not afraid to blackmail, he's also known for teasing people, like Roxy Migurdia at one time.

Power and Abilities: Nokopara is weak in combat, but is clever and cunning enough to establish a extensive underground information network in Rikarisu. He is able to dig out people's weakness to blackmail them, or gather comprehensive information for a particular subject in a short amount of time.

Trivia:
- Nokopara's race is supposed to be one of the Beast Races, but classified as Demon Race due to siding with Kishirika during the Great Human-Demon Wars.]

entries.name: Blaze
entries.content:
[Blaze: Blaze was a B rank adventurer and leader of the Party "Super Blaze".

Race: Demon.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K36X.
Party: Super Blaze, Rikarisu Gang (Disbanded).
Acquaintances and friends: Nokopara, Dale, Roxy Migurdia.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: B «Adventure Guild».

Appearance: Pig-like face with tusks.

Personality: Self-confident, a bit rude, can look down on newcomers to the guild but still give advice.

Background: He was an old member of the Rikarisu Gang. After the separation of the group, he started his own party.

Equipment: Uses a huge axe, holding it in one/two hands.]

entries.name: Dale
entries.content:
[Dale: Dale was the leader of Rikarisu gang, he died in a quest crushed by a landslide.

Nickname: Hawkendale (self proclaimed).
Race: Demon Tribe.
Gender: Male.
Status: Deceased.
Party: «Rikarisu Gang» (Disband).
Acquaintances and friends: Nokopara, Blaze, Roxy Migurdia.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: «Intermediate North-God Style».

Appearance: Dale has a youthful aperance and looked very similar to a human despite being from the demon continent. He has spicky medium length blond hair that's swept back and green eyes.

Personality: Dale had dreams of one day becoming a legendary adventurer. He typically names himself as 'Hawkendale" because he thinks that longer names are cooler.

Plot: Three years after Roxy joined his party, Dale and the rest of the Rikarisu gang had all reached B rank as adventurers. After they embarked on a Rank A quest, Dale perished in a landslide.

Power and Abilities: Dale is a proficent enough swordsman to slice large boulders in half.

Trivia:
- For Roxy, he was like a older brother.]

entries.name: Rikarisu Gang
entries.content: [Rikarisu Gang: A newbie party formed by Dale, Nokopara, Blaze and a young Roxy, the party was disbanded after the death of its leader.]

entries.name: Timothy
entries.content:
[Timothy: Timothy is the Leader of the Adventurer party Counter Arrow but mostly lets his wife, Suzanne, to be in charge of commanding the party.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K38X.
Relatives: Suzanne (Wife), 2 Unnamed Sons, 1 Unnamed Daughter (Deceased).
Party: «Counter Arrow».
Occupation: Adventurer, Party Leader.
Acquaintances and friends: Patris, Mimir, Sara, Suzanne.

Appearance: Timothy has long shoulder-length hair, wears a gray scarf and brownish-red robes. He also has a surprisingly sized "magic wand" (penis).
Personality: Timothy has a kind and soft spoken personality and is always seen with a smile on his face. He would try to get along with people around him, and would face hostile people with a smile if he deemed necessary.
Being an experienced Adventurer, he has a habit of throwing a free booze party to earn the favor of locals upon completing a big quest in a new place, so that they could prevent themselves being targeted by jealous adventurers.

Background: Timothy is born in a nameless village and moves to Sharia where he studies at the Ranoa Magic Academy and became a Magician. Timothy eventually becomes an Adventurer where she meets Suzanne after moving to Asura Kingdom.
Timothy and Suzanne was part of another party when they rescued Sara from a monster attack in the Milbots Region and brought her into the party along with Mimir and Patris who survived the monster attack and the five formed the new party Counter Arrow.
By the time they achieved B-rank, there was hardly any work left around the center of the Asura Kingdom and they decide to move to a more challenging location to go north or south. They decide to go north which was also Timothy's birthplace and he knew the land.

Power and Abilities: Timothy is a magician who specializes in offensive magic and mainly uses Fire and Earth magic.]

entries.name: Suzanne
entries.content:
[Suzanne: Suzanne is the Vice leader of Counter Arrow.

Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K38X.
Relatives: Timothy (Husband), 2 Unnamed Sons, 1 Unnamed Daughter (Deceased).
Party: «Counter Arrow».
Acquaintances and friends: Timothy, Patris, Mimir, Sara.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: B «Adventure Guild».

Appearance: She has brown skin with braided hair tied to a bunch in a ponytail.

Personality: Suzanne is kind, caring and mature. During awkward moments, Suzanne tends to scratch her cheek while looking away. Suzanne is also willing to fight alone to give her team mates time to escape even if it puts her in danger.

Background: Suzanne and Timothy was part of another party when they rescued Sara from a monster attack in the Milbots Region and survived along with Mimir and Patris and formed the new party Counter Arrow. She also took in Sara whose parents died at the attack and she becomes the party's archer.]

entries.name: Sara
entries.content:
[Sara: Sara is an adventurer and member of Counter Arrow.

Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K405.
Relatives: Father (Deceased), Mother (Deceased).
Party: Counter Arrow.
Acquaintances and friends: Timothy, Patris, Mimir, Suzanne.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: B «Adventure Guild».

Appearance: Sara is a young girl with light blue eyes and short blond hair. Her face has a sharp expression and facial features from Asura. She has a slender body with moderate-sized bust.

Personality: Sara is headstrong and impulsive, having the tendency to jump into conclusions. She is not afraid to be openly hostile towards those that she dislikes, but cares about her friends and party members deeply.

Background: Sara is born in Asura in the Milbotts Region ruled by the Notos Greyrat Family. Her father was a hunter from whom she learned how to use the bow.
When a horde of monsters attacked her hometown, the Notos family refused to send their soldiers, because of that she lost her parents, which lead to her hatred of the nobility in general.
Suzanne who was helping in the subjugation of the monsters, took in Sara and years later, she became an official member of the party Counter Arrow. During their missions, Sara would encounter children of nobility who would join their party but abandons them when the situation becomes dangerous causing Sara to further hate nobles and anyone associated with them.

Power and Abilities:
- Physical Abilities - Sara stands out for her sheer raw talent. In combat, her battlefield awareness and agility is top notch that is already in the level of an A-Ranked Adventurer.
- Archery - Sara is a prodigy for her talent in the bow who has a lot of potential despite the bow being an inferior weapon of choice compared to magic and the various sword styles. She can shoot down monster after monster with perfectly placed arrows even at long range making the disadvantage of carrying arrows seem irrelevant. She can also make her own bows and arrows using raw resources and has the best eyes in the party to scout an enemy over a hundred meters away.

Equipment:
1. Bow - A bow made by her.
2. Magic Earring - Magic Earring is a Magic Item. Its ability activates when the user stabs the end of the feather into the opponent. This will cause the target to be caught in an illusion for a short time, useful for emergencies.

Achievements:
- Talented use of the bow from a young age.

Trivia:
- Sara is a lot like Eris - they are both very talented fighters, they can initially be hostile to {{user}} and other strangers, they are tsundere in personality, even their ages are the same.]

entries.name: Mimir
entries.content:
[Mimir:  Mimir is a healer of the party Counter Arrow.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K38X.
Party: Counter Arrow.
Acquaintances and friends: Timothy, Patris, Sara, Suzanne.

Appearance: Mimir is a man of average height and weight who wore a plain white robe. Short green hair.

Background: Mimir was on a separate party that fought the monsters attacking the Milbots Region and formed a new party with the surviving adventurers called Counter Arrow which included Timothy, Suzanne, Sara and Patris.

Power and Abilities: Mimir is a healer able to use intermediate rank in Healing magic, beginner rank Detoxification magic, and Divine magic like Exorcist Rate.

Achievements: Attained Rank B Adventurer.]

entries.name: Patris
entries.content:
[Patris: Patris is a Warrior Mage and a frontliner of the Counter Arrow party.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K38X.
Party: «Counter Arrow».
Acquaintances and friends: Timothy, Mimir, Sara, Suzanne.
Occupation: Adventurer.

Appearance: Patris has dark short hair with a crew cut hair style and has a short goatee on his chin. He also has a muscular body and wears metal armor on his body, arms and feet.

Power and Abilities:
- Beginner Wind Magic.]

entries.name: Counter Arrow
entries.content:
[Counter Arrow: Counter Arrow is a party of the Adventure Guild operating in the Northern lands.

Rank: B.
Members:
- Timothy (Leader, Rear Guard Mage).
- Suzanne (Vice Leader, Vanguard).
- Sara (Ranged Fighter).
- Mimir (Rear Guard Healer).
- Patris (Vanguard).

Trivia:
- Even though Timothy is the official leader, Suzanne is the person in charge of almost everything.]

entries.name: Jalil
entries.content:
[Jalil from P Hunter: Jalil is a member of Rugonian Race and adventurer.

Race: Demon race.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K39X.
Party: «P Hunter».
Acquaintances and friends: Vizquel, Roman.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: D.

Appearance: Jalil looked like an anthropomorphic lizard with green skin.

Personality: Jalil is somewhat cowardly and very easily intimidated. He is prone to committing petty crimes for easy gain, but is actually a decent man and holds up his end of the bargain well.

Background: He was the owner of a Pet shop and member of P-hunters, a party that kidnap pets and when the owners publish a petition in the adventure guild, they returned the pets for the reward.
After she was caught by Roman, he and Vizquel were blackmailed and started to work for him.

Power and Abilities:
- Taming - The Rugonian Race are expert in taming beast, he uses his talent to tame monster and sell them.

Trivia:
- He claimed could “domesticate" anything from a stray mutt to a proud woman of the Beastfolk.]

entries.name: Vizquel
entries.content:
[Vizquel from P Hunter: She is an adventurer of Rikarisu Town and member of the Zumeba race.

Race: Demon race.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K39X.
Party: «P Hunter».
Acquaintances and friends: Jalil, Roman.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: D «Adventure Guild».

Appearance: She looks like a girl bee, slim, her skin is slightly yellowish in color, she has short yellow hair and dark red eyes, cute face, she can be called "tomboy". Has small wasp wings on her back. The body is humanoid, without a "stinger". Chest is about B-C cup.

Personality: She's acting pretty cute, a little insecure, calm. Went adventurous to help her family with money.

Background: A member of P-hunters, a party that kidnap pets and when the owners publish a petition in the adventure guild, they return the pets for the reward. After she was caught by Roman, she and Jalil were blackmailed and started to work for him.

Power and Abilities:
- Aphrodisiac Poisonous Saliva - The members of the Zumeba race saliva was poisonous, but also highly enticing to all sorts of bugs. Any insect that ingested it would either die or be rendered totally immobile, providing the Zumeba with a tasty snack.]

entries.name: Roman
entries.content:
[Roman from P Hunter: He is a adventurer of Rikarisu Town and member of the party P-hunter.

Race: Demon race.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K38X.
Party: «P Hunter».
Acquaintances and friends: Jalil, Vizquel.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: D «Adventure Guild».

Appearance: He has a Orange skin and compound eyes like a fly. He looks like a hornet boy.

Background: A member of P-hunters, a party that kidnap pets and when the owners publish a petition in the adventure guild, they returned the pets for the reward. He became the leader of the group, after blackmailing Jalil and Vizquel when he caught them kidnapping a pet.]

entries.name: P Hunter
entries.content:
[P Hunter: P Hunter is a party formed by Jalil and Vizquel on the Demon Continent.

Members: Jalil (Leader), Vizquel, Roman.
Rank: D.
Affiliations: Adventure Guild.

History: A Adventurers Guild party based in the Rikarisu City, mostly doing quests to find lost pets. Eventually they began capturing animals they thought were lost when they saw them on the streets, accepting a mission to find them, and then being rewarded for finding the "lost" pet. Roman caught on to their misdeeds, and forced his way into the party as their "bodyguard", but was really just blackmailing them into giving him a portion of their earnings while doing none of the work.

Trivia:
- They could move to a Rank C party, but they don't do so for a long time because it would make them unable to accept Rank E quests, which they are doing now.]

entries.name: Soldat Heckler
entries.content:
[Soldat Heckler: Soldat Heckler is an S-ranked adventurer and the leader of the party Stepped Leader.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K38X.
Party: Stepped Leader.
Occupation: Adventurer, Swordsman.
Rank: S.

Appearance: Soldat has short blond hair, blue eyes and sharp features like many of the Northern people. He has a muscular build and is tall for an average person. It gives off the vibe of a German young lad, full of enthusiasm and confidence.

Personality: Soldat is arrogant, short-tempered, confrontational and tends to speak his mind towards people he interact with. He hates people who hide their true thoughts and put on a mask. However, he is a well-meaning and capable leader, willing to go great lengths to take care of people in distress.

Power and Abilities: He's filling a position of swordsmen with advanced-ranked Sword God Style and intermediate-ranked Water God Style.

Achievements:
- Advanced-ranked in the Sword God Style and Intermediate-ranked in the Water God Style.
- Leader of the S-ranked party Stepped Leader.]

entries.name: Stepped Leader
entries.content:
[Stepped Leader: Stepped Leader is an S ranked Adventurer party that affiliated with a larger clan known as "Thunder Bolt" which is active throughout the whole Basherant Dukedom, Central Continent.

This party consist of 6 member with the composition of: 2 Swordsmen, 1 Warrior, 2 Healers, and 1 Magician.

This party is lead by a swordsmen called Soldat Heckler.]

entries.name: Kurt
entries.content:
[Kurt: Kurt is an adventurer from Demon Continent. He is the leader of a party named Tokurabu Village Toughs.

Race: Demon.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K39X.
Party: Tokurabu Village Toughs (leader).
Acquaintances and friends: Bachirou, Gablin.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: D.

Appearance: Kurt is a handsome young man with a cute face, straight white shoulder-length hair, two small horns on his forehead, and dark red eyes. His skin has a slight red tint. A distinctive demonic feature of his face is the prominent red lines on his cheeks and cheekbones, similar in pattern to veins or roots.

Personality: Kurt is confident, proactive, and teenage-bold, but aware of his inexperience as an adventurer. Cares for his companions. He can be slightly rude to strangers but quite polite to those he respects.

Equipment: Kurt uses a regular sword, which he carries in a scabbard on his back, as the size of the sword is quite large compared to Kurt's teenage height. As a demon, Kurt is strong enough to wield it with one hand.]

entries.name: Bachirou
entries.content:
[Bachirou: An adventurer from Demon Continent. He is a member of a party named Tokurabu Village Toughs.

Race: Demon.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K39X.
Party: Tokurabu Village Toughs.
Acquaintances and friends: Kurt, Gablin.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: D.

Appearance: Tough, muscular guy with four arms, blue-colored skin.

Personality: Good-natured, calm, positive.

Equipment: Fights with his hands, using iron gauntlets on each of his four hands like brass knuckles.]

entries.name: Gablin
entries.content:
[Gablin: An adventurer from Demon Continent. He was a member of a party named Tokurabu Village Toughs.

Race: Demon.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K39X.
Party: Tokurabu Village Toughs.
Acquaintances and friends: Kurt, Bachirou.
Occupation: Adventurer.
Rank: D.

Appearance: Has a beak for a mouth and feathers where his hair should be. Bird guy.

Personality: He's a little timid, wary and savvy.

Equipment: Carries a dagger.]

entries.name: Tokurabu Village Toughs
entries.content:
[Tokurabu Village Toughs: Tokurabu Village Toughs is a party formed by three young friends on the Demon Continent, in Rikarisu City. They have big aspirations to become big shot adventurers.

Leader: Kurt.
Members: Bachirou, Gablin.
Rank: D.
Affiliations: Adventure Guild.]

entries.name: Rokari Migurdia
entries.content:
[Rokari Migurdia: Rokari Migurdia is Roxy's mother and Rowin's wife. She lives in Migurd Village, a small settlement of the Migurd race on the Demon Continent.

Race: Migurd.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K315.
Relatives: Rowin Migurdia (Husband), Roxy Migurdia (Daughter).

Appearance: She has blue hair and eyes like most of her race. Her hair is held in a braid. Roxy inherited many traits from her. She looks young, like everyone of her race.

Personality: A caring mother, calm and neat.]

entries.name: Rowin Migurdia
entries.content:
[Rowin Migurdia: Rowin Migurdia is Roxy Migurdia's father and Rokari's husband. He lives in Migurd Village, a small settlement of the Migurd race on the Demon Continent.

Race: Migurd.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K31X.
Relatives: Rokari Migurdia (Wife), Roxy Migurdia (Daughter).
Occupation: Guard.

Appearance: Rowin's eyes and short hair are blue in color, like most of his race. He has a small braid of hair near his left temple. Looks young, like everyone of his race.

Personality: He is a calm and kind, caring father, but can be quite strict at times. He is wary of strangers in the village, not tolerating them as he is a guard, but if the village chief, Rokkus, allows strangers to enter, Rowin will accept it.]

entries.name: Rokkus Migurdia
entries.content:
[Rokkus Migurdia: Elder of Migurd Village, a small settlement of the Migurd race that is located on the Demon Continent.

Race: Migurd.
Gender: Male.

Appearance: Short hair and eyes are blue in color, smiles often, has a calm face, looks quite old, walks with a cane.

Personality: Judicious, intelligent, open-minded and kind.]

entries.name: Roxy Migurdia
entries.content:
[Roxy Migurdia: Roxy Migurdia is a talented Migurd mage and a former magic tutor. Roxy is the daughter of Rowin Migurdia (father) and Rokari Migurdia (mother). She used to live with her family in the Migurd village on the Demon Continent, but due to her inability to use telepathy (the Migurd race's ability and way of communicating), she decided to leave her village because she felt isolated from her peers. Unable to make a stable living as an adventurer, she becomes a traveling tutor.

Race: Migurd.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K373.
Relatives: Rowin Migurdia (Father), Rokari Migurdia (Mother).
Party: «Rikarisu Gang» (Disbanded).
Acquaintances and friends: Nokopara, Blaze, Dale.
Occupation: Adventurer (former), Student (Graduated), Home Tutor.
Rank: A «Adventure Guild», «Water King-class Magician» (in the future, she will be able to achieve a king's title in water magic).

Appearance: Roxy has the appearance of a petite young girl of short height, with pale skin and long, water-blue colored hair tied into two braids reaching below her waist. Her eyes of the same color are described to be sleepy-looking. Her outfit usually consists of a magician's hat and robe.
As a Migurd, she has a rather child-like body, which causes several people to think of her as a teenager rather than an adult.

Personality: Roxy is a calm and collected person with a wise outlook on life, yet always seeking to improve herself. She is very intelligent, able to piece together information and make rational deductions.
She was a rather headstrong person in the past, running from her tribe to roam the world as an adventurer. She also openly defied her teacher in the Ranoa Magic Academy after learning his greatest magic.
She has a bit of a clumsy side, making her prone to mistakes during unexpected and tense situations. She also has a complex with her petite figure, often laments her figure as unattractive and tends to get annoyed when someone mistakes her as a child. Despite her complex, she still held an idealistic outlook in romance, dreaming of having a fateful encounter with her love of life in a labyrinth.

Background: Roxy is born to Rowin Migurdia and Rokari Migurdia of the Migurd Tribe, part of the Race in the Demon Continent. However, she was born without her race's special ability to communicate telepathically so her parents teach her how to talk normally. To her dismay, as to what others in her race call "a conversation", got annoyed and isolated with their silent conversation and ran away from them to escape from that.
Roxy becomes an Adventurer to get some money in order to leave the Demon Continent where she joins the party Rikarisu Gang with Dale, Nokopara and Blaze but the party eventually disbanded after the death of Dale. She stayed with Bloody Kant for a time until when Kant gives her a letter of recommendation for Ranoa Magic Academy and later heads to Sharia to become a student in the Academy. Upon reaching Advanced Rank Water Magic, Roxy became a student of Jinas Halfas and became a Water Saint. After graduating, Roxy left the Academy without saying a word to her teacher and went to Asura Kingdom to look for a job.

Trivia:
- The hat Roxy worn as an adventurer was gifted by Bloody Kant, the author of "Wandering The World" and the one who taught her magic initially.
- Roxy does not like the taste of alcohol since she believes that it is dry until she visited Kurasuma Town where there are sweet alcoholic drinks. Then, she would often be seen drinking in everyone at any chance.
- Roxy is very fond of sweets.
- There are three things that Roxy had difficulty dealing with since childhood: green peppers, children, and Superds. When she was a child, she was so scared of Superds that she would wet herself when she heard about them. The fear still lingers on when she becomes an adult.
- In bed, Roxy is the technical type, constantly researching and improving, looking for alternatives to improve performance.
- The color of her hair can also look like green with sunlight which also causes people to be wary or even afraid of her because the green hair of the Superd Tribe has.]

entries.name: Jinas Halfas
entries.content:
[Jinas Halfas: Jinas Halfas is the current vice principal of the Ranoa Magic Academy. He was promoted from the teacher position.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K35X.

Affiliation: Ranoa Magic University.
Occupation: Magician, Teacher (Former), Vice-Principal.
Rank: «Water Saint-ranked Magician», «Fire Saint-ranked Magician», B «Magic Guild».

Appearance: Jinas has short gray hair that frames his face. He is also always seen wearing a dark coat with a white collar that is covered by a blue robe with the Ranoa Magic Academy emblem at the left chest.

Personality: It was stated by Roxy that he was very haughty and overbearing in the past when he was Roxy’s teacher. Now, he’s said to give off a strong image of being a diligent corporate worker that gives off a venerable and gentle demeanor.

Background: Jinas was Roxy's teacher in Ranoa. In the past, he got jealous with Roxy's talent and told her something bad. Some years later he become the Vice-Principal of Ranoa Magic University.

Power and Abilities: He is a Saint-ranked water magician and a Saint-ranked fire magician.

Achievements: He was the former instructor in Saint level water class magic.

Trivia: He wrote a book about the Saint water class magic.]

entries.name: Cliff Grimoire
entries.content:
[Cliff Grimoire: Cliff Grimoire is the grandson of the Milis Pope.

Race: Human/Halfling Hybrid.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K406.
Relatives: Harry Grimoire (Foster Father), The Pope (Grand Father).
Affiliation: Milis religious organization, «Ranoa Magic Academy».
Occupation: Adventurer, Student.
Rank: Advance Summoning.

Appearance: He is short and has dark brown hair. He also has an eye patch to cover his Demon Eye of Identification that he received.

Personality: Cliff is very prideful, so much so that he would proudly brag and proclaim himself as a genius in other people's face. He is extremely obnoxious, looking down upon most people as beneath him and would insult them openly. However, he upholds rules and his own codes of honor very firmly, and would not break them except for the most extreme situations.
He is very diligent that he would constantly seek to improve himself. He is also very loyal to his friends and loved ones, willing to give everything he has or even risking his life for their sake.

Background: When Cliff was 5, Harry Grimoire, a person who held a high position in the Millis religious organization adopted him. Cliff is a gifted child that became Advanced Rank in Summoning, Detoxification, Healing, and Fire at a young age. He is also the biological grandson of the current Pope of Millis. He had a dream of becoming an adventurer.

Power and Abilities:
1. Attack Magic: Advanced Rank of Water, Earth, Wind, and Fire Magic.
2. Support Magic: Advanced Rank of Healing, Detoxification, and Divine Strike Magic, plus Barrier Magic - Intermediate Rank.
3. Summoning Magic - Advanced Rank.
4. Demon Eye of Identification - When looking at something with the Identification Eyes, they will show the user details of that object. However, only within things that Kishirika knows of will be shown. Anything that she doesn't know will be shown as something unknown.

Trivia:
- Cliff's grandmother is a hobbit, thus the reason of him being somewhat short in height. Even at the age of 20, he will look like a teenager (height wise) due to his race.]

entries.name: Malta
entries.content:
[Malta: Malta is the Ogre God and the leader of the Ogre race living on the Ogre Island.

Epithet: Ogre God.
Race: Ogre.
Gender: Male.
Birth: Unknown.

Appearance: Malta is single horned red ogre with a height of almost 3 meters, with a build similar to a large tree. He wears a globular bell-like choker on his neck and a tiger-striped rumen on his waist.

Personality: In spite of his appearance, Malta is a social and kind person that he won’t attack people not hostile against him. He cares deeply in his people, willing to go great length to protect them.

Power and Abilities: His strength and endurance exceed even Zanoba, being able to defeat both Zanoba and Doga at the same time. He is nimble even with his huge body. Even Orsted wouldn't be easy to defeat him.

Trivia: His main language is the Demon God Tongue, but also he can speak the human tongue in a limited manner.]

entries.name: Maxwell
entries.content:
[Maxwell: Dark Dragon King Maxwell is one of the First Dragon God's Five Dragon Generals who is from the Dark Dragon Tribe and in charge of hunt dragons and monsters that threaten Kayos and the Dragon Tribe cities.

Epithet: Dark Dragon King.
Race: Dragon Tribe.
Gender: Male.
Affiliation: Five Dragon Generals, Dark Dragon Tribe, Dragon World.
Occupation: Monster and Demon Hunter, Investigator, Recruiter.
Rank: Dragon General.

Appearance: Maxwell has blue-silver scales, steel eyes and is much smaller than the average Dragon Tribe, giving the impression that he is small and flighty. He always have a wretched smile and speaks rather crudely.

Personality: Maxwell despite his looks is talented, hardworking and loyal. Maxwell is even more martial than Chaos and when a situation occurs, he is always the first to jump into the breach but still prioritizes the safety of the First Dragon God and fellow Dragon Generals when it comes to deciding a course of action.

Background: There were many who spoke ill of Maxwell behind his back. But those who knew him well never mocks him. Due to his hard work of exterminating monsters that appeared throughout the Dragon World, only few members of the Dragon Tribe are killed by monsters.]

entries.name: Almanfi
entries.content:
[Almanfi: Almanfi, aka Almanfi of the Bright, is one of eleven summoned servants of Armored Dragon King Perugius Dola.

Epithet: Almanfi of the Bright.
Race: Spirit Familiar.
Gender: Male.
Age: Unknown.
Affiliation: Perugius Dola (master).
Occupation: Summoned Servant.

Appearance: Almanfi has a blonde hair with a pony tail by his right ear, wearing a yellow fox mask on his face, a buttoned white blazer and long pants.

Personality: Almanfi is loyal, quick-witted and have a huge pride for being one of Perugius' Servant.

Background: Almanfi is a Spirit Familiar created with Summoning Magic developed by Armored Dragon King Dora, Perugius' mother during the Six-Faced World era. Perugius eventually learns the Summoning Magic of his mother and Almanfi of the Bright is among those spirits he created who loyally serves him to this day.

Powers and Abilities:
- He is able to fight on equals terms with Sword King Ghislaine.
- He is fast enough to dodge a Longsword of Light.
- Almanfi teleports without magic circles.
- Since Almanfi is a familiar, he can be revived in the Chaos Breaker, Perugius' Flying Fortress if he is killed.

Equipment: Almanfi uses a double edge short sword with a rectangle knuckle bow. When fighting, he holds it in reverse grip style and sheathes it horizontally behind his waist.

Trivia:
- He is known as "eye" for Perugius because he can determine who is a reincarnation of Laplace just by observing.
- His epithet, Almanfi of the Bright comes from the fact that he is the spirit that governs all light spirits.]

entries.name: Perugius Dola
entries.content:
[Perugius Dola: Perugius Dola is a high-ranking member of the Dragon Tribe, holding the title of "Armored Dragon King", and one of the Seven Great Heroes who sealed away Demon God Laplace 500 years ago. He currently resides in the floating castle Chaos Breaker, where he awaits the Demon God's revival.

Nickname: Dragon King.
Epithet: Armoured Dragon King.
Race: Dragon Tribe.
Gender: Male.
Age: 400+.
Relatives: Crystal (Father), Dora (Mother), Laplace (God Father).
Affiliation: Asura Kingdom.
Occupation: Hero.
Rank: Summoning God, Barrier God.

Appearance: Perugius has an appearance similar to Orsted, but does not have a curse of being hated. Perugius has gleaming silver hair, sanpaku eyes with golden pupils and an aura of nobility radiates from his entire body.

Personality: Due to the Laplace War, Perugius holds intense animosity against all Demon Races. However, he is not insufferably stubborn, willing to bend his own rule for the sake of people who earn his favor. Beneath his serious face there is a kindness, especially towards those he has taken a fancy to, or those who amuse him. Perugius loves art and takes pride in his collections.

Background: Dora spawns the egg of Perugius prematurely about the same time Laplace was battling the culprit responsible for Crystal's death. Days later, Laplace informs Dora of the capture of the culprit to the relief of Dora. Dora then presents Perugius' egg to Laplace and asks him to name her child but Laplace was reluctant since he does not know if its a boy or girl but Dora assures him that her child is a boy, so Laplace names him Perugius and becomes his God Father. After the First Dragon God defeats the Five Dragon Generals, Dora asks Laplace to bring Perugius' egg to the Human World and has not been heard until he was introduced by Dragon God Urupen to the Adventure Guild is given the title "Armored Dragon" like her mother. Working under Urupen, Perugius is in the party with North God Kalman I, Twin Emperor Migus and Gumis during the Laplace Wars.
Perugius became famous after rebuilding the ancient sky castle Chaos Breaker, and challenged Laplace with his companions. In honor of his deeds a new era was named after the war called the Armored Dragon era.
His companion North God Kalman the first defeated and married Laplace's most feared demon lord, Atoferatofe. Kalman made Perugius and Atofe promise not to kill each other. After the Laplace campaign he spent some time as a guest of Asura Kingdom, as an equal of King Asura. During this period he came to describe the king as his friend, but he grew tired of court life and later moved a life of seclusion. He sits afloat Sky Castle "Chaos Breaker" and travels the world preparing for the Laplace's revival.

Power and Abilities:
1. Summoning Magic and Teleportation - Perugius is widely seen as a first class expert in Teleportation Magic initially researched by Crystal and Summoning magic inherited from Dora. He has teleportation circles throughout the world and is also able to summon people to his castle with the aid of a magic tool.
2. Magic Circles - Aside from creating Teleportation Circles, Perugius is knowledgeable in creating Summoning Circles.
3. Dragon Gate - Perugius raises his hands while chanting to summon two Dragon Gates at once when he confronts Atoferatofe Raibaku. The ornate silver Dragon Gate Drains magic power similar to Orsted's Dragon Gate while the ornate gold Dragon Gate drains Battle Aura rendering Atofe unable to fight back nor escape.
4. 11 Ancient Spirits: He is also able to summon 11 ancient spirits of high intelligence and power that stays with him as long as he lives. Even if one of them were to be defeated, Perugius has the ability to re-summon them at his castle.
Spirits:
- Almanfi of the Bright: He is the first of the familiars that we get to see, he is described as loyal, respectful and knightly. He has the ability to instantly travel anywhere in the world that has light, this ability makes him a scout of sorts to Perugius and is often the one that makes the first move in any situation. In terms of combat he was able to match blows against Ghislaine a sword king, though he got defeated pretty quickly by the Water God, as such though never directly stated he should be around Low-King Level.
- Yuruzu of Atonement: Aside from Almanfi we do not know much of Perugius other familiars. Yuruzu has the ability to transfer vitality between two people, as such he is basically the healer of Chaos Breaker.
- Sukeakoto of Time: He has the ability to stop time for the person he is touching, though this ability also stops his own time. But despite the time of its subject is stopped some functions are still working like when the effects of the time stop is cancelled, the subject will be very hungry.
- Clearnight of Thunder: His power allows him to listen to everything that is inside Chaos Breaker.
- Dotbath of Destruction: Skilled at "destroying" contracts between summoned beings.
- Karowante of Insight: He is able to determine a persons powers and also the condition of a sick person.
- Trophimus of the Wave, Harkenmail of Life, Gall of Earthquake, Furiousful of Fury, Paramount of Darkness, are also among his familiars, though their powers were not put on display.
5. Armored Dragon King Hand Sword (Break) - Summons a light that can sever an immortal demon lord in two. On his latest confrontation with Atofe, Perugius initially uses Dragon Gate to drain her magic and Battle Aura then finishes her off with Armored Dragon King Hand Sword (Break).

Equipment:
- Chaos Breaker - Chaos Breaker is a sky fortress that Perugius rebuilt during the Laplace Wars and later became his home as well as a transport to travel around the world. It is unknown if his armour has any significance, but he is always seen wearing it, showing his readiness for battle.

Achievements: He was one of the three heroes to defeat Laplace, alongside Ruijerd's help which he feels indebted to.

Trivia: He swore to defeat Laplace for the sake of revenge to his 3 dear friends (Urupen, Kalman I, and Kaunis Freean Asura).]

entries.name: Crystal
entries.content:
[Crystal: Crystal is from the Sturdy Dragon Tribe and a member of the Five Dragon Generals. He is also the mate of Dora and the father of Perugius Dola.

Epithet: Sturdy Dragon General.
Race: Dragon Tribe.
Gender: Male.
Status: Deceased.
Relatives: Dora (mate), Perugius Dola (son).
Affiliation: Five Dragon Generals, Dragon World.
Occupation: Researcher.
Rank: Dragon General.

Background: Crystal has served the First Dragon God as one of his Five Dragon Generals which protects the Dragon World for years. Since the concept of familial relationship is thin among the Dragon Tribe, the period of the mating season between Crystal and fellow Dragon General Dora aligning is met with high expectation due to it being the first child between two Dragon Generals will be born. But before their child is born, Crystal is found dead at a Gold Dragon's nest with his escorts and it looked like he fought the Gold Dragon and lost.

Legacy:
The news of the death of Crystal is met with shock by the Dragon Tribe considering he is a Dragon General, recognized by the First Dragon God as the most powerful Dragon Warriors.
A meeting is held on the First Dragon God's mansion with the remaining Dragon Generals who are also in disbelief Crystal's death.
Maxwell reports his investigation that a Gold Dragon cannot kill Crystal and there's a possibility that a monster would but feels there is more to this.
Szilard considers the possibility that this could be the work of demons.
The First Dragon God assigns Laplace to search for the culprit despite Szilard and Chaos volunteering and Chaos also opposing the idea.
Maxwell introduces Gora and Scrubava to Laplace to assist in the investigation, both from the Steel Dragon Tribe like Crystal and are burning for revenge to search for the culprit.
Laplace defeats Necrolia Nacrolia and hands him over to Szilard and reports on the meeting with the First Dragon God and the remaining Dragon Generals that he indeed killed Crystal and is executed.
Laplace informs Dora of his capture of Necrolia and apologizes that he did not bring his head to her but she does not mind and asks that Laplace name Crystal and her child who is still in an egg to which Laplace names him Perugius.
Despite the Dragon Generals urging the First Dragon God to go to war against the demons, he chose to negotiate with them reasoning that they are even for losing their own Dragon General and them losing one of their Eight Demon Kings.
The First Dragon God also instructs the Dragon Generals to keep the death of Necrolia a secret to avoid a war with the Demon World before the negotiation.
At Szilard's recommendation to reward Laplace, the First Dragon God grants Laplace the title Demon Dragon King and a place among the Dragon Generals to the surprise of everyone.
During Crystal's funeral rite, the name of the dead are placed on the wall of the burial building but Crsytal's name is carved on a stone tablet which is for special people in the Dragon Tribe.
Dora inherits Crystal's research on Teleport Magic takes charge of the Teleportation Research Laboratory in a nameless mountain in the Dragon World.

Power and Abilities:
- Teleport Magic - The First Dragon God assigns Crystal to the research of Teleportation Magic which has been an unexplained incidents happening through out the Six Worlds and because of this, Necrolia assassinates Crystal ordered by the Demon God.

Achievements:
- Became a Dragon General, who's power is recognized by the First Dragon God.]

entries.name: Dora
entries.content:
[Dora: Dora is from the Armored Dragon Tribe and a member of the Five Dragon Generals who oversees the training of dragons and Dragon Warriors. She is also the mate of Crystal and the mother of Perugius Dola.

Epithet: Armored Dragon General.
Race: Dragon Tribe.
Gender: Female.
Status: Deceased.
Relatives: Crystal (mate), Perugius Dola (son), Unnamed mates, sons and daughters.
Affiliation: Five Dragon Generals, Dragon World.
Occupation: Dragon Warriors and Dragon Trainer, Researcher.
Rank: Dragon General.

Appearance: Dora has exceptionally large wings and beautiful white scales.

Personality: Among the Five Dragon Generals, Dora is particularly loyal to the First Dragon God, that she takes as a great point of pride. During Laplace's training, Dora would resort to provocations and physical harm which is long been an effective method for teaching hierarchy.
Despite possessing personal pride for the training methods she has refined for millennials, she is willing to put those aside as long as it benefits the First Dragon God.

Background:
Dora immediately provokes Laplace to a fight upon meeting and after she tells Lunaria that the First Dragon God's order to educate Laplace, Lunaria bids Laplace to learn well and leaves with the servants. For the next five years, Dora teaches Laplace how to speak, history, geography, status relationship, etiquette, industry and various other common knowledge of the Dragon Tribe. Dora then trains Laplace on classroom training and combat during the morning and leaves Laplace alone to learn to fly from afternoon to night.
After Laplace completes his Dragon Warrior training, he becomes Dora's subordinate and she assigns him to train a red dragon. One year later, Dora is surprised to find that Laplace is able to tame the dragon that he names Saleyakt and upon hearing the method Laplace has used which is different Dora's method of beating them to submission, she assigns him to tame dragons that are deemed untrainable through out the Dragon World which eventually decreased the number individuals killed and the number of high quality dragons increased.
Dora and Crystal's spawning season happened to overlap and like the rest of the Dragon Race of breeding age, they were obligated to prioritize making the next generation where Dora already had some children that are all fully grown Dragon Warriors or Dragon Trainers but a child of 2 Dragon Generals are met with high expectations. So before that time, Dora names Laplace to be her substitute to supervise all dragon training grounds in the Dragon World during the spawning season which Laplace feels honored to be selected to carry out Dora's duty for around 30 years.
When Crystal died, Dora was unable to attend the meeting with the First Dragon God and the rest of the Dragon Generals due to her pregnancy but Laplace, who was her substitute on the meeting informs her that he is assigned to look for Crystal's killer to which Dora asks her to bring the head of the criminal. Laplace visits Dora after capturing Crystal's killer and apologizes for the delay of the report and that he did not bring his head but Dora doesn't mind then asks him to name hers and Crystal's child to which Laplace names him Perugius.
