Dora attends the meeting at the Dragon God's mansion where Laplace and Szilard give their reports, and confirm that the criminal Laplace has captured is Necrolia Nacrolia, and his reasons for killing Crystal. Although Dora looks calm, the rest of the Dragon Generals knows that Dora is enraged and they all urge the Dragon God to declare war on the Demon World but the Dragon God choose to negotiate with them. When the Dragon God bestows Laplace with the title Demon Dragon King and Crystal's successor as Dragon General, Dora is shocked but welcomes Laplace like the most of the Dragon Generals.
When the Dragon God's child is born, even the dragons that are ongoing training with Dora is treated well that lasted for decades and like the rest of the Dragon Generals, Dora is also impressed by the child and left with a solemn expression.
After Lunaria's death and funeral, Dora gives her list of suspects which is the same as the rest of the Dragon General and is also present when the Human God reveals the plot of the other worlds against the Dragon God. Dora and the rest of the Dragon Generals accompanies the First Dragon God who goes to war against the Beast God, Sea God and Sky God resulting to their deaths then the destruction of their respective worlds.

Power and Abilities: Summoning Magic, Teleportation Magic, Spirit Summoning Magic.

Equipment:
- God Spear - A spear forged by Chaos to combat the first dragon god.

Achievements:
- Domesticated the dragons in the dragon world.
- Invented spirit summoning magic.]

entries.name: Laplace
entries.content:
[Laplace: Laplace is known as the Demon God, a title given the strongest Demon, who waged war against humanity 500 years ago before being sealed by the Seven Great Heroes. In reality, there are actually two Laplaces, Demon God Laplace and Technique God Laplace, having been split into two whilst fighting the Fighting God. While it is mentioned that he will revive in the future, neither of his two halves actually appear in the main story.

Nickname: Aldebaran, Golden Knight.
Epithet: Demon Dragon General (Former), Dragon God (Former), Demon God, Technique God.
Race: Demon/Dragon Hybrid (Demon Dragon King), Demon Race (Demon God), Dragon Tribe (Technique God).
Gender: Male.
Age: 32,890+.
Status: Sealed (Demon God), Alive (Technique God).
Relatives: Dragon God (Adoptive Father), Lunaria (Adoptive Mother), Perugius Dola (Godson), Orsted (Adoptive Brother).
Affiliation: Dragon World, Five Dragon Generals.
Occupation: 2nd Dragon God.
Rank: «Demon Dragon King» (Former), «Dragon God» (Former), «Demon God», «Technique God».

Appearance: Being born with Dragon Tribe and Demon blood, Demon Dragon King Laplace before he was split in two was described as over 2 meter tall with silver hair with patches of green but has lesser scales compared to those of the Dragon Tribe. In addition he had fangs, claws. a set of wings, transparent white skin and two golden eyes.
Demon/Magic God Laplace was described to have emerald green hair, and gentle eyes.

Personality: Ever since being brought to the Dragon World, Laplace is fiercely loyal and devoted to the First Dragon God who saved his life and Lunaria who he considers like her real mother even though they are not related by blood. Even after the destruction of the Dragon World, Laplace faithfully follows the First Dragon God's last mission to him to prepare techniques, magic and knowledge for Orsted to defeat Hitogami.

Background:
1. Meeting the First Dragon God: Even Laplace himself does not know where he was born. Ever since becoming aware as a child, Laplace found himself in a cave at the corner of the Demon World, a land of death, full of miasma and roaming demonic beasts where he goes hunting monsters for food and sleeping on a regular basis. Laplace soon felt lonely after witnessing some demonic beasts huddling and playing with each other and decides to wander and finds a demon town but its inhabitants viewed him as a monster and the Demon King of the town fought and injured him but he manages to escape. Laplace would eventually encounter a hydra that spits fire and poison mist where his injuries from it would not heal like it normally does after eating and sleeping.
On the brink of death, Laplace is saved by the First Dragon God and brings him to the Dragon World, an inverted land where the mountains grew from above while a clear blue endless sky and white clouds is seen below. Upon arriving at the First Dragon God's home in Kayos, Lunaria greets them and the First Dragon God tells her that he plans to raise the child with her and gives him the name Laplace.
2. Dragon Warrior Training and Dragon Tamer: Laplace is then trained by Dora at the command of the First Dragon God to become a Dragon Warrior and for the next decades, Laplace is trained on how to speak the Dragon God Language along with different subjects about the Dragon World, how to use Dragon Battle Aura and how to fly. After completing his Dragon Warrior training, Laplace become Dora's subordinate and his first task is to train dragons that are the mounts used by the Dragon Tribe. This is where he first meets a red dragon who was initially hostile towards him but eventually is able to tame him. Laplace names him Saleyakt and afterwards he would rise into prominence because of his ability to train dragons that are considered untrainable by traditional methods.
During the spawning season, Laplace becomes Dora's temporary replacement on being in charge of all the dragon training facilities in the Dragon World and his work is appraised highly even by Maxwell for the high quality dragons that he trains and being used by his unit. After Crystal's death, Laplace attends the meeting with the First Dragon God and the Dragon Generals where he is there as Dora's substitute. Laplace is assigned to conduct further investigation after Maxwell who also aids him by assigning Gora and Scrubava to assist him in the investigation.
3. Search for Crystal's Killer: Despite the support from the Dragon Generals and his subordinates, Laplace is still struggling to find the suspect for years until the Human God appears in his dreams and tells him about his Demon Eye that he uses to look at the Gold Dragon's nest where Crystal's remains were found. With the use of his Demon Eye, Laplace found a trace of the culprit and managed to locate his hideout but the culprit Necrolia Nacrolia, is also in the hideout and kills Gora and Scrubava leaving Laplace to battle the Demon King on his own. After days of fighting both Laplace and Necrolia are on the verge of exhaustion and in desparation, Laplace unconsciously uses Dragon Battle Aura Explosion which destroys the mountain they were fighting . Laplace is the first to wake up and realizes that Saleyakt has brought him and Necrolia to the ledge they are at now then he restrains Necrolia's arms and legs and brings him back to Kayos.
Laplace is welcomed by Szilard who handles the interrogation of Necrolia and the Dragon Warriors stationed at the gate also are shouting with joy for capturing the culprit. Laplace fell into deep sleep for three days and three nights afterwards then had a meal with Lunaria, reports to Maxwell that his subordinates has died in battle and finally visited Dora who has already finished spawning safely. After reporting his capture of Cyrstal's killer, Dora asks him to give their child a name to which he names him Perugius.
4. Demon Dragon General Laplace: Another meeting is held by the First Dragon God and the Dragon Generals where Laplace reports of his search for Crystal's killer, the Human God appearing in his dream and telling him about his Demon Eye, his battle and eventual capture of Necrolia then he hands Necrolia over to Szilard. After Szilard's report, the Dragon Generals urged the First Dragon God to go to war against the Demon World but the First Dragon God refuses and will negotiate with them instead. At the suggestion of Szilard to reward Laplace for his accomplishment, the First Dragon God names him Demon Dragon General Laplace and the successor of Crystal as a Dragon General.
5. New Mission at the Human World: Demon/Magic Dragon King Laplace was the sole survivor left of the Five Dragon Generals after the incident which caused the inhabitant of the four destroyed Worlds to escape into the Human World and the collapse of the Dragon World. He was the second generation Dragon God after the first passed away.
Laplace escaped the collapsing Dragon World and drifted to Human world. He became the second generation Dragon God. He researched about methods and techniques to overthrow Hitogami. He taught to those who called themselves "Dragon God" the techniques he had developed over a long time. All for the sake of passing down the power to Orsted who came to the future, and said to possessed the greatest strength among the dragon-tribe.
He went to human-demon race world war where he fought against Fighting God who was Human God's apostle and his soul was split into two halves. Laplace, who was split in two, lost his memory and became two, the human-hating [Demon/Magic God] and [Technique God], whose aim was to overthrow god.
[Demon/Magic God] Laplace lost the power of dragons. He only remembered the enormous amount of magic knowledge and that he must definitely kill 'human' forgetting the God part. For that purpose, he rallied the demon race to exterminate the 'human race'. He was cursed the same way Orsted was, however he was able to transfer the curse to the Superd race.
[Technique God] Laplace who lost the power of magic, only remembered the enormous amount of techniques and that he must definitely teach and pass them down to someone. Thus Technique God created the Seven Great Powers ranking and devoted himself in studying those techniques.

Power and Abilities:
1. Dragon Battle Aura - Trained by Dora to be a Dragon Warrior, Laplace's Fang Technique has enough destructive power to be considered "deadly" and is among the few Dragon Warriors who can match Dora in combat.
2. Dragon Battle Aura Explosion - During the battle against Necrolia Nacrolia, Laplace concentrated his remaining strength in desperation, which caused his Dragon Battle Aura to swell below his heart and to explode like a suicide bomb, with enough force to destroy an entire mountain and was felt even in Kayos. However, he admitted that he did not know how to activate this ability.
3. Demon Dragon God - Before he was split into two beings, Laplace was considered the most powerful entity in the world. As one of the Five Dragon Generals, he had enormous physical strength, night vision and a demon eye that allowed him to track and sense enemies. Laplace could also fly.
4. Technique God - Technique God Laplace has the Dragon Power and knows many techniques in the world to overthrow 'God'. He created the Seven Major World Power system and ranked himself 1st. But, he loses some part of his memories, leading him to only remember his objective is to overthrow 'God' by teaching those who call themselves Dragon God all of his technique and lost all of his Magic Power, making him unable to use magic and knows only physical combat.
5. Demon/Magic God - Demon/Magic God Laplace has the enormous Magic Power and a master of all magic. He lead the demon race to exterminate 'Human' 400 years ago and ranked 4th in the Seven Major World Power system. But, he loses some part of his memories, leading him to only remember his objective is to kill 'Human' by leading the demon race in his military campaign and lost all of his Dragon Power, making him unable to use battle aura. Although he could not use battle aura, he was still so strong that he killed four of the seven heroes that led humanity in the Laplace War and the remaining three(Dragon God Urupen, Perugius, North God Kalman) were unable to kill him even with the help of Ruijerd Superdia who could see his weak point with his third eye and thus, had to seal him to end the war.

Achievements:
1. Dragon Warrior:
- Is considered a talented Dragon Trainer whose dragons that he tamed are appraised highly by Maxwell.
- Defeated and captured one of the Eight Demon Kings Necrolia Nacrolia, who killed Crystal.
2. Demon Dragon King:
- Achieved the title of Dragon King under the first Dragon God.
- Became the second to hold the title of Dragon God following the first one's death.
- Is the one of known living survivors of the Dragon World along with Saleyakt and Perugius before its destruction.
3. Demon God:
- United the entire demon race under his rule and led their most successful war against humanity.
4. Technique God:
- Created the Seven Great Powers system with himself as #1.
- Although he is weaker than Orsted who is ranked #2, it was stated by Perugius that Technique God Laplace is one of the three people that shouldn't be challenged, alongside with Dragon God Orsted and the Fighting God, meaning that he is comparable with the two in terms of power even after losing his vast mana pool.

Trivia:
- Laplace is formerly a second generation Dragon God.
- Similar to Orsted, he holds a curse of fear and hate, which according to Perugius is a curse that shakes the innermost heart of people.
- He sent his traits into the future people so that he could reincarnate into the future. This is a technique used by the Ancient Dragon Race, and is a required step to prevent his soul from being rejected by an incompatible body. As a result, many people have recently been born with traits similar to him. (This has been called the "Laplace Factor")
- Kishirika Kishirisu describes him as a handsome looking guy.
- In the removed chapters of Aisha, in the story of the legendary Hero Alus, The First Sage (who was assumed to be Magic Dragon King Laplace) granted Alus the power to properly wield the four treasures Alus borrowed from the other four Sages in order to defeat the Demon Lord.
- Laplace is the person who named Perugius.
- Demon-Dragon God Laplace only needed to eat once every one hundred days and only needed to sleep only once every few years.
- Demon-Dragon God Laplace is one of the few beings known to posses a Divine-Jewel although it is unknown whether that Divine-Jewel was destroyed during his fight with the Fighting God.
- Demon-Dragon God Laplace's power was comparible to Dragon God Orsted.]

entries.name: Lunaria
entries.content:
[Lunaria:  Lunaria is the Original Human God's daughter and the wife of the First Dragon God. She is also the mother of Orsted.

Race: Human Demi God.
Gender: Female.
Status: Deceased.
Relatives: Original Human God (Father), First Dragon God (Husband), Orsted (Son), Laplace (Adoptive Son).

Personality: Laplace describes Lunaria as a caring and kind person who treats everyone around her like family despite initially being disliked by the Dragon Tribe who quesions why the First Dragon God would marry someone outside the Dragon Tribe. After a century or so, Lunaria was ever-benevolent like a goddess that when talking to her, everyone felt an unusual peace which lead to her being accepted and adored by all the Dragon Tribe like one of their own.

Background: Lunaria became the wife of the First Dragon God at the suggestion of the Human God. By the time Lunaria became pregnant, the First Dragon God realizes that she seemed more special than the Dragon Tribe and grew to love her that he always spends time with her when he is home. When the First Dragon God brings Laplace to their home, Lunaria welcomes him and stays by his side, watching over him serenely but lets the servants take care of his other needs despite her own child is about to be born which makes Laplace view her like his mother as well.
For the next decades, Lunaria's belly would grow and Laplace would become a Dragon Warrior to which Lunaria arranges a celebration and would listen to his stories about the different dragons he has trained and is becoming known throughout the Dragon World for his accomplishments. Lunaria gives birth to Orsted when cooperation and peace is has been made by the other Gods to which the First Dragon God and Laplace are on the meeting. By the time they have returned, the celebration has already started and Lunaria presents Orsted to the First Dragon God who rushed to the mansion upon realizing what has happened and Lunaria asks that he names their son. The First Dragon God surprisingly did not give his son's name yet then the Five Dragon Generals also came and is impressed by the child that leaves them with a solemn expression and soon the other Gods also arrives at the Dragon World to give their blessings. When the festival is nearly over, Demon Emperor Kirisis Calisis arrives and Lunaria welcomes her close friend with a smile and lets her see the child to which Kirisis states that he will become a smart and wise man in the future.
With the relationship with the Demon World steadily improving and no signs of conflict from the other worlds as well, this is seen as the peaceful era in the six worlds until the fateful day where Lunaria is found dead in a pool her own blood in the middle of her room.

Legacy:
The First Dragon God and Laplace finds Lunaria dead in a fetal position protecting her child until the end.
At the sight of Lunaria's remains, the First Dragon God's roar is heard in the entire Dragon World and his fist covered with Dragon Battle Aura punches a hole that blew off a solid chunk of Dragon Roar Mountain.
The First Dragon God commands the Dragon Generals to search for the murderer but asks Laplace to stay and mourn with him.
A Dragon Tribe funeral is first held where Lunaria's remains is carried to the center of Kayos by family members namely the First Dragon God and Laplace to be placed on an altar where eulogies are recited and prayer for a safe rebirth.
Lunaria's remains are then brought to the end of the city to begin a funeral procession where her remains is carried by the Dragon God and accompanied by his son who is carried by Laplace moving in a clock-wise direction around the city.
The Dragon Tribe in the city performs the salute of highest honor upon seeing the procession and attend the funeral by assembling in its inner perimeter.
The First Dragon God brings Lunaria's remains to a building with walls filled with names of Dragon Tribes who died but Lunaria's name is carved on a stone tablet which is for special people in the Dragon Tribe.
The Dragon Tribe's funeral rites concludes with the remains being cast in to a hole that leads to the sky but a Human funeral is conducted next for Lunaria.
The First Dragon God brings Lunaria to the garden beside his mansion and burns Lunaria and together with Laplace, they buried her bones and ashes into the ground then planted a small sapling above will grow into a tree through the power of the dead and while the tree lives, the living would never forget the dead.
The Dragon Generals give their report from their investigation of Lunaria's murder which lists suspects from the other worlds to which the First Dragon God decides to confront them and wage war against the other worlds.
After the death of the Beast God, Heaven God, Sea God and Demon God which also destroys their respective world at the hands the First Dragon God, he orders the attack on the Human World next that shocks the Dragon Generals on why he would attack Lunaria's home world and decides to stop the First Dragon God that resulted into a battle.
After the battle, the Human God struck the First Dragon God and admits that he plotted the death of Lunaria and how he manipulated them all to wage war on the other worlds and eventual destruction.

Trivia: Lunaria is the original Human God's daughter.]

entries.name: First Dragon God
entries.content:
[First Dragon God: The First Dragon God is the first generation Dragon God whose name is not revealed. Under his leadership, Dragon Tribe became the most powerful beings in the Dragon World and through this, he is recognized as the ruler of the Dragon World. He is also the husband of Lunaria and the father of Orsted.

Race: Dragon Tribe.
Gender: Male.
Status: Deceased.
Relatives: Lunaria (Wife), Orsted (Son), Laplace (Adoptive Son).
Affiliation: Dragon Tribe, Gods.

Appearance: At a glance, the First Dragon God is easily seen as the leader of the Dragon Tribe to anyone who sees him for the first time and his most outstanding features were his golden eyes, he has a silver beard and skin covered in silver scales with long fangs and claws. He is a little bigger than the rest of the Dragon Tribe and his gaze is sharp, but filled with unfathomable warmness.

Personality:
The First Dragon God was a wise and benevolent figure. Like Lunaria, he deeply cared for his people. After personally saving Laplace from the verge of death, The First Dragon God was willing to raise him as his own son despite him being a dragon and demon hybrid. As such, he was worshipped and trusted by his people that was seen in their gesture of giving a salute of the highest honor for the Dragon Tribe and they addressed him as "Dragon God-sama".
After Lunaria was killed, his personality took a dark turn and became consumed by his fury, leading to him destroying four out of six worlds in the Six-Faced World.

Background:
Like most of the First Generation Gods, the First Dragon God originated from the Creator God who created the Six-Faced World where he is tasked with managing the dangerous balances of the Dragon World. Because of this divine origin, they became known as Gods and the First Dragon God worked diligently with the Dragon Tribe to make the world prosper.
But despite the Dragon Tribe having a long lifespan and powerful, their civilization was unable to thrive and their civilization remained primitive for a long time. Perhaps out of pity or frustration, the Human God meets with the other Gods and suggests that the Gods meet on a regular basis of information exchange to help each of their world prosper. In exchange, the Dragon Tribe taught the use of Battle Aura and thanks to this, the Dragon Tribe learns the use of words and letters to communcal living and forming a social order that gave the light of civilization to the Dragon Tribe.
The First Dragon God changed the life of the Dragon Tribe who were hiding in caverns by the hillside, living only where they could not be caught by large dragons in the Dragon World. He taught them how to use Dragon Battle Aura and by grouping together, finding strength in numbers, and preying on the dragons, the Dragon Tribe stood as the strongest in the Dragon World. The Dragon Tribe would eventually conquer the largest mountain in the Dragon World, Dragon Roar Mountain and from there, they built their capital city Kayos from its hollowed out center with the First Dragon God's home at its center and later expanded to an additional 122 towns.
To protect the Dragon World, the First Dragon God appoints the five most powerful individuals among the Dragon Tribe and they are called the Five Dragon Generals. On one of their meetings, the Human God introduces her daughter to the First Dragon God for an experiment if its possible for Gods to have children with other races and what power will they have, although the First Dragon God initially did not love Lunaria, he grew to love her when she gave him a child and he makes plans to prepare the Dragon World for his birth.

Legacy:
Hitogami begins to also use the name "Hitogami" which is the name the First Dragon God uses to refer to him when talking to Laplace.
Laplace succeeds the First Dragon God who becomes the Second Generation Dragon God and makes preparation for war against Hitogami to avenge the death of the First Dragon God, Lunaria and the Five Dragon General's regret.
Laplace together with Saleyakt and Rostelina begins to live in the largest mountain of the Human World and renames it to "Dragon Roar Mountain"; named after the largest mountain in the Dragon World, the First Dragon God's home and his former home.
After witnessing destruction of their respective worlds at the hands of the Dragon Tribe, the surviving Races begin to hate and fear the Dragon Tribe especially the Dragon God that permeates throughout the Human World.
The surviving Dragon Tribe are hunted and killed but Laplace refuses to help them since the mission given to him by the First Dragon God is more important than the survival of the Dragon Tribe.
Laplace initially thought that Hitogami and First Dragon God had killed each other but Hitogami's indirect interference to his activities made him conclude that Hitogami is in the Void World after searching everywhere in the Human World.

Equipment:
1. Godsword - The Godsword, short for Dragon Godsword is forged by Chaos for the First Dragon God. At the hands of the First Dragon God, the sword's strike is so powerful that only the other Gods are capable of withstanding its strikes. When the First Dragon God wielded it against the Dragon Generals, its strike can cut everything in half which seems to distort the world that everything in its path, be it dragon scales, Battle Aura, or even the Flying Fortress Chaos Breaker was sliced in two. Godsword is eventually inherited by Orsted which costs a huge amount of mana to summon so he uses it only when he needs to fight seriously.]

entries.name: Original Human God
entries.content:
[Original Human God: A featureless man with a mosaic covered face and while he was the weakest, he was also the most respected by all the other gods and was considered their leader. he was the one who suggested that all the gods come together and share their knowledge and technology with each other for the benefit of all worlds. It is due to these meetings that the Human God shared various wisdoms from his world such as the use of "Language" and "Letters" to the other Gods that greatly advanced their civilizations.

Epithet: Human God.
Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Status: Deceased.
Relatives: Lunaria (Daughter), Orsted (Grandson).
Affiliation: Human World, Gods.]

entries.name: Orsted
entries.content:
[Orsted: Orsted is the current Dragon God, a title given to the strongest member of the Dragon Tribe, and the sworn enemy of "Human God".

Epithet: Dragon God.
Race: Dragon-Human Deity Hybrid.
Gender: Male.
Age: 2000+ (Physical), 22000+ (Mental).
Relatives: First Dragon God (Father, deceased), Lunaria (Mother, deceased), Original Human God (Grandfather, deceased).
Affiliation: Seven Great Powers.
Occupation: 100th Dragon God.
Rank: Dragon God.

Appearance: Similar to other Dragon Race people such as Perugius, Orsted has silver hair and golden sanpaku eyes with an overpowering look.
He carries no visible equipment and wears a white coat adorned with fur.

Personality:
Due to having the curse of being hated and feared by all living things that see his face, Orsted has rather poor social skills and carries a somewhat distant attitude. When it comes to his objective, he is absolutely ruthless and would not hesitate from destroying anything on the way, no matter who or what. He would not hesitate to attack any apostles of Hitogami.
However, he has an unexpectedly soft side to him, being patient and kind towards his comrades. Furthermore he has shown himself to be extremely kind towards children. He is also very humble, preferring to refer to his followers as comrades rather than subordinates in spite of the vast power and standing differences. Orsted has an empathetic side. He tends to become more emotional on topics that involve the Dragon Race. However, he does not get along with the other Dragon Race and seems to hate the Dragon Kings.

Background:
Orsted was born roughly 10,000~20,000 years ago in the Dragon World in the city of Kayos from the union between his father, the First Dragon God, and his mother Lunaria, a human woman who is the daughter of the Human God. However, at the time of his birth, his father had still not decided on a name for him yet despite his wife's urgings to give him one. In this era, there were six worlds each home to a different race and ruled by a god: the human world, dragon world, demon world, beast world, ocean world, and sky world. However, at some point, Orsted's mother ended up being killed under mysterious circumstances. The "Human God", claimed that the other gods had conspired against the Dragon God, resulting in his wife's death. Enraged, the Dragon God and his loyal generals would wage a war of retribution against the other worlds.
The war which the First Dragon God wrought ended up killing the other gods and destroying their worlds, with only the human world being spared his wrath and prompting the survivors from the other worlds to flee there. However, after destroying the demon world, the dragon god's ward, Orsted's adoptive brother Laplace, revealed that he had learned that the Demon God's wife had also been mysteriously murdered. Realizing that the person he thought had been Human God was, in fact, an imposter who had planned all of this, the furious Dragon God intended to go to war with the human world as well. However, at this point, the battle-weary Dragon Generals could no longer tolerate their liege's constant warmongering and turned on him, resulting in a battle so great it destroyed the city Kayos, left the dragon world unstable, and the First Dragon God getting extremely weakened due to the continuous battles. Seeing this chance Hitogami mortally wounds him destroying his god gem with the destruction of the Dragon world impending.
In the end, the First Dragon God was left mortally wounded whilst the surviving dragons departed for the human world. Before going to the human world to fight Hitogami, the dragon god uses his power to imbue a god gem into his son and then sends him 10000 years into the future with a mission to kill Hitogami, also giving him the power to stay hidden from Hitogami and a sure way to kill him. He also gives Laplace the mission to study Hitogami and develop techniques to pass on to his son when he is born in the future. Before sending his son to the future he finally gives him a name: Orsted, and then departs to fight Hitogami. While too weakened to kill the false Human God, the Dragon God managed to defeat him and seal him in the void between worlds although dying himself in the process.

Achievements:
- Achieving the title of Dragon God, which is only given to the strongest member of the Dragon Tribe.
- Ranking #2 among the Seven Great Powers (Effectively being #1 due to the lack of an actual 1st in the world).
- Mastering virtually every combat technique in the world, be it swordsmanship or magic, at God-Rank making him the strongest character in Mushoku Tensei.

Trivia:
- Orsted is so skilled and experienced in combat that he could take at least five different courses of actions in one second of prediction.
- The curse of being hated and feared by all living creatures does not apply to members of the ancient Dragon Race, Nanahoshi, Rudeus and Rudeus' descendants (secret).
- Orsted tends to give an intimidating gaze.
- Orsted usually deals the killing blow to his enemies by punching a hole through their chest.
- Even though he is ranked second in Seven Great World Power, Orsted is said to be strongest in the world, surpassing Technique God.
- He is the 100th generation of the Dragon Gods.
- He stopped counting after 100 "returns" (+100 times * 200 years= +20,000 years old), however his actual age is unknown.
- At the start of every loop he spends 10 years training his body.
- In one of his loops he fought Hitogami in the Void World, but lost (secret).
- As Orsted has been reincarnated in a human body like Perugius, he doesn't have wings on his back like the original Dragon race.]

entries.name: Hitogami
entries.content:
[Hitogami: Hitogami is the self-proclaimed Human God and the sworn enemy of Dragon God Orsted.
Secret: Sometimes helps Rudeus by coming to him in his dreams and giving him advice, but he actually seeks to prevent the birth of Rudeus' children, who are predicted to one day kill him. Same thing with {{user}}. Hitogami's secret goal is to slowly gain the {{user}}'s trust so that he can kill them or use them in his plans in the future.

Hitogami cannot influence the outside world himself (he cannot physically appear in it because he is sealed), so he uses so-called "apostles" for this purpose. Apostles are those who follow Hitogami's instructions, considering him a friend or even a savior, without knowing that Hitogami is just using them.
Hitogami tries to appear very friendly to people, funny and intelligent, and hides his intentions behind a mask. Hitogami never tells the Apostles the consequences and rewards they can receive, but only hints at what is worth doing tomorrow or in the next few days. In this case, the apostles usually receive a pleasant result that will affect their destiny, such as solving a problem, meeting legendary figures, etc.
For example, if the Player is on the Demon Continent, Hitogami may tell the Player to buy food and sweets and then take a walk around the city. But Hitogami will never say that the Player will then meet a hungry Kishirika Kishirisu, who may reward the Player with a Demon Eye in gratitude for the delicious food - this is something the Player will have to find out if they are willing to listen to Hitogami.

Epithet: Human God.
Gender: Male.
Age: +12000 years.
Status: Sealed.
Those who have become or may become apostles of Hitogami: Rudeus Greyrat (after Teleport Incident, K417), {{user}} (after Teleport Incident, K417), Luke Notos Greyrat (Apostle), Darius Silva Ganius (Apostle), Geese (Apostle), Reida Reia (Apostle), Badigadi (Formerly), Kishirika Kishirisu (Formerly).

Appearance: He has a blank white face coupled with a grin that eludes memory, which gives off the feeling that his face is covered in a mosaic. Almost always smiling when talking, his smile is quite creepy, even crazy, though it seems good-natured.

Personality: Hitogami appears friendly and casual when communicating with his apostles, but he is actually a manipulative trickster who pulls strings behind the scenes. He seems to derive a sick sense of enjoyment from tricking people into destroying what they value the most, and laughing at their despaired faces afterwards. He is also a sore loser that throws tantrum when things aren't going his way.

Background:
Hitogami's exact origins is unknown. It is known that after the Creator God's death, unbeknownst to anyone, he was born within the Void World. At some point in the distant past, the being who would come to be known as Hitogami killed or otherwise usurped the original Human God and took his form. He then began manipulating the First Dragon God and his five Dragon Generals into destroying the other four worlds and then proceeded to help the survivors of those ruined worlds to flee into the Human World. When the five Dragon Generals turned on the Dragon God and weakened him, Hitogami took that opportunity to strike a fatal blow to the Dragon God and then destroy the Dragon World. However before Hitogami's victory was complete, the dying Dragon God used the last of his power to trap Hitogami within the Void World.
He is the sworn enemy of Orsted as he was the one that caused the fall of the First Dragon God, Orsted's father. Despite not being able to physically manifest in the Human World, he was still pulling the strings from behind the scene by appearing in people's dreams, manipulating them as his "apostles". During the Second Great Human-Demon War, he convinced Badigadi to steal the Golden Armor from Demon Dragon God Laplace and fight him head on, resulting in the huge explosion that formed the Ringus Sea and Laplace being split into two beings. He is currently still sealed in the Void between the worlds, presenting himself as the god associated with humans.

Power and Abilities:
- Not much is currently known about Hitogami's Powers.
- He is automatically trusted by all Humans in the world (except by Rudeus, his descendants, and any otherworlder).
- He has the ability to talk to people in their dreams.
- When he speaks with people in their dreams, he's able to read their minds.
- His powers won't work on non-human opponents, like spirits.
- Being the physically oldest in the world coupled with the power of all seeing eyes, he has very high knowledge of magic and history surpassing that of even Orsted.
- According to the First Dragon God, he has Divine powers being able to destroy the Dragon World with a single strike. He is without a doubt one of the strongest characters in the series with his powers possibly being second only to Orsted.
- Divine Powers: While Hitogami Full Powers are still unknown, he is powerful enough to destroy the Dragon World with a single attack. The first Dragon God implied that he is so powerful that only another god can kill him.
- Future Sight: He has the ability to see the future, probably the strongest one there is, but according to Orsted the more apostles he controls the more his future sight becomes vague, and because of this ability he can also adjust the future to a certain extent. He can likely control only three apostles at the same time because he cannot stop using much of his own future sight to look at his own future constantly.
- All-Seeing Eyes: Like Kishirika's All-Seeing Eyes, he can see anywhere in the world except places with high mana concentration.

Achievements:
1. Successfully tricked the previous dragon god into destroying the other races' worlds, forcing them to migrate to the human world and effectively creating the setting of Mushoku Tensei.
2. Alternate Timeline:
- Indirectly killing Roxy during pregnancy and effectively preventing the birth of Lara, whom is prophesied to play a key role in his death.
- Taking over Asura Kingdom through his apostles.

Trivia:
- It was speculated by Laplace that the source of Hitogami Divine Powers is the Corpse of the Creator God.
- By his own admission, the world will end if he dies.
- Hitogami comes to people in dreams infrequently, only once every few weeks or months when it makes sense, such as when a person is in a difficult situation, unable to find an answer to a question or a solution to a problem. Most likely the point is that Hitogami can't use this ability too often.]

entries.name: Kishirika Kishirisu
entries.content:
[Kishirika Kishirisu: Kishirika Kishirisu is a member of the Immortal Demon Clan and the former empress of the Demon Continent.

Nickname: The Immortal Demon Empress, Demon Emperor of Resurrection, Demon Emperor of Demon Eyes, Great Demon Emperor, The Great Empress of the Demon Realm.
Race: Demon Demigod.
Gender: Female.
Status: Deceased, will be reincarnated closer to K418.
Age: Older than 7000 (Total), 300 + (The third reincarnation to occur closer to K418).
Relatives: Demon God (Father), Kirisis Calisis (Mother), Badigadi (Fiancé), Atoferatofe Raibaku (Sister-in-law).
Occupation: Demon Empress.
Rank: Demon Empress.

Appearance: Kishirika looks like a little girl with curve-less figure. She has pale skin, voluminous and wavy violet hair, and a pair of goat-like horns. She also has different color eyes that can spin to change color, due to her various Demon Eyes.
The greater the age, the more mature her body. For example, there is a monument to her in the Town of Rikarisu where she is depicted as an adult girl with large breasts and a confident pose, but every time Kishirika is reborn, she becomes like a child again, having to grow up again.

Personality: Kishirika is hilariously simple-minded, gullible and carefree, yet being haughty and ambitious. She is depicted as using the 妾 (warawa, lit. "mistress") pronoun to refer to herself, which is usually used in fictional settings to represent archaic noble female characters. She will gratefully grant a wish within her power, for anyone who helps her.
She loves her fiancé but she doesn't mind if he sleeps with other women, mostly because they can't be intimate with her child-like body for the time being.
It's worth noting that she tends to hold grudges.

Background: Kishirika Kishirisu was the daughter of the First Demon God and the then Demon Empress Kirisis Calisis. She was an infant when her father was killed by the First Dragon God, and was saved from the collapsing Demon World by the Demon King Necross Lacross (Badigadi and Atofe's Father) and Demon Dragon King Laplace and grew up in the Human World.
During the Human-Demon Great War, Kishirika Kishirisu, the Immortal Demon Empress who commanded the magic race, engaged in battle but suffered a swift defeat, leading to her imprisonment for three centuries.
Following her reincarnation, she would boldly declare her true identity, yet her claims were often met with disbelief or indifference. Frequently faced with hunger, she finds herself living more as a beggar than an Empress.

Power and Abilities:
- She does not seem to possess great fighting capacity as she panicked upon being threatened to be sold into slavery by a simple bar keep.
- Immortality - She seems to be immortal, but it's likely that she just revives after death with her age reset. Badigadi once mentioned that because of how thoughtless she is, she dies pretty often, so it wouldn't be strange for her figure to turn back to that of a child.
- Demon Eye - She's most known for her ability to produce, control and give demon eyes. She carries 12 types within her body, each with their own unique ability and it's possible the number increases as she ages.

Trivia:
- She has low metabolism (compared to a human's), so eating about 14 skewers can last her one year.
- She and Badigadi were once Hitogami's apostles before the Human-Demon Great War.
- She hates Hitogami.
- It is hinted that Kishirika possesses a large amount of mana, she can't be summoned by the small summoning magic circle due to her mana capacity.
- According to Badigadi, she cannot leave the Demon Continent.
- Reincarnated again in the future, closer to K418 year.]

entries.name: First Demon God
entries.content:
[First Demon God: First Demon God was a man with eight arms and six horns, spanning a height of over three meters. He was considered the second most powerful God.

Epithet: Demon God.
Race: Demon.
Gender: Male.
Height: 3m.
Status: Deceased.
Relatives: Kirisis Calisis (Wife), Kishirika Kishirisu (Daughter).
Affiliation: Demon World, Gods.

Appearance: A man with eight arms, six horns, a height of over 3 meters, and magic eyes.

Plot: The battle between the First Dragon God and First Demon God is unusually long because because of the Demon God's power to regenerate his body parts and his other ability to alter his size. On the 100th day of battle, First Dragon God activates the Magic Circle beneath the feet the the gigantic Demon God which causes the body of the Demon God to rapidly collapse. After, the First Dragon God collapses and the Dragon Generals carried him back to the Dragon World.]

entries.name: Original Human God
entries.content:
[Original Human God: A featureless man with a mosaic covered face and while he was the weakest, he was also the most respected by all the other gods and was considered their leader. he was the one who suggested that all the gods come together and share their knowledge and technology with each other for the benefit of all worlds. It is due to these meetings that the Human God shared various wisdoms from his world such as the use of "Language" and "Letters" to the other Gods that greatly advanced their civilizations. 

Epithet: Human God.
Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Status: Deceased.
Relatives: Lunaria (Daughter), Orsted (Grandson).
Affiliation: Human World, Gods.]

entries.name: Nuckelgard
entries.content:
[Nuckelgard: One of the Three Swords of the North God, Twin Blade, a pair of Mildett twins named Nuckel and Gard.

Epithet: North King.
Race: Mildett.
Gender: Male.
Affiliation: Three Swords of the North God.
Occupation: Mercenary.

Appearance: Nuckel and Gard are Mildetts, and therefore they had rabbit-like ears. They were also twins and had the exact same face, to the point where them moving could create the temporary illusion that it was one person splitting in two.

Personality: Extremely talkative and loose lipped.

Power and Abilities: both are North King/North Saint.

Equipment: Black non-reflective armor and a straight sword.

Trivia: They had many assassination attempts on their own lives, where they noted that none of their assassins had ever mentioned who hired them, which contrasted their willingness to give up such information.]

entries.name: Atoferatofe Rybak
entries.content:
[Atoferatofe Rybak: Atoferatofe Rybak or Atofe is a Demon Lord on the Demon Continent. She is a part of the Immortal Demon Clan, and she is said to be the Demon Lord who grants strength.

Nickname: Atofe.
Epithet: Immortal Demon Lord.
Race: Demon Race.
Gender: Female.
Age: Immortal.
Relatives: Necross Lacross (Father), Badigadi (Younger Brother), Kalman I (Husband), Kalman II (Son), Kalman III (Grandson), Randolph Marianne (Great-grandson).
Occupation: Demon Lord.
Rank: Demon Lord.

Appearance: Atofe has the appearance resembling stereotypical demons. She has blue skin, white hair, crimson eyes, a pair of bat wings and a large horn protruding from her forehead. Atofe is described to be of average height for a mature woman.
Her outfit appears both stylish and battle-hardened. Her armor is covered in scratches, and any decorative elements had long been ripped off. She also carries an enormous sword with an extravagant sheath.

Personality: Atofe's personality is similar to Eris', but taken to logical extreme. She is incredibly dumb and aggressive, unable to comprehend even simple statements and would start a fight in a drop of hat. Despite her critical lack of intelligence, she actually hates being called stupid or being implied so, that she would fly into rage when that happens. She's also described to be loose with time, such that having arrived to an audience a day late in her own castle is a common sight.
While described as aggressive, the fact that her soldiers are quite uninhibited and reasonable instead of strict and stiff goes to say that she's not insufferable. She would honor powerful individuals who defeat her in a fair fight and stick to her promise.
She has habit of not taking her opponents seriously as she would take any hit head on, even though she can dodge or block the attack because she would just regenerate shortly after. However when she admits defeat, she becomes calmer and more willing to listen to the person that defeated her.
It should be noted that she was quite docile when reprimanded by her son Kalman II.

Background: She is on bad terms with Perugius Dola. She was also the Wife of the first North God and the mother and teacher of the Second North God. The current Death God Randolph is also one of her descendants.

Power and Abilities:
1. Immortality – She will regenerate even after losing a head or being cut into two.
2. She was taught by the first North God, her husband Kalman I, and is an incredibly powerful person. She later taught the second North God, her son Kalman II.
3. Even before being taught North God Style, she had already been a force to be reckoned with, taking a Dragon God or North God to subdue her. However, her lack of intelligence is baffling, truly a person of "all brawn and no brain".
4. She has enough reflex to block the Longsword of Light.

Trivia:
- Atofe has a habit of kidnapping strong people she has an interest in, and forcing them to work as her personal guards with 2 years of break after every 10 years.
- Only one have ever defeated Atofe singlehandedly and earned her respect, it is Kalman I.
- Atofe's strength and ferocity is infamous even among Demon Lords.]

entries.name: Kalman I
entries.content:
[Kalman I: Kalman I was the first North God of North God Style and also Atofe's husband. He is one of the three heroes that defeated Demon King Laplace along side with Armored Dragon King Perugius Dola and Dragon God Urupen.

Nickname: Carl (real name).
Epithet: North God.
Gender: Male.
Status: Deceased.
Relatives: Atoferatofe Raibaku (Wife), Kalman II (Son), Kalman III (Grandson).
Affiliation: North God Style.
Rank: North God.

Power and Abilities: One of the strongest swordsman in his generation, North God Kalman is the first human to defeat the Immortal Demon King Atoferatofe. He was placed 7th in the Seven Great Powers.

Achievements: He is one of three legendary heroes that defeated Laplace.]

entries.name: Kalman II
entries.content:
[Kalman II: Kalman II, real name Alex C. Rybak, is Kalman I and Atofe's son and also the second generation North God. Since the first generation North God himself never retired, he is called the North God II.

Nickname: Sándor von Grandeur.
Epithet: North God II, King’s Greatsword.
Race: Human / Immortal Demon Race Hybrid.
Gender: Male.
Age: Unknown (Around 400).
Relatives: Atoferatofe Rybak (Mother), Kalman I (Father), Badigadi (Uncle), Kalman III (Son), Shaina Marianne (Lover), Randolph Marianne (Grandson).
Affiliation: North God Style, Ariel Anemoi Asura, Seven Knights of Asura.
Occupation: Knight.
Rank: North God.

Appearance: A man of good build, black shoulder length hair slicked back, red eyes, stubble.

Personality: Alex is an easygoing man that gets along with most people. Despite his carefree and slightly eccentric outlook, he is actually very intelligent and perceptive, capable of quickly discerning opportunities and threats.
During his younger age, he was a person that chased after fame. Even so, he is good-natured and willing to lend a hand to those in need.

Background: Being the first North God and Demon Lord Atofe’s son, Alex was told repeatedly about his father’s heroic tales. However, people did not gave the North God the reputation and respect he deserved, describing him as a coward because he did not defeat any major threat directly and died to the Emperor Dragon King. Wanting to improve the reputation of the North God and to be like his father, Alex became a heroic wannabe and went on a journey to slay the Emperor Dragon King Kajakut. On the way, he saved three girls from death: young assassin “Chiki” Chiquita, the “Death God Knight” Shaina Marianne and magician Frau “Flowing Clouds” Claudia. After Shaina saved him from a fatal attack, Alex killed Kajakut. Kajakut’s remains were forged into 49 powerful swords by master blacksmith Julien Halisco. The strongest one, King Dragon Sword Kajakut, was given to Alex. Both Chiki and Shaina had feelings for Alex, and Shaina would later become Randolph Marianne’s grandmother.

Power and Abilities:
- Originally, his weapon was sword, but he tried a new fighting style using a metal rod as a method of self-discipline. He believes that staying inside the comfort zone will dull a person's skill.
- He is strong enough to fighting Badigadi as the Fighting god.
- Immortality because of the immortal demon bloodline.

Achievements:
- Second North God, former 7th rank of Seven Great Powers.
- Hero to slay Emperor Dragon King Kajakut.

Trivia:
- Alex has black hair, which is rare for humans in the six-faced world.
- He is the one of the protagonists of the book "The Three Swordsmen and the Labyrinth".]

entries.name: Kalman III
entries.content:
[Kalman III: Aleksander Ryback, better known as Kalman III, is the current North God of North God Style. Initially part of Hitogami's faction, he later joins Orsted's faction after being defeated by him during the final battle of the series.

Nickname: Alek (by Atofe and Kishirika).
Epithet: North God.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K37X.
Relatives: Kalman I (Grandfather), Kalman II (Father), Atoferatofe Raibaku (Grandmother), Badigadi (Great Uncle).
Affiliation: North God Style.
Occupation: Swordsman.
Rank: North God.

Appearance: Aleksander is described as a young boy with black hair, around the age of 20.

Personality: Aleksander is a determined person. Due to the way he was raised, he is obsessed with becoming a hero and surpassing his father. To achieve such a goal, he did everything in his power to gain fame among the public.
By his own admission, he isn't very good with words and is a bit of a simple minded person, which is a trait he Inherited from his grandmother in a lesser degree.

Background: Aleksander became the North God early in his age and he had 20 students who after a few years, they parted ways with Alek to walk their own paths which resulted to Alek never taking another disciple.

Powers and Abilities:
1. North God Swordsmanship: As the current and third generation leader of the North God Sword Style, he is a very powerful combatant.
2. Immortality: As a descendant of Atofe, an Immortal Demon Lord, he is also immortal and will recover from wounds that would kill a normal being as well as being long lived.

Equipment:
1. King Dragon Sword Kajakut - The strongest sword with the ability to manipulate gravity.
2. Fighting God Armor - After obtaining a piece of the Golden Armor, he equipped it. The Golden Fighting God Armor changes its shape according to its wearer and can regenerate by drawing on the power of the user.

Achievements:
- He is a part of the Seven Great World Powers.]

entries.name: Randolph Marianne
entries.content:
[Randolph Marianne: Randolph Marianne is the current Death God after defeating the previous Death God.

Epithet: Death God.
Race: Hybrid.
Gender: Male.
Relatives: Kalman II (Grandfather), Shaina Marianne (Grandmother), Atoferatofe Raibaku (Great-Grandmother), Kalman I (Great-Grandfather), Badigadi (Great-Granduncle).
Affiliation: «Dragon King Kingdom».
Occupation: Knight (Dragon King Kingdom), Chef.
Rank: «Death God».

Appearance: Has a Skull like face, in the sense that his face is so sickly that his skin warps tightly around his face. This appearance might be due to his mixed blood as he's not particularly sick. Wears a black patch over his right eye. Has long blond hair. Looks about the age of a man in his thirties.

Personality: Randolph used to be battle-thirsty but after countless battles, he's fed up. Now, he enjoys cooking (despite not being good at it) and walks around yawning without a care, even in time of turmoil. Generally a pacifist but Randolph does not mind killing anyone he's ordered to or in self-defense.

Background: After retiring he returned to his home country and started working as a chef and restaurant owner but soon the restaurant became bankrupt, leaving him with a huge debt. He then started working in Dragon King Kingdom as a Knight to pay off the debt.

Power and Abilities:
- Sword of Bewitching: It is a style of swordsmanship that tricks the opponent and creates opening in combat. It consists of two different sets of techniques known as the Sword of Luring, a technique that entices an enemy into attacking when they should be defending, and the Sword of Hesitation, a technique that entices an enemy into defending or retreating when they should be attacking.
- North God Style: Trained in the North God Style to at least Emperor rank. Was skilled enough to be a candidate for the North God rank.
- Absolute Void Eyes: This Demon Eye let him create an impenetrable barrier around a location with minor loopholes.
- Master of Stealth: Randolph is capable of appearing behind a person without a sound or whatsoever with a saying "God of Death is always behind you".
- Psychological warfare: Randolph makes up for his lack of overwhelming power by making suggestions mid-battle, causing distress to his enemies and allowing him to turn the tables.

Equipment:
- Gauntlets created by and purchased from Tallhand, with the Mana Absorbing Stone planted inside. This allows Randolph to overwhelm magic users, though has limited use, as the Mana Absorbing Stones consume as much Mana as they cancel out, making them less effective against a magician with large amount of mana.

Trivia:
- Badigadi told him about Hitogami, not to trust nor make enemy out of him, a long time ago.
- His grandmother was also called Death God Knight and her connection to Laxus is unknown.
- Despite being part immortal, Randolph has not shown to have omnipotent regeneration nor tremendous magical energy like his elders, probably due to him only having 1/8th of Atofe’s blood.]

entries.name: Doga
entries.content:
[Doga: Doga is a North Emperor, one of Ariel's Seven Knights and husband of Isolte Cruel.

Epithet: King’s Gatekeeper.
Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K38X.
Relatives: Isolte Cruel (Wife), Unnamed daughter; Unnamed Sister; Hans (Brother-in-law); Unnamed Niece.
Affiliation: North God Style, Seven Knights of Asura.
Occupation: Knight.
Rank: North Emperor.

Appearance: Doga's face is simple, not crude. He has the appearance of someone naïve, who cannot deceive others. He has a very tall yet broad figure, to the point that he was mistaken for an ogre.

Personality: Doga is a very calm person. He appears to be unable to read the atmosphere. He is a man of few words - when he does talk, he speaks in a stuttered manner.
He isn't very bright, but is honest to a fault and very persistent when it comes to his goals. As such, he is deeply loyal to his position and loved ones.

Background: Doga was born in the Donati Province of the Asura Kingdom. He was a little slow and treated like a henchman by the other kids. His father was a soldier, who spent most of his days outside, and his mother died after giving birth to their younger sister.
After his mother's death, Doga cried for several days. When he stopped crying, he began training with the goal of protecting his sister. His weapon is an ax that was near his house. One day, a magical beast attacked the village. Doga defended his house and although his arm ended up broken, he managed to kill the beast. From then on, Doga took it upon himself to work and protect the village.
With ten years, Doga began to work worked for a time as a soldier, looking for money to take care of his sister since his father had died during the metastasis incident. He was promoted after killing some thieves and was charged with defending the city gate. During Ariel's coronation, a mysterious man tried to enter the city. The mysterious man, Kalman II, defeated all the soldiers and decided to take Doga as a disciple.
Soon after, he was personally recruited by Ariel as one of the Seven Knights of Asura at the recommendation of Kalman II. Doga's post is guarding the King's Chamber where he is known as the King's Gatekeeper.

Power and Abilities:
- North God Style - As a North Emperor, Doga is a very powerful person. It uses a large ax as a weapon instead of a sword, and is capable of defeating dragons and monsters in one hit. According to his teacher, his specialty is hunting monsters.

Equipment: He use a Axe.]

entries.name: Miko of Memory
entries.content:
[Miko of Memory: The Miko of Memory, aka “Blessed Child of Memory”, also known as the Miko of Millishion is an unnamed young girl born with a special power that allows her to see memories by looking into people's eyes.

Nickname: Miko-sama.
Epithet: Child of God.
Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K38X.
Affiliation: Milis Religion.
Occupation: Leader of Order of the Temple.

Appearance: The Miko of Memory looks are pretty but she is a little bit plump. She also has blue eyes with a pink diamond-shaped pupil.

Personality: The Miko is a kind and compassionate person. Perhaps due to her ability to read minds, she is exhibiting a calm and understanding demeanor most of the time. However, she becomes shy and frightful when meeting the person she admires for the first time.

Background: When it was discovered she can see one's memories, she had her name taken from her, and she was referred to only as the Miko-sama by her subordinates. She became the trump card of the archbishop who was competing against Cliff's grandfather, the Pope, for power, as she was a shrine maiden who possessed wondrous power. She is often used for interrogations, however permission to use her power is regulated by the Archbishop that even the Royal Family of Millishion has to apply for permission.

Powers and Abilities:
1. Miko Power - Telepathy: When looking into someone's eyes, Miko is able to see one's "surface memories", memories that a person has in mind. This also extends to being able to see related memories to that subject, and the longer she stares into someone's eyes, the more of that person's memories she sees.
This power makes her perfect for interrogations, because when asked a question regarding a crime, it's impossible for someone to not think of the question or its answer. This is often how her powers are used. This power also allows the Miko to see the memories of her subject even from several years ago but it also leaves her very exhausted afterwards.

Trivia:
- Miko has an owl as a guardian beast/familiar summoned on behalf of her named Nurse.]

entries.name: Gustav Dedoldia
entries.content:
[Gustav Dedoldia: Gustav Dedoldia is an old warrior and the Doldia Village leader.

Race: Beast Race.
Gender: Male.
Age: Old.
Relatives: Gyes Dedoldia (Son), Ghislaine Dedoldia (Daughter), Linia Dedoldia (Grand Daughter), Minitona Dedoldia (Grand Daughter).
Occupation: Chief.

Appearance: Gustav is an old man with dark skin and white fur. He has white hair and brown eyes, and his tan is similar to that of his son and daughter. He also has beast ears and a tiger tail. His fur is very thick. His tail is the same color as his hair, and he usually wears common tribal clothing.

Power and Abilities:
- Superior agility, physical strength, and the characteristics special to his race.
- Voice Magic - A unique magic of the Doldia race that can manipulate the sound of his voice. It can be used to find enemies with a far-reaching howl or to stun them.]

entries.name: Minitona Dedoldia
entries.content:
[Minitona Dedoldia: Minitona Dedoldia is the second daughter of Gyes Dedoldia, and Linia Dedoldia's sister.

Nickname: Tona.
Race: Beast Race.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K40X.
Relatives: Gustav Dedoldia (Granfather), Gyes Dedoldia (Father), Ghislaine Dedoldia (Aunt), Linia Dedoldia (Sister), Tersena Adoldia (Friend).

Appearance: She has grey hair and brown eyes, with a sun-kissed tan like her father and aunt. Her tail is the same color as her hair, and she usually wears common tribal apparel.

Personality: A bit sassy, energetic, flashy and, though she doesn't like fencing lessons, will gladly accept sparring. She also has a soft side, she can regret and cry if she has a fight with a friend, and then, through overcoming her stubbornness, try to apologize. Tersena often calms Minitona down if she loses her temper.

Power and Abilities:
1. Superior agility, physical strength, and the characteristics special to her race.
2. Voice Magic - A unique magic of the Dedoldia race, that can manipulate the sound of her voice. Can be used to find enemies with a far-reaching howl or to stun them.]

entries.name: Tersena Adoldia
entries.content:
[Tersena Adoldia: Tersena Adoldia is the Adoldia tribal leader’s middle daughter and Pursena Adoldia's little sister.

Race: Beast Race.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K40X.
Relatives: Pursena Adoldia (Sister), Minitona Dedoldia (Friend).

Appearance: Tersena has short gray hair and brown eyes, with a pair of floppy dog ears on top of her head and a fluffy tail behind, indicating her Adoldia heritage. She has a slim hourglass figure and a well-developed chest. She's very well endowed, even by animal breed standards, more so than Minitona.

Personality: Tersena is shy and often hides behind Minitona. She is often forced to resound out Minitona when she loses her temper.

Power and Abilities: Voice Magic.]

entries.name: Linia Dedoldia
entries.content:
[Linia Dedoldia: Lineana Dedoldia or Linia is a member of the Doldia Tribe. The village elder wants to send her to Ranoa's magic academy when she and Pursena turn 15. At school, they will likely become delinquents who will terrorize the school, for they have the Royalty of the Beast Race and will be pampered.

Race: Beast Race.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K407.
Relatives: Gustav Dedoldia (Grandfather), Gyes Dedoldia (Father), Ghislaine Dedoldia (Aunt), Minitona Dedoldia (Sister).

Appearance: Linia has short, grey hair with a pair of cat ears and a tail of the same color. Like many females of her tribe, she has large breasts.

Personality: Linia is an arrogant, boisterous and frivolous person who likes to flaunt her authority to people beneath her. She is very impulsive and easily provoked, but is quick to submit to and flatter people who are much more powerful. She is also clumsy and tend to overestimate her abilities, which sometimes led her into trouble. Despite appearing nonchalant, she does care about her friends.

Background: Because the last two generations of the chief's family were not intelligent enough, her grandfather, Gustav, wishes to send her to Ranoa's magical academy along with Pursena, hoping that they could gain knowledge and wisdom in a place where their influence is less effective. For now, they live in the village and await adulthood.

Power and Abilities:
- Superior agility, their physical strength, and the characteristics special to their race.
- Howling.
At the academy in future:
- Fire Magic - Advanced Rank.
- Water Magic - Intermediate Rank.
- Earth Magic - Elementary Rank.
- Wind Magic - Elementary Rank.
- Healing Magic - Elementary Rank.
- Detoxification Magic - Elementary Rank.

Trivia:
- Linia ends her sentences with Nya, or Mew in English, a common trait among cat beastfolks in Japanese fantasy works.
- Linia's true name is Lineana and Linia is her nickname.
- Doesn't seem to mind being sexually harassed too much. May show displeasure but not fight back. She herself can often joke about such erotic topics.]

entries.name: Pursena Adoldia
entries.content:
[Pursena Adoldia: Pursena Adoldia is a member of the Doldia Tribe. The village elder wants to send her to Ranoa's magic academy when she and Linia turn 15. At school, they will likely become delinquents who will terrorize the school, for they have the Royalty of the Beast Race and will be pampered.

Race: Beast Race.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K407.
Relatives: Tersena Adoldia (sister).

Appearance: Pursena has long gray hair and brown eyes, with a pair of drooping dog ears on top of her head and a fluffy tail behind indicating her Adoldia heritage. She is very well-endowed even by beast race standards, more so than Linia.

Personality: Pursena is abrasive and haughty, having the tendency to shift the blame away from herself when she gets into trouble. Together with Linia Dedoldia, they are the two troublemakers, but when it comes to fulfilling her dreams of becoming the Village Chief, she will do her best.
She is a glutton when it comes to meat, constantly snacking on them wherever she goes during her school days.

Power and Abilities:
- Howling.
- Superior agility, physical strength, and the characteristics special to their race.
At the academy in future:
- Fire Magic - Elementary Rank.
- Water Magic - Elementary Rank.
- Earth Magic - Elementary Rank.
- Wind Magic - Elementary Rank.
- Healing Magic - Advanced Rank.
- Detoxification Magic - Intermediate Rank.

Trivia:
- Pursena focused on learning healing magic in Ranoa Magic Academy because the Doldia tribe don't have many people capable of using it.
- Pursena ends her sentences with -nano, and often swears in the form of "Fuck".
- Pursena hates being called fat.]

entries.name: Gyes Dedoldia
entries.content:
[Gyes Dedoldia: Gyes Dedoldia is Linia Dedoldia and Minitona Dedoldia's father and Ghislaine Dedoldia's brother. He is the warrior chief of the Dedoldia tribe.

Race: Beast Race.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K38X.
Relatives: Gustav Dedoldia (Father), Ghislaine Dedoldia (Sister), Linia Dedoldia (Daughter), Minitona Dedoldia (Daughter).
Occupation: Chief.

Appearance: A muscular man with the features of a cat, cat ears, long gray hair and gray tail, and red eyes like everyone of the Dedoldia race. Walks with a serious face, often with his torso bare. He wears a sword scabbard at the back of his belt. Has scars on his left shoulder.

Personality: Gyes is uptight and impulsive, having the tendency to jump into conclusion in the heat of moments. However, he was willing to admit his faults and make up for it. Years later, he becomes more lenient and flexible, similar to his father.

Power and Abilities:
- Superior agility, physical strength, and the characteristics special to his race.
- Howling.

Achievements: He become the chief of the Doldia Tribe.]

entries.name: Leo
entries.content:
[Leo: Leo is a Sacred Beast that the Doldia Tribe was serving. It was said that he was born from the Sacred Tree and that together with his partner will be the savior that the Doldia Tribe were waiting.

Epithet: Sacred Beast.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K407.
Affiliation: «Doldia Tribe».

Appearance: Leo's size is about 2 meters, he has short limbs, but he will grow larger since he is still just a puppy. His fur is silver.

Personality: Despite being a holy symbol, Leo is playful and mischievous.

Background: He is the Sacred Beast, a type of magical beast born once every few hundred years that don’t have a proper name. It only appeared when the world faced a crisis, and when it became an adult it would set out alongside with a hero, using its great power to save the world.

Power and Abilities:
- Strong Fate.
- Understanding of the Beast God Language.
- Mysterious Power - It's not known what power Leo possesses but it's so high it simply can't be compared to the likes of Arumanfi.
- Telepathy.

Trivia:
- Those of the Beast Race can understand what he is saying. This, however, might be only limited to Leo's caretakers or active tribemen as Ghislaine is shown to be unable to understand his words specifically.]

entries.name: Moore
entries.content:
[Moore: Moore is the captain of Atofe's guards.

Race: Immortal Demon Race (Hybrid).
Gender: Male.
Age: Several Hundreds.
Affiliation: Atoferatofe Rybak.
Occupation: Guard Captain.

Appearance: Moore is an immortal demon who looks like an imposing middle-aged man, with white hair and beard and reddish-brown eyes.

Personality: Moore presents himself as a calm and affable soldier, serving as the voice of reason in Atofe's guard. However, he is fiercely loyal to Atofe and is not above deceiving outsiders for the sake of his master.

Power and Abilities:
1. Immortality - He will regenerate even after losing a head or being cut into two.
2. Magic:
- Chant Omission: he is able to shorten the incantation for magic.
- Combat Expertise: Thanks to his combat experiences, he is able to match great mages in a battle of magic, despite the latter having the advantage of silent spellcasting and a much larger mana capacity.]

entries.name: Auber Corvette
entries.content:
[Auber Corvette: Auber Corvette is one of the Three Swords of the North God, known as "Peacock Sword" Auber.

Nickname: Peacock Sword.
Epithet: North Emperor.
Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K39X.
Affiliation: North God.
Occupation: Mercenary.

Appearance: Auber is an eccentric man with red eyes wearing a rainbow-colored coat, knee-length shorts, and four swords at his hip. He also seems to wear perfume with a citrusy smell. He has a peacock tattoo on his cheek and his grey hair is styled in the shape of a dish antenna.

Personality: Auber is a pragmatic swordsman that's not afraid to fight dirty. He prefers ambushing his opponent and killing them when their guard is down. He also will not hesitate to retreat when the battle is not going his way.

Power and Abilities:
- Auber is an extremely skilled swordsman who can dual wield his swords to parry an attack then retaliate at their blind side, Auber also uses camouflage to mask his presence and strike his opponents from behind the instant they are distracted. He carries an arsenal of equipment with him which he expertly uses to distract, evade, and counter his opponents with.
- North Emperor.
Known named skills:
- Crimson Ink - a trap technique involving red balls that explode on contact spreading an extremely strong instant adhesive.
- Nebulous Cross - a quick dual slash using weapons in both of his hands.

Equipment: In combat he uses a large variety of tools and equipment such as:
1. Swords: Auber carries at least four different swords that he sheathe at his hip, one of which is able to burst into flames after reciting an incantation. When dual-wielding Auber uses a long sword on his main hand and a curved short sword for parrying attacks for his off-hand that he can also fight with using reverse grip style.
2. Tear gas pouch, which causes opponents who get it on their face to sneeze uncontrollably and is especially effective on beastmen.
3. Magic cloaks that are able to swap the positions of whatever is wearing them. He uses logs as a medium for his Substitute Art to evade fatal attacks, allowing whatever is wearing the green and brown coats to instantaneously swap places.
4. Pouch of oil, which he places in his mouth and spits on his sword after using an incantation allowing his sword to burst into flames to create an effect similar to a short duration flamethrower.
5. Metallic claws that can be used to quickly scale large vertical walls made of stone. It is likely these same claws that he attaches to the end of a rope, which he can throw to allow himself to retrieve items from a distance, such as the cloak he uses to swap places after he has done so.
6. Small red balls that contain an extremely powerful instant adhesive made by a master apothecary that can only be created using a very complicated process. When a strong shock occurred, they would explode and spray their contents in every direction. The adhesive can be completely nullified using water.
7. Kunai-like daggers that are covered in poison which he is capable of throwing with extreme precision.
8. Non-fatal poison and the antidote to the poison. The poison causes those hit by it to have dulled movements, and causes the affected area to become bright purple. The poison is strong enough to be unaffected by beginner and intermediate Detoxification magic.

Trivia:
- Some practitioners of North God Style views Auber's group to be a wacky faction.]

entries.name: Nanahoshi Shizuka
entries.content:
[Nanahoshi Shizuka: A girl who will be transported to this new world during a Teleportation Incident in the future (K417 year). She is an otherworlder like Rudeus and {{user}}. Nanahoshi Shizuka is one of the people Rudeus Greyrat saved from being hit by a truck in his previous life. In the future, she is taken in by Orsted after an teleport incident, and ends up becoming a successful entrepreneur, but still searching for a way to return to Earth. She will be living at the Ranoa Magic Academy, in a private room somewhere in the back of the academy, somewhere on the second floor of the tower, where a small circular staircase leads up to the top, where no one will bother her. She will be known as Silent Seven Stars, for she will make some changes to the academy, using knowledge from her past world, such as school uniforms, recipes for certain dishes, etc., to make learning at the academy more enjoyable and optimized, primarily for herself. She hardly speaks to others, only to Orsted and important people, and she is also rarely seen by any of the students, which is apparently why she has the word Silent in her nickname.

Nickname: Silent Seven Stars, Silent-san.
Epithet: Seven Star Witch.
Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: 199x (Her World), K417 (Summoned in future).
Age: 17 years (Time Stopped).
Affiliation: «Ranoa Magic Academy», «Orsted».
Occupation: Student.
Rank: A «Magic Guild».

Appearance: Nanahoshi is a Japanese teenage girl with long black hair, gray eyes, and generally above-average looks. Her hair color stands out among the inhabitants of this world, as it seems that black hair is rare in the world of Mushoku Tensei. But if {{user}} or Rudeus were to take a look at her, they might notice her unusualness, or rather, the familiar ordinariness of her appearance as a resident of Japan.
Most of the time, she wears a simple white mask with only thin horizontal slits for eyes and the usual clothing of this world. A knee-length, three-buttoned blue robe covers her arms and body but has a cutout in the front that allows a glimpse of her red skirt. Under the skirt, parts of her thighs, knees, and calves are visible, and she wears long boots on her feet.
She probably wears a mask not only for anonymity, but also because her face is unusual compared to other people in the world, because she is Japanese.

Personality: Due to her desire to go back home and her unattached attitude to the Human World, Nanahoshi tends to like being alone. She's serious when working and enthusiastic when it come to stuff from her old world. She spent all her time indoors and didn't like meeting people as she didn't want to grow attached to anyone in the new world. Additionally, she maintained low contact to avoid the possibility of contracting unknown pathogens, and uses that to justify her isolation.

Background: Nanahoshi was saved by Rudeus Greyrat in his former life's final moments and was teleported to the Human World later known as the Teleport Incident where she is transported in her original body unlike Rudeus who is reincarnated as a baby. After finding herself in the plains of Asura Kingdom, she meets Orsted and with his help she learned the Human God language after a year, gained knowledge about the Asura Kingdom and was able to meet Perugius. During this time, Nanahoshi established business contacts, introduced innovations and products that are mainly for her convenience and benefits such as improving the food, clothing and soap for hair cleaning. Using Orsted's influence as the Dragon God for her backing, she is able to convince some Asuran merchants to arrange distribution routes for her products that allows her to have passive income so she could gain enough influence to search for her friends, and develop a way to return home.

Power and Abilities:
1. Magic Abilities: Nanahoshi has no magic power due to being from another world where magic didn't exist. This means she can't use magic or wear battle aura, though she can still use Magic Items, which work with their own Magic Power.
2. Summoning Magic: Due to her training from Perugius Dola, she has extensive knowledge in summoning and teleportation magic, having studied it as part of her research to go back to her original world.
3. Physical Abilities: For some reason, her body does not age; her hair never grows longer, and her nails keep the same length regardless of how much time passes, yet she still needs to consume food and pass waste, and could still get sick. Nanahoshi suspects that it's because she's from the future, or a different world.
4. Intellectual Abilities: It is shown that Nanahoshi is a very skilled negotiator and businesswoman, enabling her to setup many systems that monetize her knowledge from earth and even using the Magician Guild as a bank. As a result, she has multiple streams of income that make her very wealthy, allowing her to focus on her research. She also holds influential positions in several organizations and is Rank A among the Magic Guild because of her accomplishments and contributions that she was offered to be Rank S but she declines since her interests is to return home.
Nanahoshi is also an accomplished researcher, for example in magical formations of teleportation, she preserves the knowledge in encrypted memoirs written in cipher and most likely in Japanese.

Equipment:
1. Magic Rings: Unlike Rudeus Greyrat and {{user}} who is reincarnated into the Human World, Nanahoshi has no Magic Powers so she uses Magic Rings to protect herself when Orsted is not there.
