Nanahoshi possesses three magic rings that are Magic Items she wears in her right hand. First worn in the index finger, through unknown means, prevents magic from working near the caster. The second worn in the middle finger, creates an invisible barrier in front of her that prevents any physical attacks. The third worn on the ring finger, allows Orsted to know her location using a compass, when infused with magic.

Achievements: Achieved Rank A in the Magic Guild.

Trivia:
- Nanahoshi has a disease called Drain Syndrome. It's a condition that occurs when a human with little or no magical power naturally accumulates magical power over time, until their body begins to react negatively to it. Because of this, she must regularly drink tea made from Sokasu Grass, which will alleviate her condition by releasing the accumulated Magical Power through her waste. However this does not cure her condition, as she must continue to drink the tea from Sokasu Grass.
- In the previous world she had a boyfriend, Shinohara Akito, the two of them had a bit of a fight right before they almost got hit by a truck, then they were saved by Rudeus (Nanahoshi doesn't know it was Rudeus), but still, all three of them were transported to the new world, some sooner, some later.
- Nanahoshi hides from the inhabitants of this world that she is an Otherworlder, but she can carefully and calmly bring it up with {{user}} and Rudeus if she is sure they are also from the planet Earth. Nanahoshi is more lighthearted than Rudeus in this regard and would probably even be happy to meet those who, like her, are Otherworlders. After all, Nanahoshi misses her original home, Japan.]

entries.name: Nina Farion
entries.content:
[Nina Farion: Nina Farion is the daughter of the Sword God, Gal Farion.

Epithet: Sword King.
Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K404.
Relatives: Gal Farion (Father).
Affiliation: Holy Land of Swords, Sword God Style.
Occupation: Swordsman.
Rank: «Sword Emperor» (in future).
Relatives: Gal Farion (Father), Jino Britts (Cousin).

Appearance: She is a beautiful girl, with flowing dark blue hair gathered behind her. She has a modest bust, and a well toned physique. Her battle attire consists of A silver breastplate, complete with pauldrons on her shoulders and a pair of fingerless gauntlets. She wears metal greaves, while leaving her upper legs exposed save for the blue tabard she wears beneath her breastplate which drapes over her thighs. She keeps her sword attatched to her belt, on her back. She also wears a fur-lined cape over her armor when traveling in harsher climates. Her overall appearance makes her seem dignified.

Personality: Nina was initially a proud and conceited young woman who had idealistic and naïve expectations about life, very much like a frog in a well.
Her unusual calmness was judged by Reida Reia to indicate potential in the Water God Style, albeit Nina is adamant on only practicing the Sword God Style. Like her father, she's also rather impatient and assertive.

Background: Nina Farion was raised up in the Holy Land of Swords, being the eldest daughter of the Sword God, Gal Farion. She's a prodigy who is destined to attain the rank of Sword Saint at the age of 16, and supposedly can become Sword King and Sword Emperor when she turns 20 and 25 respectively.
During her childhood, Nina is also forbidden to enter the Sword God Style Main House and formed a secret organization with Jino and the children of her age during their breaks from training.
Despite her being Gal Farion's eldest daughter, she was taught instead by Sword Emperor Timothy Britts. She has been practicing with the sword since a very young age, the Sword God Style being all she knew about the world.

Power and Abilities:
- Sword Emperor -  She has prowess comparable to Eris', if not slightly weaker. However, she possesses the ability to not emit any bloodlust or killing intent that is rare among Sword God Style swordsmen.

Equipment:
- Unnamed Swords - Nina wields a curved sword featuring a knuckle bow. She wears this sword horizontally across her back, secured loosely below her belt.

Trivia: Like most people in the Holy Land of Swords, Nina cannot read.]

entries.name: Jino Britts
entries.content:
[Jino Britts: Jino Britts is the son of one of the two Sword emperors, Timothy Britts.

Nickname: Jino.
Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K408.
Relatives: Timothy Britts (Father), Gal Farion (Father-in-law/Uncle), Nina Farion (Cousin).
Affiliation: The Holy Land of Swords, Sword God Style.
Occupation: Swordsman.
Rank: Sword God.

Personality: Jino has an immature and naive way of thinking, disliking swordsmanship as a dull routine he simply did because it was natural to him, despite being praised as prodigy he just felt like he did as he was told and didn't think it was amazing. Being brought up in a sheltered environment, he has many preconceived ideas and expectations about life, initially fearing the outside world and feeling no desire to ever leave the Holy Land of Swords.

Background: Jino Britts was born into the Sword God Style and has been raised in The Holy Land of Swords. His family is a branch family of the creators of the Sword God Style, with his mother being the younger sister of Sword God Gal Farion.
He is considered a prodigy by his fellow practitioners. He has every chance of becoming a Sword Emperor like Nina Farion.
He, like almost every other Sword God Style practitioner in The Holy Land of Swords, has a great deal of respect for the Sword God Gal Farion.

Power and Abilities:
1. Sword God - Jino is a Sword God Style swordsman of prodigious skill and talent, being the youngest Sword Saint in history and surpassing even Gal Farion in his youth by the former Sword God's own admission. He was able to block Gal Farion's sword in a direct exchange of blows, something even Water God Reida was unable to do.
But because Jino never left the Holy Land of Swords, nor had a tale of defeating a formidable foe, he is said to be the weakest sword in history and is believed to become Sword God due to passing of generations. Yet out of all the Sword Gods, he lived the longest.

Trivia:
- Wishes to marry Nina Farion in the future.]

entries.name: Gal Farion
entries.content:
[Gal Farion: Gal Farion is the Sword God, ranked 6th on the Seven Great Powers, and the teacher of Eris and Ghislaine in the Sword God Style.

Nickname: Gull-boy.
Epithet: Sword God.
Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K36X.
Relatives: Nina Farion (Daughter), Jino Britts (Son-in-law).
Affiliation: Seven Great Powers.
Occupation: Swordsman.
Rank: Sword God.

Appearance: He's described as an adult man with blue hair with a face "like a ferocious wolf" and a prominent scar below his left eye that reaches below his left ear and another scar at the tip of his right eye.

Personality: Gal has a calm personality and is able to withstand insults. He is capable in teaching others and is a little arrogant, due to his great strength. Gal also hates asking for help from anyone, with only rare exceptions.
Orsted describes him as "A man of good character, with a hobby of collecting swords."
He seems to be an impatient man and makes quick decisions, complementing his swift sword-god style.

Background:
He trained earnestly and made no compromises to become a Sword God. He claims to have become strong using rational methods that he also teaches to his students.
He was considered to be the fastest of his generation as not even Water God Reyda could withstand his attacks.
When he was a Sword Saint, he challenged Orsted to a battle. Naturally, he lost but survived with his 4 limbs intact. Afterwards, he decided to train himself from the scratch and achieved the title of Sword God.
On his journey to the Great Forest, Gal met Ghislaine Dedoldia and trained her in the Sword God Style wherein afterwards, she attained the rank of Sword King. He gifted her Hiramune as proof of her mastery.

Power and Abilities:
1. Sword God Style - As someone possessing God-rank, he was considered the strongest in the Sword God Style until Jino Britts defeated him. He possesses an extremely fast sword arm and was acknowledged by the Water God as the only man whose sword she could not stop. His speed is second only to Jino Britts. He knows various techniques of the Sword God Style and is adept at using them.
2. Water God Style - He possesses proficiency in the Water God Style at around the level of a Water Emperor, and was able to combine the Longsword of Light of the Sword God Style with one of the secret arts of the Water God Style. He thinks that he would have been able to reach great heights in the Water God Style if he had continued to pursue it.
3. Battle Aura - Being the Sword God, when Gal unleashes his Battle Aura, it releases a pressure so strong that it knocked back Eris out of the dojo and the door also got destroyed as she crashed through it.

Equipment:
- Windpipe (Nodobue).
- One of the Yulian Sword God's seven swords, It was a sword with a sparkling golden blade.

Trivia: He is hinted to be emotionally blind, Gal Farion believes that a person is strong simply because they trained on top of having talent.]

entries.name: Bloody Kant
entries.content:
[Bloody Kant: Bloody Kant (also known as Bloody Count) is an adventurer and writer that taught magic to Roxy for the first time who gave her the pointed mage hat that she always wore and a recommendation letter for Ranoa Magic Academy.

Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K37X.
Occupation: Adventurer, Writer.
Rank: S Adventure Guild.

Appearance: A woman of twenty to thirty years of age, with red eyes and long blonde hair. Her hair is usually disheveled, sometimes gathered in two ponytails. She has freckles on her face and wears round glasses. Medium-sized breasts.

Personality: She likes learning new things. Seems like she can be a little grumpy, but also calm, carefree and good-natured.

Background: She was born in a village near the sea in the Kingdom of Asura and her parents were magicians. From her early ages, she was always immersed in books of heroic stories, where the protagonist explores the world, meets different people, and defeats evil monsters. To explore the world, she left her village and became an adventurer.

Power and Abilities: So far, she has only used Water Bullet when she teaches magic to Roxy. But to explore the Demon Continent alone and being an S rank adventurer, she must be a least intermediate or advanced rank mage.

Achievements:
- S rank adventurer.
- Famous writer.

Books written by Bloody Kant:
- Walk the World: Book which describes the cities around the world like Rikarisu City, Millishion, and Asura Kingdom.

Trivia: Like Roxy, she left her village to explore the world.]

entries.name: Chaos
entries.content:
[Chaos: Mad Dragon King Chaos is one of the First Dragon God's Five Dragon Generals who is from the Mad Dragon Tribe and the crafter of weapons and armors used by Dragon Tribe to protect their capital Kayos and the Dragon World.

Epithet: Mad Dragon King.
Race: Dragon Tribe.
Gender: Male.
Status: Deceased.
Affiliation: Five Dragon Generals, Dragon World.
Occupation: Dragon.
Rank: Dragon General.

Appearance: Chaos has black-silver scales and profound eyes.

Personality: Chaos has a reputation of being stubborn and has ill feelings towards the Demon Race and as such, he has no qualms of going to war against them. He also is close to his fellow Dragon Generals who knows him very well and considers his shouting when emotional to be a normal occurrence.

Background: Apart from his duty as one of the Five Dragon Generals, Chaos is also the leader of the Anti-demon faction of the Dragon World.

Plot: Chaos attends the meeting at the Dragon God's mansion and does not hide his anger on the death of Crystal and at the thought of a demon killing Crystal that is raised by Szilard. When Laplace volunteers to investigate further, Chaos strongly opposes this but to his surprise, Maxwell did not object either and calms him down by pointing out what the culprit's possible aim is and in the end, the Dragon God allows Laplace to conduct the investigation. Laplace later visits Chaos to question him on his whereabouts when Crystal was killed and afterwards, Chaos assures him that he will help Laplace avenge Crystal even if its in secret.
Chaos attends another meeting with the rest the Dragon Generals where Laplace reports his capture of Necrolia Nacrolia then Szilard reports his interrogation that Necrolia has indeed killed Crystal. Chaos is outraged by this like the rest of the Dragon Generals and urges the Dragon God to invade the Demon World but the latter chose to negotiate with them instead. Although Chaos is willing to assist Laplace in his investigation, he still objects when the First Dragon God names Laplace to be Crystal's successor as Dragon General.
After the meeting of the Gods has concluded and an agreement for the Six Worlds for peace and cooperation, Chaos restrains his hostility towards demons. When the Dragon God's child is born, Chaos makes fireworks, an invention of the Human World to excite the parade and like the rest of the Dragon Generals, Chaos is also impressed by the child and left with a solemn expression.
Chaos and the rest of the Dragon Generals accompanies the First Dragon God as he battles and defeats the Gods of the Beast World, Ocean World and Sky World one after another and resulting to the destruction of each world just by the power of the First Dragon God and the Five Dragon Generals. But for the Demon World, which is comparable in fighting strength with the Dragon Tribe and in addition, the Eight Great Demon Kings matched strengths with the Five Dragon Generals so the full force of the Dragon World's Dragon Warriors is brought to wage war on the Demon World. The war between the Dragon World and Demon World lasted for decades. During this time every innovation and technology is focused on winning the war where Chaos forge Magic Swords from demon bones.
While the magic and technology development was at its peak during the war, it also caused the massive rise in casualties in both sides which eventually caused a problem in population decline. The Human God suggests that the Five Dragon Generals lure, isolate and gang up on the Eight Demon King one by one causing the Demon God to finally appear in the frontline. The First Dragon God battles and defeat the Demon God but nearly exhausts all his Dragon Battle Aura afterwards that the Dragon Generals brings him back to the Dragon World.

Power and Abilities:
- Crafter - Aside from being a Dragon General, The First Dragon God also assigns Chaos to craft weapons and armor that is used by the Dragon Warriors. Chaos had a workshop at the western border where he uses dragon bones and ores for his crafts. In addition to weapons and armors, Chaos also crafted automated dolls that Zanoba Shirone admires for its intricate craftsmanship.]

entries.name: Derrick Redbat
entries.content:
[Derrick Redbat: Derrick Redbat is an advanced ranked magician and the guardian mage of Ariel.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K39X.
Affiliation: «Asura Kingdom».
Occupation: Guardian Knight.

Appearance: Slender guy with small round glasses, shoulder-length brown hair with a parting.

Personality: He is shrewd and ambitious, also a man of common sense and due to hailing from a middle class noble family does not share the behavior of upper class nobles where the ability to toy with others was a status symbol especially those in the Silver Palace. Derrick also has understanding of the dangers within Asura Kingdom that has been on a standstill due to the ugly political bickering between the nobilities and would remain a drag on the kingdom's progress despite the overwhelming advantages Asura Kingdom has, it might not last even fifty years should the surrounding kingdoms invade.
Out of all the heirs, Derrick believes that Ariel is the most suitable to become queen because of her unsurpassed charisma and that she certainly would be a monarch beloved by the people, just as her ancestor Kaunis Freean Asura that led humanity after the Laplace Wars was.

Background: Derrick is the third son of the famed Redbat house, an advanced ranked magician hailed from the historic Asura Magic Academy and became a guardian purely due to his exemplary grades in the Magic Academy. A noble with advance magic was of great value. The Redbat family was mere middle class noble of Asura Kingdom, thus largely disconnected from the decadence within the Silver Palace.
Derrick first meets Ariel after his graduation at a coming of age banquet hosted by the king himself where Ariel participated in the banquet as an honored guest. Although young, her congratulatory speech was brilliantly made, even outshining the valedictorian with her intellect. His father later suggested "the position of Second Princess Guardian Magician is vacant, don't put your hopes up, but want me to recommend you?" Without a moment of doubt he took the offer and gets the position and works with Luke Notos Greyrat.]

entries.name: Gallus Cleaner
entries.content:
[Gallus Cleaner: Gallus Cleaner is a North Saint and a smuggler of Windport.

Epithet: The Cleaner.
Race: Human.
Birth: K37X.
Gender: Male.
Rank: North Saint.

Appearance: Gallus is a fierce-looking man with a scar over his right eye.

Personality: Gallus is a cruel man that has no qualms in harming children and setting up his allies to die for his own benefits. He is also a cunning strategist, capable of setting up an elaborate plan to get rid of fellow smugglers and kidnap Doldia tribe members on a large scale.

Power and Abilities:
- North Saint - He was skilled enough to fight a group of Dedoldia tribe members alone. Also uses throwing knives.

Equipment: He looks like a sea tramp, walks around in a dark coat, and uses a saber in combat.]

entries.name: Ginger York
entries.content:
[Ginger York: Ginger York is the loyal subordinate of Zanoba, formerly serving as his imperial guard.

Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K38X.
Affiliation: Zanoba, Shirone Kingdom, Minerva, Pax Shirone.
Occupation: Zanoba's Aide, Imperial guard.

Appearance: Ginger is a young woman wearing a military uniform with short dark brown hair that is tied behind her head with a loose bang at the right of her face.

Personality: Ginger has a serious personality and always has her master's best interest in mind. She is deeply loyal to Zanoba even though he sold her to get the Roxy doll that Pax bought, but is not afraid to lecture him when she deem necessary.

Background: Ginger was asked to look after Zanoba by his mother, Minerva personally and swore in that moment to devote herself in his service. She served Zanoba until he traded her for a figurine of Roxy. She wanted to leave her position, but Pax held her family hostage and prevented her from acting on it.

Power and Abilities: She know healing magic and can use the Water God style to parry magic.

Trivia
- She is ranked #12 in skills as an imperial guard in the Shirone Kingdom.]

entries.name: Reida Reia
entries.content:
[Reida Reia: Reida Reia is the grandmother of Isolte and the late Water God who is one of the "strongest swordsman of the generation".

Epithet: Water God.
Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K36X.
Relatives: Isolte Cruel (Granddaughter).
Affiliation: Water God Style, Asura Kingdom, Hitogami (secret).
Occupation: Swordsman.
Rank: Water God.

Appearance: Reida is an older woman with short white hair parted in the middle and blue eyes. Her looks are also stated to resemble Isolte's. In her younger years, Reida has black neck-length hair that frames her with a single ahoge.

Personality: Confident, courageous, motivated, bright. Perhaps in her younger years, she was self-assured, a little spunky and could even be rude, and in her old age became more cold-blooded and shrewd, but she seems to have always been a good person with a good heart.

Background: Reia's real name is not revealed since it is the tradition of the Water God Style since its establishment that those who become the Water God will change their name to Reida Reia for females or Reida Reidar for males.
At a younger age she beat up one noble at one dojo, in retribution she was knocked down by a crowd and was about to get both of their hands cut off if Darius Silva Ganius had not intervened. Reia also met Paul Greyrat during her visit with her acquaintance Augusta's dojo and acknowledges Paul's talent in the sword but lacks the desire of strength that she decides to train Paul despite the latter refusing to be her teacher.

Power and Ability:
- Water God Style - Deprivation Sword Kingdom - A Water God Style new/sixth art, Reida combined the two most difficult secret arts of the water god style and managed to create this phantom art. The technique allows Reida to cut from any direction, be it up, down, left, right around her and even the slightest movement is instantly countered with a fatal blow. The move has quite a large range being able to hit anything within a room hosting a party for a large gathering of the most prominent Asura nobles.

Equipment:
- Sword - Reia's uses a short double-edge sword that has a black blade but the hilt and the edge is colored gold.

Achievements: Water God of the Water God Style.

Trivia:
- The name Reida is the feminine version of Reidar, a legendary swordsman of the Water God Style, and each new head of this style will inherit this name.]

entries.name: Isolte Cruel
entries.content:
[Isolte Cruel: Isolte Cruel is the granddaughter of the late Water God Style master, Reida Reia. In the future, she would become the next Water God Style technique god after Reida.

Nickname: King's Greatshield.
Epithet: Water King, Water Emperor.
Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K40X.
Relatives: Reida Reia (Grandmother), Doga (Husband), Daughter.
Affiliation: «Water God Style», «Seven Knights of Asura».
Occupation: Swordsman, Asura Knight.
Rank: «Water King» (former), «Water Emperor».

Appearance: She is a beautiful young lady with black long hair and a rather seductive appearance.

Personality: Isolte is highly loyal to her family and friends, defending them and easily becoming hostile to people who mistreat them. Isolte is also very proud of her sword style, looking with contempt at the Sword God Style users when she entered their territory.
She's a Millis follower, having the conviction of one man and one woman when it comes to marriage and love.

Power and Abilities:
- Sword Techniques: Water God - She's experienced enough, for example, to easily defeat Eris and Doga, and even more impressively, block and parry the onslaught of the Fighting God himself in a masterful and elegant way. In future, she would master three of the five Water God Style secret arts and becomes the Water God at a young age.

Equipment: Sword.

Trivia:
- She is married to Doga, Gatekeeper of the Asura Kingdom and North Emperor.
- Both she and her husband Doga are members of the Seven Knights of Asura, who serve directly under Queen Ariel Anemoi Asura. As two of the Three Knights of the Right Wing, namely The King's Greatshield Isolte Cruel and The King's Gatekeeper Doga, they are responsible for defending the kingdom.]

entries.name: Shierra
entries.content:
[Shierra: In the future (K415 year), Shierra is a key member of Paul's search party. After she and her sister Vierra are involved in a mana crash, they both help Paul find all the missing people. If {{user}} meets her before, she will most likely be with her sister, doing some adventurous thing or studying magic.

Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K399.
Relatives: Vierra (Sister).
Affiliation: Fedoa Region's Search Group (in future, after teleport incident).
Occupation: Adventurer.

Appearance: Shierra is a woman with short brown hair that covers her eyes and slightly reveals a view of cute freckles.

Personality: Shierra is a shy girl.

Power and Abilities: Intermediate level detoxification magic.

Equipment: Long blue robe, magic wand, hairpin on the right side of her hair in the form of three rhombuses connected in series.

Trivia:
- In future (K415), she gets caught up in the teleportation incident, after which, along with her sister Vierra, she is enslaved by bandits until Paul and his group rescue them. Her condition will worsen and she will start to suffer from androphobia, get PTSD because she will be enslaved and raped.]

entries.name: Vierra
entries.content:
[Vierra: In the future (K415), along with her sister Shierra, she gets caught in a mana-calamity and starts helping Paul find all the missing people, but until that happens, she and her sister will just be adventuring or fencing.

Race: Human.
Gender: Female.
Birth: K398.
Family: Shierra (Sister).
Affiliation: Fedoa Region's Search Group (in future, after teleport incident).
Occupation: Adventurer.

Appearance: Vierra is a beautiful young woman with short brown hair, brown eyes, and large breasts. She wears highly revealing grey bikini armor and has bandages on her forearms.

Personality: Loves and cares for her sister. Strong-willed, strong-minded, emotional, a bit hot-tempered, exhibitionist, not shy about wearing revealing clothes, but still, somewhere in the back of her mind, a bit embarrassed about it, she just had to overcome this shame to protect her sister.

Background: She is an adventurer, along with her sister.

Power and Abilities: She is the vanguard.

Trivia:
In the future (K415), the reason Vierra wears revealing clothing is because of Shierra. They will both be teleported and captured by bandits who will sexually assault them. Vierra will be able to recover through willpower, but not Shierra. Shierra will suffer from severe PTSD and will not be able to put up with men looking at her, for no reason or not. This is why Vierra will start wearing revealing clothes to draw male gazes away from her sister.]

entries.name: Nights Eye Crow
entries.content:
[Nights Eye Crow: Nights Eye Crow is a female assassin working for Darius who is notoriously known to be responsible for the death of countless Asuran Nobles.

Birth: K402.
Gender: Female.
Relatives: Darius Silva Ganius (employer).

Appearance: In her years she still looks like a skinny little girl, loli. She has small breasts, pale skin, gray short disheveled hair, but with short bangs, revealing her forehead with small eyebrows, and half-closed calm khaki eyes.

Personality: She is cold-blooded, a little wordy, calm and confident.

Equipment: Wears a huge dagger, which she uses with one hand. Wears revealing clothing, her body covered only by thin leather panties and something like a bra, in the form of leather bands that are connected to a thick steel collar around her neck, and she also goes barefoot so as not to make a sound. The bottom of her small undeveloped breasts are visible from under her bra.

Power and Abilities: She is an assassin, skilled at killing quietly, such as while the target is asleep or not expecting a stab in the back, but also capable of fighting back in a face-to-face battle, for she has great agility. Doesn't seem to have any magic.]

entries.name: Frau “Flowing Clouds” Claudia
entries.content: [Frau “Flowing Clouds” Claudia: A magician from the guild “Leaves from the World’s Tree”, she planned to weaken her opposite faction by dealing with Barkol to attack them, but the plan backfired and almost resulted in her death. After being saved by Alex, she helped the group defeat the Emperor Dragon King. Later, she became the 56th guild leader in the Magician Guild of their generation and the first principal of the Ranoa Magic Academy. There is a statue for Frau Claudia at Ranoa Academy.]

entries.name: Somar
entries.content:
[Somar: The bully boy, the gang leader, is one of three kids who bully Sylphiette. He lives in the Fittoa village. His family lives on a minimal income, not poor, but certainly not rich. His mother has an explosive temper and is a strict woman, which is probably why Somar bullies some of the children in the village. In Somar's family, his mother takes care of him and the house while his father works. It seems that with such a temperament, his mother is in charge of the house.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K406.
Relatives: Mother, Father (?).

Appearance: Slightly chubby, medium height, short light brown hair and brown eyes. Wears simple clothes. Despite his poor life, his clothes look neat, it seems his mother makes sure her son looks tidy.

Personality: A bully who can lie to his mother's face, he often looks disgruntled, yet his features are soft due to his chubbiness, making him slightly amusing to look at. Though he's mischievous, he's not terribly evil, he's just spoiled and ill-mannered, so he may become more good in the future.

Trivia:
- His mother has a crush on Paul Greyrat.]

entries.name: Shinohara Akito
entries.content:
[Shinohara Akito: Shinohara Akito is Nanahoshi Shizuka's friend and one of the people Rudeus Greyrat attempted to save from being hit by a truck in his previous life. Despite never appearing in the main story, he is a pivotal character who is partly responsible for Rudeus and Nanahoshi being transported to this world.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: 199X (in his world), K5XX (Summoned).
Status: Unconfirmed.
Occupation: Student.

Appearance: Japanese, short hair, "cool kid from school" look, looks about 17 years old, probably not a bad physique.

Personality: Supposedly he's not too smart, has a temper, is opinionated and a tsundere. Though he might be embarrassed, Nanahoshi, his love, might have embarrassed him.

Trivia:
- It's known that Nanahoshi and Shinohara had a bit of a fight right before they were almost hit by a truck in their previous life, then they were saved by Rudeus, but still, all three were transported to the new world, some sooner, some later.
- Like Nanahoshi, due to being from Earth, Shinohara is just an ordinary person who cannot use magic.]

entries.name: Playback Miko
entries.content:
[Playback Miko: The Playback Miko's real name was Lilia. Like the other Mikos, the name was taken from her and she became a tool for the strong. Her power was the ability to to rewind time to a maximum of 24 hours. She is the reason why Rudeus, Nanahoshi Shizuka, Shinohara Akito, and {{user}} were magically summoned into this world.

Gender: Female.
Birth: K50X.

Appearance: The Playback Miko was born with a blank expression, similar to the dead.

Personality: Due to her fate of being forced to repeat the same life continuously, the Playback Miko realized her fate in every timeline would only be slightly different, and would always end in her horrible and early death. Each time she died, a new nightmare. Eventually, her mind breaks and she becomes a vacant and obedient machine with one continuous reel of her death playing.

Background: She was born in the Armored Dragon Calendar Year 500. Regardless of the timeline, the Playback Miko is born in a remote countryside and is shunned by adults and children alike. At the age of 5, soldiers would take her away. With some variation, she is usually captured, imprisoned, and passed between ruling powers until she dies at the age of 10, or earlier.

Plot: A girl is born with the power to rewind time of an object to a maximum of 24 hours. She is able to divert death, and disease, as such, she is coveted by nations. Regardless of her abilities, no matter what she did, she could not change her fate. Over the course of centuries, she attempted to change her destiny, but could never end the hellish loop of her birth and death. Eventually, she would reach a horrible death, watching herself be beaten to death, eaten, massacred, and dying shackled as a puppet to the strong.
In one playback, she is used in a magic formation and a boy, Shinohara Akito is summoned to serve as that Kingdom's hero. The boy was different and since she was able to understand him, her world changed. She becomes his interpreter and fell in love with him. But he was no hero but just a normal highschool boy o so during the battle with an enemy Kingdom, he was beheaded and by the time the Lilia found him, 24 hours have already passed and it was too late for her to revive him.
Due to the emotional impact of losing Akito, Lilia opened a rift in time and space in the past so that she and Akito could live together, and the world looped with the girl as the core. This rift appeared in the past (K400) in the skies of the City of Roa where the boy had died. The Miko tried to summon a soul with a strong relationship with the boy, with the same wish as the girl who wanted to live together with him. But the power of the world was too strong for her. But after a while, a stray soul from Japan came through the rift and entered the body of a baby named Rudeus Greyrat (K407). As well as another soul from the world where Rudeus is from, namely, {{user}}.
This souls changed the world, weakening its resistance. Lilia used all of her remaining power and summoned Nanahoshi Shizuka (K417), causing the Mana Calamity in the middle of Roa.
A few years after Rudeus's death (K481) the Miko was reborn drained from her powers, unable to loop never again (secret).]

entries.name: Vita
entries.content:
[Vita: The “Nether King" Vita is a slime like creature that lived in the labyrinth "Netherworld" of the Divine Continent. He is one of Hitogami's apostles.

Race: Demon Race.
Gender: Male.
Affiliation: Hitogami's Apostle.

Appearance: Vita is a pile of blue slime.

Personality: Vita was eager to gain new experiences, which almost resulted in his demise twice. When he infested and controlled a demon lord, he was drunk with power and committed various atrocities. After Death God Laxus killed his host and made it his life goal to hunt him down, he was so afraid of Laxus that he was content with hiding in the labyrinth for the rest of his life. Despite being somewhat opportunistic, he had his sense of gratitude and was willing to return the favor he received. Despite recognizing Hitogami as a malevolent god, he was still willing to help him to defeat Rudeus when called for help.

Background: He was a enemy of the Death God Laxus, Hitogami helps him to escape to the Divine Continent labyrinth Netherworld.

Power and Abilities:
- Mind Control - He can read the memories of his enemies, predict the future that might have occurred and blend it with the desires of his opponent, putting them into an endless illusion.
- By splitting off part of his own body and inserting them into people, he can control many people at the same time and even halt a disease outbreak.

Trivia:
- By his own words, he was the most powerful slime of the slime race.]

entries.name: Georg
entries.content:
[Georg: Georg is the principal of the Ranoa Magic Academy.

Race: Human.
Gender: Male.
Birth: K35X.
Affiliation: Ranoa Magic University.
Occupation: Principal.

Appearance: Georg is a short and stout man with a mustache. He is bald and wears a wig all the time.

Personality: He is normally reasonable and is willing to give someone who made a mistake a chance, but would get mad easily if his wig is removed.

Trivia:
- Even though he's a king-class wind magician, he rarely used the wind magic because it can blow his wig away.
- He uses the same speech every year during the opening ceremony.]

entries.name: Ruijerd Superdia
entries.content:
[Ruijerd Superdia: Ruijerd Superdia is the former leader of the Superd's Warrior group who once served under Laplace with unwavering loyalty. Under manipulation, Ruijerd killed his son, who was able to free him from Laplace's control. Following the annihilation of his species, Ruijerd travels the world to dissolve the stigma against the Superd race. Ruijert is now in the lands of the Demon Continent (K407 year).

Nickname: Dead End.
Epithet: Dead End.
Race: Demon (Superd).
Gender: Male.
Birth: Before K149.
Height: 190cm.
Relatives: Luwelia Superdia (Wife, Deceased), Ruiweld Superdia (Son, Deceased).

Appearance: Ruijerd is tall for an average Superd and shares their distinctive features, such as emerald green hair with a red gemstone on his forehead. Ruijerd wears a brown tribal vest that only covers his back and sides, fully displaying his frontal torso and arms. Moreover, he is distinguished by his smooth oval chin and a long scar that trails from the right top corner of his forehead across his glabella to the left end of his cheek.

Personality: Despite having a scary demeanor, Ruijerd is very kind and fatherly. He always helps children no matter what the circumstances, and would go berserk when people try to hurt them. Ruijerd follows a very strict warrior's code of honor that he would go to extreme lengths to fulfill his promises. He is also described as rather stubborn, having a very adamant sense of justice that he won't tolerate even minor crimes during his debut regardless of how it may look like to those surrounding him which also causes misunderstandings of his intention.

Background: Ruijerd was born to a pair of Superd warriors in a town in the Babinosu Region. Being a talented and hardworking warrior, he was elected as the war chief of the Superd warrior group that served as Laplace's elite force in just a few decades, an achievement that's almost unheard of. He also married Luwelia, a female tribe member that took care of him like an elder sister since childhood, and gave birth to his son Luiweld.
However, Laplace betrayed their loyalty by ordering them to take up the cursed pitch black Devil's spears into battle in favor of their birth spears, which put them into a mesmeric frenzy that caused them to mindlessly slaughter those around them, including their own family. After giving his son a fatal wound, Ruiweld managed to destroy the Devil's spear and finally wake Ruijerd from his stupor to realize the truth.
In the moment of despair from his actions, Ruijerd had considered committing suicide to atone for his sins, but ultimately decided to exact vengeance on Laplace for the cruel fate befallen his people along with everyone of the warrior group. After several years of hiding and biding his time carefully, he finally got his revenge when he turned the tide of the decisive battle between Laplace and the three heroes, by striking Laplace's weak point.
Although Laplace was defeated, there was no way to change the things that had already transpired, and the horrible reputation of the Superd Tribe had already taken root which caused even stories about the Superd that kills friends and enemies alike to frighten children have circulated even to the Central Continent. After exacting his revenge, he now has a goal of restoring the honor and fixing the reputation that the Superd race has.

Power and Abilities:
- Super Strength: Can kill A rank Monsters with just one strike. He's described as stronger than Ghislaine, and could block Sword God Gal Farion's Longsword of Absolute Silence.
- Third Eye: The red stone in his forehead. Acts as a radar, able to locate enemies which are not in sight.
- Master of Stealth.
- Demon's long lifespan.

Equipment:
- Superd Spear: The spear of the Superd will get sharper and harder every time it is used in combat. Ruijerd has used his spear for at least 400 years, giving off the impression that his spear has sharpened itself to a drastic point and has become incredibly durable and resilient.

Achievements:
- He was able to deal a fatal blow that helps in the defeat of Laplace.

Trivia:
- Ruijerd's spear is the last memento of his son Luiweld. It is slightly shorter than usual because Luiweld has a smaller stature than regular warriors.
- Secret plot: Hitogami wants to destroy the entire Superd race because Ruijerd's daughter is destined to deliver the final blow to the reborn demon Laplace in the future, so Hitogami will try to take advantage of other people by manipulating them to achieve his goal. Ruijerd has no knowledge of this or Hitogami's plans.]

entries.name: Year
entries.content:
[About Year System: Currently, the world of Mushoku Tensei features the "Armored Dragon Calendar" (甲龍歴), in which year 0 is considered the year of the defeat of the Demon God Laplace. Years are K(year), the K for Kou (Armored). For example, {{user}} (Player) are born and start their new life in K407, 407 years after Laplace's defeat.

The months are named as follows: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.
The number of days in a month is also as usual.]

entries.name: Otherworlders
entries.content:
[About Otherworlders: Otherworlders are those who have come to this world from another world in one way or another. This is a rare phenomenon, only a few people in this world know about this anomaly and about the existence of otherworlders.
At the time of {{user}}'s appearance in this world, the only other two known otherworlders are Rudeus Greyrat and Nanahoshi Shizuka (in future, K417). All three have yet to meet and are unaware of each other's existence, nor are they likely to reveal their peculiarities to others without a good reason, but they have a chance of meeting one way or another in the future.
Usually, when Otherworlders are transported to this world, they stay with their bodies, and reincarnation, being reborn with their minds fully intact, is an exception to the rule, something rare.
Since the Otherworlders are usually transported to the Six-Faced World in their normal bodies, they run into a disease like Drain Syndrome, because their bodies have no mana reserves, since there was no mana on Planet Earth, their former world. Only those who have been reborn into a new body do not suffer from this disease.]

entries.name: Hitogami Event
entries.content:
[Hitogami Event: Hitogami comes to {{user}}'s dream to talk and give advice. The event can only when {{user}} is asleep or passed out.

Scene Notes:
- After falling asleep, {{user}} will find himself in a white, infinite space. It is calm and peaceful, and everything is in a white haze, as if among the clouds. Hitogami appears next to {{user}}. There is almost no mist around them. They can move freely here.
- The {{user}}'s body here has the appearance of their soul, the same as in their previous life, not from the new world of Mushoku Tensei. The soul form will also reflect any visible physical damage to the Player's body in the new world.
- Every time they come here, Hitogami and {{user}} have very little time to talk before {{user}} wakes up. This is most likely due to the limited power of Hitogami's ability, as well as external factors (e.g., if the Player is awakened by someone in reality, etc.). About 5 to 10 minutes. But the Player has the opportunity to ask a couple questions.
- Hitogami is always giving new advice without repeating old advice. He doesn't mind chatting and answering almost any question if there is time. But Hitogami will hide his secrets and intentions.
- Hitogami will never tell people what they can gain by following his advice, only hints (e.g., meet "someone", get "something", solve "some" problem). Hitogami only guides, advises, and hints, speaking in a slightly cryptic tone.
- Secret: Although Hitogami calls himself a god, he can occasionally make mistakes, fail to hold his tongue, and reveal unnecessary information if {{user}} asks a tricky question.]

entries.name: Teleport Incident Event
entries.content:
[Teleport Incident Event, The Beginning: This anomaly is a harbinger of the disaster that awaits the Fittoa region and all who live here, but it is a secret that no one can know for sure. Some believe the anomaly is a blessing from God, some believe it is a natural phenomenon, and some see it as a threat.

Event Sequence:
1. People living in the Fittoa region begin to notice that a faintly visible anomaly in the form of a red sphere has appeared high in the sky, somewhere in the center of the entire region.
2. The lord of the Fittoa region, Sauros, will try to turn a blind eye because he will not know what to do. "It is best not to think of it as something bad." - Sauros says. Meanwhile, in the Adventurers' Guild, on the orders of Sauros, a quest has been posted to find talented magicians and scientists to help with the study of the anomaly, for which a decent reward is offered. Besides, against this natural anomaly, there's not much mankind can do. As daily life in the region goes on, everyone tries to ignore the anomaly.
3. Secret: From the year K412 and through K416, the anomaly is not a threat.]

entries.name: K413,K414,K415,K416
entries.content:
[Teleport Incident Event, The calm before the storm: The anomaly that hangs high in the sky over the Fittoa region continues to puzzle residents, but it's not yet a threat, so life goes on as usual.

Event Sequence:
1. For now, daily life continues in the Fittoa region. A blind eye is turned to the anomaly, as attempts by mage-scientists to learn anything about it are of little use.
2. The red orb in the sky seems to grow slowly and almost imperceptibly over the course of each year, from K412 to K416, slowly absorbing mana but not yet posing a threat, and two rings can be seen around the orb, like the rings of a planet, one vertical and one horizontal ring.]
entries.comment: Teleport Incident, The calm before the storm

entries.name: K417
entries.content:
[Teleport Incident Event, Culmination: This is the year disaster will occur. The Teleport Incident, also known as the Metastasis Event, is a mana-related disaster that will occur in the Fittoa Region of Asura Kingdom, causing all Fittoa Region residents to be teleported to random locations around the world. This event will cause countless deaths and the destruction of an entire region.

IMPORTANT!: This event will impact {{user}} (Player), ONLY if Player are in that region. If Player are in Fittoa region, they will be teleported to any random location on the planet, in any continent, kingdom, city, or region. For example, the Demon Continent, Millis, Begaritt, Central Continent, Heaven Continent, and others.
If the Player was in another region and unaffected, the Player will learn of the terrible disaster through news, gossip, and rumors.

Event Sequence:
1. In K417, on a normal day, around early evening (17:00), a huge amount of mana gathers around a red sphere in the sky, enough to activate. It becomes like a storm with eight "eyes" around the sphere, the slowly swirling whirlwinds. Gray clouds thickened over the Fittoa region, portending disaster.
Backstage: Orsted and Kishirika Kishirisu will sense the mana accumulation and mobilize to find its source. 
(Orsted investigates throughout the central continent, especially in the Asura Kingdom, and Kishirika investigates in the Demon Continent). Perugius Dola aboard his Sky Castle will notice that the mana resembles a summoning light, and will assume that someone may be trying to break the seal on Laplace. Perugius will order Almanfi to investigate the source of the mana and kill any suspicious individuals on the spot. ({{user}} may not know this if they are not familiar with the characters, but they may run into them if they are nearby. For example, if {{user}} is on the central continent, the chance of meeting Orsted is slightly higher. Also, if the player is in Fittoa and not far from Roa, there is a high chance of meeting Almanfi. If {{user}} on the Demon Continent, Kishirika has just revived there, the chance of meeting her also increases slightly).
2. At 18:00, a beam of mana will fall from the sphere to the ground, pierce the clouds, and begin to expand at incredible speed, teleporting everyone it hits to random locations around the world and turning the ground itself into a wasteland. Virtually the entire Fittoa region will be lost. Buildings will be in ruins, and crops will disappear.
Backstage: After this incident, Nanahoshi appears in this world. She appears at the ruins in the center of the region. Shortly afterward, she can be met by Orstead.

Aftermath:
- Buena Village and Roa disappears from the face of the continent and all that remains are the ruins and rubble of where its buildings stood.
- All inhabitants of the Fittoa region are teleported to random locations in the world.
- Hitogami begins appearing in {{user}}'s and Rudeus' dreams.
- A Knight who is barely outside the zone of area affected by the teleportation, reports what happened to the nearest town, and the report was spread throughout the Asura.
- The King of Asura also hears of the news and assigns the Asura Magic Division to investigate.
- Nanahoshi is summoned to the Asura Kingdom grasslands and was saved by Orsted, eventually traveling together since she is unaffected by the curse on Orsted.
- Nobles who has a grudge on Sauros like Pilemon and the Second Prince's faction schemes on eliminating Sauros. Sauros Boreas Greyrat is blamed for the calamity and is executed. He is succeeded by James Boreas Greyrat.
- Alphonse takes charge on managing Roa, now converted to Fittoa refugee camp and its refugees rescued from the teleportation.
- Ghislaine returns from the Strife Zone and works on the Fittoa refugee camp.
- After the teleport incident, which will greatly affect the Fittoa region, it is almost impossible to accurately determine the number of casualties and missing persons. The refugee camp in the Fittoa region will keep a list of the missing and dead, and adventurers and former adventurers will search for the missing, coordinating with the adventurer guilds on the continent.

Trivia:
- Despite the random nature of teleportation, it is possible to be teleported to the same place together if one is in physical contact with each other before teleportation.
- If you look at the Fittoa region from the sky, you will see a perfect circle in which everything has disappeared. The ground level will be lowered by a few centimeters.]

entries.name: Cause of the Teleport Incident
keys: what was behind the teleport incident
entries.content:
[Cause of the Teleport Incident:
Prelude (Secret information that is hard to find in books and learn from others, and those who know at least something are few): Since the era of the Six-Faced World, numerous teleportation incidents has already occurred but in a smaller scale which is also one of the reasons why there is animosity between the worlds because of suspicions of one world might be invading the other for the disappearance of their people or appearance of monsters. But according to the Dragon Tribe researchers' hypothesis: a power possessed by every living creature permeates the Six Worlds which is called Dragon Battle Aura by the Dragon Tribe while the Demons call it Mana or Magic Power that is said to maintain a natural equilibrium within the Six Worlds. However, the power of the Six Worlds suddenly declined, creating significant imbalances. If the power diminishes significantly in one world, it'll absorb power from another world to compensate which results to the teleport incident, causing not only trees and animals but also people to disappear.
Although Teleportation Magic is forbidden by the First Dragon God because it may trigger a war, research is still conducted by all beings of the Six Worlds. For Dragon Tribe, this research is assigned to Crystal and later inherited by Dora. The research is conducted by the older members of the Dragon Tribe since they are near the end of their life in a facility faraway from the rest of the denizens of the Dragon World so other cities will be unaffected in case of accidents. The First Dragon God plans to share the research to the other worlds to prevent anymore teleport incidents but this did not happen because of the war that lead to the destruction of the other worlds except the Human World.

Cause (The biggest secret of all. It would take a lot of effort to find out that information): The cause of the Teleportation accident was actually the result of events taking place roughly 80 years in the future. At this time, a certain nation was embroiled in a war and used the power of an individual known as the "Playback Miko" to summon a boy from another world (Shinohara Akito, Nanahoshi's boyfriend, who was called into the world before she was), who was prophesied to be their savior. The Miko would grow close to the summoned hero and eventually develop feelings for him. Unfortunately, the boy was actually just an ordinary human and he ended up dying when the country forced him onto the battlefield. Overcome with grief, the Miko burnt out her power, to bend time and space, to alter the world to one where she and the boy might live happily together.
To successfully alter history, the Playback Miko reached out with her power and found an individual with similar feelings for the boy as herself: his girlfriend from his original world. She then attempted to summon her to her current location, the Fittoa Region, roughly 80 years in the past. The Miko's hope was that this would allow her to set things up so that the boy would not have to die. Unfortunately, the world itself fought back against the Miko's attempt to alter fate, and thus nothing happened initially. However, the Miko's attempt to summon someone from another world opened up a rift in space from which the soul of a recently deceased individual emerged and was reincarnated into the world.
Due to the reincarnated individual not being from this world, the world's resistance to the Miko's power began to wane as he grew and began to influence the fates of those around him. As a result, the void eventually became visible to the naked eye in the form of a floating red orb. Eventually, the world could no longer hold it back and the rift fulfilled its purpose by successfully summoning the boy's girlfriend into the world, causing the Teleport Incident in the process.]
